// `speed` card: a line-art stick figure sprinting through flowing dashed wind lines that bend around
// it, faint afterimages behind, a gold count-up speed label and a small spinning stopwatch
// (IFOLOGY "250 KM/H").
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import type { CardProps } from './index';
import { Icon, runPose } from './icons';
import { C, Caps, GlowDefs, GoldText, NavyBg, Push, backOut, clamp01, countText, decimalsOf, easeOut, f, isNumeric, sBool, sNum, sStr, seg } from './kit';

export const SpeedCard: React.FC<CardProps> = ({ t, dur, spec, W, H }) => {
  const raw = spec.value;
  const numeric = raw != null && isNumeric(raw);
  const unit = sStr(spec, 'unit', 'KM/H');
  const label = sStr(spec, 'label');
  const stopwatch = sBool(spec, 'stopwatch', true);
  const cadence = sNum(spec, 'cadence', 2.4); // strides per second of the run cycle

  const fx = 720, fy = 560, figSize = 440;
  // wind lines: streamlines that bow around the runner and flow right→left
  const rows = 15;
  const lines: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    const y0 = 170 + (r * (H - 340)) / (rows - 1);
    const rel = (y0 - fy) / 260;
    const bow = 70 * Math.sign(rel || 1) * Math.exp(-rel * rel * 0.9) * (Math.abs(rel) < 0.2 ? 0.4 : 1);
    let d = '';
    for (let x = -40; x <= W + 40; x += 30) {
      const g = Math.exp(-Math.pow((x - fx - 40) / 260, 2));
      const ripple = 7 * Math.sin(x / 150 + t * 4 + r * 1.3);
      const y = y0 + bow * g + ripple * (0.4 + 0.6 * (1 - g));
      d += `${x === -40 ? 'M' : 'L'}${x},${f(y)} `;
    }
    const appear = easeOut(seg(t, 0.02 * r, 0.02 * r + 0.35));
    const speed = 900 + (r % 3) * 220;
    const o = (0.3 + 0.35 * ((r * 7) % 5) / 4) * appear;
    lines.push(
      <path
        key={r}
        d={d}
        fill="none"
        stroke={C.line}
        strokeWidth={r % 4 === 0 ? 3.2 : 2.4}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeDasharray={r % 2 ? '46 30' : '70 38'}
        strokeDashoffset={f(t * speed + r * 53)}
        opacity={o}
      />,
    );
  }

  const ph = t * cadence;
  const bob = Math.abs(Math.cos(ph * Math.PI * 2)) * -8;
  const lab = backOut(seg(t, 0.25, 0.6), 1.8);
  const c0 = 0.3, cd = Math.min(1.1, Math.max(0.6, dur * 0.3));
  const txt = numeric ? countText(t, sNum(spec, 'from', 0), sNum(spec, 'value', 0), c0, cd, decimalsOf(raw)) : label;
  const shimmerK = seg(t, c0 + cd, c0 + cd + 0.7);

  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <NavyBg t={t} W={W} H={H} cx={40} />
      <Push t={t} dur={dur} ox={40}>
        <svg width={W} height={H} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
          <defs>
            <GlowDefs id="spd" />
          </defs>
          {lines}
          {/* afterimages */}
          {[3, 2, 1].map(k => (
            <Icon
              key={k}
              name="run"
              pose={runPose(ph - k * 0.07, 20)}
              x={fx - k * 120}
              y={fy + bob}
              size={figSize}
              p={seg(t, 0.1, 0.5)}
              sw={4}
              opacity={0.26 - k * 0.07}
            />
          ))}
          <Icon name="run" pose={runPose(ph, 20)} x={fx} y={fy + bob} size={figSize} p={seg(t, 0, 0.45)} sw={5} filter="url(#spd-soft)" />
          {stopwatch && (
            <Icon name="stopwatch" x={1640} y={300} size={120} p={seg(t, 0.3, 0.7)} t={t * 3} sw={3.5} filter="url(#spd-soft)" />
          )}
        </svg>
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', left: 1010, top: 300, transform: `translateY(-50%) scale(${0.6 + 0.4 * lab})`, transformOrigin: 'left center',
            opacity: clamp01((t - 0.25) / 0.1), display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 20,
          }}
        >
          {numeric ? (
            <>
              <GoldText text={txt} size={170} shimmer={shimmerK > 0 && shimmerK < 1 ? -0.2 + 1.4 * shimmerK : null} />
              <GoldText text={unit} size={84} tabular={false} spacing={0.04} />
            </>
          ) : (
            <GoldText text={txt} size={130} tabular={false} />
          )}
        </div>
        {numeric && label && (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 1016, top: 410, opacity: easeOut(seg(t, 0.5, 0.85)), transform: `translateY(${(1 - easeOut(seg(t, 0.5, 0.85))) * 18}px)` }}>
            <Caps text={label} size={56} spacing={0.14} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Push>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// `stat` card: one big gold serif number that counts up, a unit beside it, a cream caps label under a
// gold rule, and an optional line-art icon on the left (IFOLOGY "14,000 CALORIES").
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import type { CardProps } from './index';
import { Icon } from './icons';
import {
  C, Caps, GlowDefs, GoldText, NavyBg, Push, backOut, clamp01, countText, decimalsOf, easeOut, isNumeric, sNum, sStr, seg, serifWidth,
} from './kit';

export const StatCard: React.FC<CardProps> = ({ t, dur, spec, W, H }) => {
  const icon = sStr(spec, 'icon');
  const raw = spec.value ?? 0;
  const numeric = isNumeric(raw);
  const to = sNum(spec, 'value', 0);
  const from = sNum(spec, 'from', 0);
  const decimals = spec.decimals != null ? sNum(spec, 'decimals', 0) : Math.max(decimalsOf(raw), decimalsOf(spec.from));
  const prefix = sStr(spec, 'prefix');
  const unit = sStr(spec, 'unit');
  const label = sStr(spec, 'label');
  const countDur = sNum(spec, 'countDur', Math.min(1.1, Math.max(0.5, dur * 0.3)));

  const c0 = 0.15;
  const valueText = numeric ? countText(t, from, to, c0, countDur, decimals) : String(raw);
  const finalText = numeric ? countText(1e9, from, to, 0, 1, decimals) : String(raw);
  const big = `${prefix}${valueText}`;
  const hasIcon = !!icon;
  const blockLeft = hasIcon ? 790 : W / 2;
  const maxW = hasIcon ? W - blockLeft - 170 : W - 260;
  // fit number + unit on one line
  const est = (s: number) => serifWidth(prefix + finalText, s) + (unit ? s * 0.12 + serifWidth(unit, s * 0.46) : 0);
  const size = Math.round(Math.min(250, (250 * maxW) / est(250)));
  const unitSize = Math.round(size * 0.46);

  const pop = backOut(seg(t, 0.05, 0.4), 1.6);
  const done = c0 + countDur;
  const settle = Math.exp(-Math.pow((t - done - 0.08) / 0.09, 2)) * 0.05;
  const shimmerK = seg(t, done, done + 0.7);
  const shimmer = shimmerK > 0 && shimmerK < 1 ? -0.2 + 1.4 * shimmerK : null;
  const rule = easeOut(seg(t, 0.3, 0.75));
  const lab = easeOut(seg(t, 0.4, 0.85));

  const iconX = 490, iconY = H * 0.5, iconSize = 380;
  const align = hasIcon ? 'flex-start' : 'center';
  const glowK = clamp01(t / 0.6);

  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <NavyBg t={t} W={W} H={H} cx={hasIcon ? 34 : 50} />
      <Push t={t} dur={dur}>
        {hasIcon && (
          <svg width={W} height={H} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
            <defs>
              <GlowDefs id="stat" />
              <radialGradient id="stat-disc">
                <stop offset="0" stopColor={C.goldHi} stopOpacity={0.16} />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor={C.goldHi} stopOpacity={0} />
              </radialGradient>
            </defs>
            <circle cx={iconX} cy={iconY} r={300 * (0.9 + 0.1 * glowK) + 6 * Math.sin(t * 1.6)} fill="url(#stat-disc)" opacity={glowK} />
            <Icon name={icon} x={iconX} y={iconY} size={iconSize} p={seg(t, 0, 0.65)} t={t} sw={5} filter="url(#stat-soft)" />
          </svg>
        )}
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', left: blockLeft, top: H * 0.5, transform: `translate(${hasIcon ? '0' : '-50%'}, -50%)`,
            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: align,
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: size * 0.12,
              transform: `scale(${(0.55 + 0.45 * pop) * (1 + settle)})`, transformOrigin: hasIcon ? 'left 70%' : 'center 70%', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.1),
            }}
          >
            <GoldText text={big} size={size} shimmer={shimmer} />
            {unit && <GoldText text={unit} size={unitSize} tabular={false} spacing={0.04} shimmer={shimmer} />}
          </div>
          <div
            style={{
              height: 7, width: rule * (hasIcon ? 620 : 560), marginTop: size * 0.1, borderRadius: 4,
              background: hasIcon ? `linear-gradient(90deg, ${C.goldHi}, ${C.gold} 70%, rgba(240,180,76,0))` : `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(240,180,76,0), ${C.goldHi} 25%, ${C.goldHi} 75%, rgba(240,180,76,0))`,
              alignSelf: hasIcon ? 'flex-start' : 'center', boxShadow: '0 3px 0 rgba(6,9,28,0.8)',
            }}
          />
          {label && (
            <Caps
              text={label}
              size={label.length > 26 ? 56 : 70}
              spacing={0.14}
              style={{ marginTop: 26, opacity: lab, transform: `translateY(${(1 - lab) * 24}px)`, textAlign: hasIcon ? 'left' : 'center' }}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </Push>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
@@@@ END

@@@@ FILE src/demo/PillSprint.tsx | text-crlf | 18738 | 6535a77e6954f0309aedfb96979f0c3889691d9353eb8673f17525f2ead12c12
// 4-second hero shot: our gray-jacket stickman swallows a pill and runs 100x faster.
//  A 0.00–1.45  medium close-up: looks at the pill, swallows, power surges through him
//  B 1.45–2.15  extreme close-up: shock → determined smirk, purple energy crackling
//  C 2.15–3.05  low angle behind him: sprinter crouch, LAUNCH (shockwave, dust, leaves, light trail)
//  D 3.05–4.00  tracking at speed: blurred world, speed lines, afterimages, ×100 callout, exits frame
// All timing lives in pillSprint.json, which the Python sound design reads too.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Sequence, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import TL from './pillSprint.json';
import { CAST } from '../cast';
import { at, evalActor, type ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { camAt, impulse, noise1, project, pxPerMetre, shake, type CamState } from '../engine/cam';
import { AirStreaks, DustBurst, Glow, Leaves, Shockwave, Sparks, Trail } from '../engine/fx';
import { LOOK } from '../engine/materials';
import { gaitPose, resolvePose } from '../engine/rig';
import { setRim, Stage } from '../engine/Stage';
import { Stickman } from '../engine/Stickman';
import { Lighting, PALETTES } from '../sets/look';
import { Suburb } from '../sets/suburb';
import { Crackles, Flash, SpeedLines, type Pt } from '../overlays/Energy';
import { Grade } from '../overlays/Grade';
import { StatCallout } from '../overlays/Stat';
import type { ActorInShot, Face, Pose, Vec3 } from '../types';

export const PILL_SPRINT_SECONDS = TL.duration;
const E = TL.events;
const S = TL.shots;
const W = 1920, H = 1080;
const H0: Vec3 = [0, 0.1, -4.6];
const PAL = PALETTES.afternoon;
const PURPLE = '#a56cff';
const LAVENDER = '#d2b2ff';

const clamp01 = (x: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
const smooth = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => {
  const k = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a));
  return k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
};

// ---- poses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const relaxedL: Pose['armL'] = [2, 8, 0, 14];
const P_HOLD: Pose = { spine: [3, 0, 0], head: [17, -16, 5], armL: relaxedL, reachR: { to: [-0.2, 1.12, 0.3], pole: [-0.7, -0.75, -0.2] }, legL: [0, 4, 0], legR: [0, 4, 0] };
const P_MOUTH: Pose = { spine: [-2, 0, 0], head: [-5, 0, 0], armL: relaxedL, reachR: { to: 'mouth', pole: [-0.6, -0.8, 0.0] }, legL: [0, 4, 0], legR: [0, 4, 0] };
const P_DOWN: Pose = { spine: [2, 0, 0], head: [5, 0, 0], armL: relaxedL, armR: [3, 8, 0, 16], legL: [0, 4, 0], legR: [0, 4, 0] };
const P_GULP: Pose = { ...P_DOWN, head: [19, 0, 0], spine: [5, 0, 0] };
const P_STILL: Pose = { ...P_DOWN, head: [0, 0, 0] };
const P_SURGE: Pose = { spine: [-12, 0, 0], head: [-9, 0, 0], armL: [16, 34, 0, 20], armR: [16, 34, 0, 20], handL: 'open', handR: 'open', legL: [0, 7, 0], legR: [0, 7, 0] };
const P_POWER: Pose = { spine: [-2, 0, 0], head: [-3, 0, 0], armL: [12, 22, 0, 40], armR: [12, 22, 0, 40], handL: 'fist', handR: 'fist', legL: [0, 9, 0], legR: [0, 9, 0] };
const P_CROUCH: Pose = { hipY: -0.36, spine: [48, 0, 0], head: [-36, 0, 0], legL: [70, 5, 105], legR: [-12, 5, 67], armL: [-45, 12, 0, 40], armR: [55, 12, 0, 60], handL: 'fist', handR: 'fist' };
const P_CROUCH_DEEP: Pose = { hipY: -0.4, spine: [56, 0, 0], head: [-42, 0, 0], legL: [78, 5, 108], legR: [-16, 5, 68], armL: [-55, 12, 0, 40], armR: [60, 12, 0, 60], handL: 'fist', handR: 'fist' };

// ---- faces -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const F_CURIOUS: Face = { eyes: 1, look: [-0.75, 0.65], mouth: 0.35, brow: 0.25, browY: 0.25 };
const F_DETERMINED: Face = { eyes: 0.62, brow: -0.75, mouth: 0.6, width: 0.85 };
const F_RUN: Face = { eyes: 0.6, brow: -0.7, mouth: 0.75, open: 0.3, width: 0.9 };

/** Shots A and B share one continuous performance (global time). */
function heroAB(T: number): ActorInShot {
  return {
    id: 'hero', pos: H0, rot: 10,
    pose: P_HOLD,
    poses: [
      { t: E.pillLift, pose: P_MOUTH, blend: 0.28 },
      { t: E.pillIn + 0.04, pose: P_DOWN, blend: 0.3 },
      { t: E.gulp - 0.02, pose: P_GULP, blend: 0.07 },
      { t: E.gulp + 0.1, pose: P_STILL, blend: 0.18 },
      { t: E.surge, pose: P_SURGE, blend: 0.07 },
      { t: E.surge + 0.14, pose: P_POWER, blend: 0.24 },
    ],
    face: F_CURIOUS,
    faces: [
      { t: E.pillLift, face: { eyes: 1, look: [0, -0.15], mouth: 0.2, browY: 0.15 }, blend: 0.12 },
      { t: E.pillLift + 0.13, face: { eyes: 0.9, open: 0.55, mouth: 0.1 }, blend: 0.1 },
      { t: E.pillIn, face: { eyes: 0.9, open: 0, mouth: 0.15 }, blend: 0.06 },
      { t: E.gulp - 0.08, face: { eyes: 0.06, mouth: -0.15 }, blend: 0.06 },
      { t: E.gulp + 0.15, face: { eyes: 1, mouth: 0 }, blend: 0.08 },
      { t: E.surge, face: { eyes: 1.45, pupils: true, open: 0.7, brow: 0.2, browY: 0.6 }, blend: 0.04 },
      { t: E.beat2, face: { eyes: 1.28, pupils: true, open: 0.12, mouth: 0.1, browY: 0.3 }, blend: 0.1 },
      { t: E.smirk, face: F_DETERMINED, blend: 0.12 },
    ],
    hold: T < E.pillIn ? { R: 'pill' } : undefined,
  };
}

function heroC(T: number): ActorInShot {
  return {
    id: 'hero', pos: H0, rot: 90,
    pose: P_POWER,
    poses: [
      { t: E.crouch, pose: P_CROUCH, blend: 0.2 },
      { t: E.launch - 0.09, pose: P_CROUCH_DEEP, blend: 0.08 },
    ],
    face: F_DETERMINED,
    faces: [{ t: E.launch - 0.06, face: { ...F_DETERMINED, eyes: 0.5, mouth: 0.8, open: 0.2 } }],
  };
}

/** Energy level 0..1 after the surge (pulses). */
function energy(T: number) {
  if (T < E.surge) return 0;
  const base = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin((T - E.surge) * 22) * Math.sin((T - E.surge) * 7.3);
  return base * (0.6 + 0.4 * impulse(T, E.surge, 0.25));
}

function applyEnergyLook(T: number) {
  const k = smooth(E.surge, E.surge + 0.12, T);
  const c = new THREE.Color('#f6e7c6').lerp(new THREE.Color(LAVENDER), k);
  setRim([-0.55, 0.8, 0.0], '#' + c.getHexString());
}

function bodyAnchors(s: ActorState): THREE.Vector3[] {
  const b = s.bones;
  return [
    s.anchors.headTop, at(b.head, 0.2, 0.05, 0), at(b.head, -0.2, 0.05, 0), at(b.chest, 0.17, -0.05, 0), at(b.chest, -0.17, -0.05, 0),
    s.anchors.handL, s.anchors.handR, at(b.hips, 0.12, -0.1, 0), at(b.hips, -0.12, -0.1, 0), at(b.shinL), at(b.shinR),
  ];
}

const toScreen = (pts: THREE.Vector3[], cam: CamState): Pt[] => pts.map(p => project(p, cam, W, H)).filter(p => p.visible);

const EnergyFx3D: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; T: number; light?: boolean; headGlow?: number }> = ({ s, T, light = true, headGlow = 0.22 }) => {
  const e = energy(T);
  if (e <= 0) return null;
  const chest = s.anchors.chest;
  return (
    <>
      <Glow p={chest} size={[2.4, 3.0]} color={PURPLE} opacity={0.32 * e} />
      <Glow p={s.anchors.head} size={1.2} color={LAVENDER} opacity={headGlow * e} />
      <Sparks t={T - E.surge} center={chest} n={30} area={[0.38, 0.75, 0.3]} color={LAVENDER} intensity={e} />
      {light && <pointLight position={chest.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.4, 0.7))} color={PURPLE} intensity={1.1 * e} distance={4} decay={2} />}
    </>
  );
};

// ---- shot A + B (continuous performance) --------------------------------------------------
const ShotAB: React.FC<{ T: number; close: boolean; frame: number }> = ({ T, close, frame }) => {
  applyEnergyLook(T);
  const hero = evalActor(heroAB(T), CAST.hero, T, 3.1);
  let cam: CamState;
  if (!close) {
    cam = camAt([
      { t: 0, pos: [0.5, 1.44, -2.15], look: [-0.03, 1.37, -4.6], fov: 30 },
      { t: E.surge, pos: [0.44, 1.45, -2.38], look: [-0.02, 1.38, -4.6], fov: 30, ease: 'inOut' },
      { t: E.surge + 0.12, pos: [0.38, 1.47, -2.62], look: [0, 1.41, -4.6], fov: 30, ease: 'snap' },
      { t: S.A[1], pos: [0.36, 1.48, -2.72], look: [0, 1.42, -4.6], fov: 30, ease: 'out' },
    ], T);
    cam = shake(cam, T, 0.035 * impulse(T, E.surge, 0.22), 22, 2);
  } else {
    const hc = hero.anchors.head;
    cam = camAt([
      { t: S.B[0], pos: [hc.x + 0.2, hc.y - 0.12, hc.z + 0.98], look: [hc.x, hc.y - 0.03, hc.z], fov: 28, roll: 4 },
      { t: S.B[1], pos: [hc.x + 0.12, hc.y - 0.08, hc.z + 0.8], look: [hc.x, hc.y - 0.02, hc.z], fov: 28, roll: -1, ease: 'linear' },
    ], T);
    cam = shake(cam, T, 0.012 + 0.02 * impulse(T, E.beat2, 0.15), 16, 5);
  }
  const anchors = close
    ? [hero.anchors.headTop, at(hero.bones.head, 0.21, 0.05, 0), at(hero.bones.head, -0.21, 0.05, 0), at(hero.bones.head, 0.15, 0.16, 0), at(hero.bones.head, -0.16, -0.12, 0.05)]
    : bodyAnchors(hero);
  const scale = pxPerMetre(hero.anchors.chest, cam, H);
  const e = energy(T);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Stage cam={cam}>
        <Lighting p={PAL} center={[0, 0, -4.6]} shadowBox={10} rim={false} />
        <Suburb centerX={0} behind={60} ahead={80} />
        <Stickman s={hero} faceGlow={T >= E.surge ? '#b98aff' : undefined} />
        <EnergyFx3D s={hero} T={T} headGlow={close ? 0.08 : 0.2} />
      </Stage>
      <Crackles frame={frame} anchors={toScreen(anchors, cam)} center={project(close ? hero.anchors.head : hero.anchors.chest, cam, W, H)} scale={scale} intensity={e * (close ? 1.1 : 1.0)} seed={close ? 7 : 3} color={PURPLE} />
      <Flash t={T} at={E.surge} dur={0.22} color="#b98aff" peak={0.55} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---- shot C: launch ------------------------------------------------------------------------
function launchX(tau: number) {
  if (tau <= 0) return 0;
  const tc = 0.0889; // reaches 160 m/s
  return tau < tc ? 900 * tau * tau : 900 * tc * tc + 160 * (tau - tc);
}

const ShotC: React.FC<{ T: number; frame: number }> = ({ T, frame }) => {
  applyEnergyLook(T);
  const tau = T - E.launch;
  let cam = camAt([
    { t: S.C[0], pos: [-2.4, 0.5, -2.5], look: [2.5, 0.92, -4.85], fov: 34 },
    { t: E.launch, pos: [-2.25, 0.5, -2.55], look: [2.5, 0.93, -4.85], fov: 34, ease: 'linear' },
    { t: E.launch + 0.12, pos: [-2.0, 0.52, -2.62], look: [2.7, 0.95, -4.85], fov: 35, ease: 'snap' },
    { t: S.C[1], pos: [-1.9, 0.53, -2.65], look: [2.8, 0.96, -4.85], fov: 35, ease: 'out' },
  ], T);
  cam = shake(cam, T, 0.008 + 0.07 * impulse(T, E.launch, 0.28), 24, 9);
  const base = evalActor(heroC(T), CAST.hero, T, 3.1);
  const x = launchX(tau);
  const visible = tau < 0.1;
  let hero = base;
  if (tau >= 0) {
    // mid-launch: athletic dash pose leaning hard, placed along the street
    // every launch frame shows a full-extension stride (alternating legs) so he never reads as walking
    const dash = gaitPose('dash', 0.25 + 0.5 * Math.floor(tau * 30 + 1e-6));
    const spec: ActorInShot = { id: 'hero', pos: [H0[0] + x, H0[1], H0[2]], rot: 90, pose: { ...dash, spine: [42, 0, 0], head: [-32, 0, 0], hipY: -0.1 } };
    hero = evalActor(spec, CAST.hero, T, 3.1);
  }
  const ghosts: { st: ActorState; o: number }[] = [];
  if (tau >= 0) {
    const g = (pos: Vec3, pose: Pose, life: number, o0: number) => {
      const o = o0 * (1 - clamp01(tau / life));
      if (o > 0.01) ghosts.push({ st: evalActor({ id: 'hero', pos, rot: 90, pose }, CAST.hero, E.launch, 3.1), o });
    };
    g(H0, resolvePose(P_CROUCH_DEEP), 0.42, 0.4);
    g([H0[0] + 1.0, H0[1], H0[2]], { ...gaitPose('dash', 0.25), spine: [42, 0, 0], hipY: -0.1 }, 0.34, 0.34);
    g([H0[0] + 4.0, H0[1], H0[2]], { ...gaitPose('dash', 0.75), spine: [42, 0, 0], hipY: -0.1 }, 0.26, 0.26);
  }
  const trailOp = tau < 0 ? 0 : Math.pow(1 - clamp01(tau / 0.55), 1.3);
  const headX = Math.min(x, 150);
  const e = energy(T);
  const scale = pxPerMetre(base.anchors.chest, cam, H);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Stage cam={cam}>
        <Lighting p={PAL} center={[4, 0, -4.6]} shadowBox={14} rim={false} />
        <Suburb centerX={20} behind={60} ahead={180} lamps={false} />
        {visible && <Stickman s={hero} faceGlow="#b98aff" />}
        {visible && tau < 0 && <EnergyFx3D s={hero} T={T} />}
        {ghosts.map((g, i) => <Stickman key={i} s={g.st} ghostOpacity={g.o} ghostColor="#b07cff" ghostOrder={20 + i * 2} shadowBlob={false} />)}
        {tau >= 0 && (
          <>
            <Trail from={[H0[0] + 0.3, 1.05, H0[2]]} to={[H0[0] + headX, 1.05, H0[2]]} width={0.6} color={PURPLE} opacity={trailOp} camPos={cam.pos} />
            {!visible && <Glow p={[H0[0] + headX, 1.05, H0[2]]} size={1.6} color={LAVENDER} opacity={0.9 * trailOp} />}
            <Shockwave t={tau} origin={[H0[0] + 0.25, H0[1], H0[2]]} maxR={5.5} dur={0.42} />
            <DustBurst t={tau} origin={[H0[0] + 0.1, H0[1], H0[2]]} dir={[-1.0, 0, -0.2]} spread={1.0} speed={3.6} n={40} size={0.17} seed={21} life={1.0} />
            <DustBurst t={tau - 0.03} origin={[H0[0] + 3.0, H0[1], H0[2]]} dir={[1.4, 0, 0]} spread={0.8} speed={2.6} n={22} size={0.13} seed={33} life={0.85} />
            <DustBurst t={tau - 0.06} origin={[H0[0] + 8.0, H0[1], H0[2]]} dir={[1.4, 0, 0]} spread={0.8} speed={2.4} n={18} size={0.13} seed={45} life={0.8} />
            <Leaves t={tau - 0.03} origin={[H0[0] + 2.5, 0.12, -6.3]} area={[3.5, 0.6, 1.0]} push={[17, 3.6, 1.6]} n={30} seed={8} />
            <Leaves t={tau - 0.02} origin={[H0[0] + 1.0, 0.12, -4.2]} area={[2.0, 0.05, 0.8]} push={[12, 2.2, 0.4]} n={10} seed={19} colors={['#f2efe6', '#e8e1d0', '#e2b23f']} />
            <AirStreaks t={tau} center={[H0[0] + 10, 1.0, H0[2]]} n={14} dir={1} speed={90} area={[10, 0.8, 0.8]} opacity={0.55 * trailOp} />
            {/* distant sonic boom where he breaks the sound barrier */}
            <Shockwave t={tau - 0.12} origin={[H0[0] + 18, H0[1], H0[2]]} maxR={3} dur={0.38} air airAxis="x" />
            <Glow p={[H0[0] + 18, 1.05, H0[2]]} size={3.2} color="#ffffff" opacity={tau > 0.12 ? 0.8 * Math.max(0, 1 - (tau - 0.12) / 0.25) : 0} />
          </>
        )}
      </Stage>
      {tau < 0 && <Crackles frame={frame} anchors={toScreen(bodyAnchors(base), cam)} center={project(base.anchors.chest, cam, W, H)} scale={scale} intensity={e * 1.2} seed={5} color={PURPLE} />}
      <Flash t={T} at={E.launch} dur={0.1} color="#ffffff" peak={0.5} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---- shot D: tracking at speed -------------------------------------------------------------
const X0 = 300, V = 24;
const heroDX = (T: number) => X0 + V * (T - S.D[0]) + (T > E.exit ? 55 * Math.pow(T - E.exit, 2) : 0);

const ShotD: React.FC<{ T: number; frame: number }> = ({ T }) => {
  applyEnergyLook(T);
  const xc = X0 + V * (T - S.D[0]) + 0.55;
  let cam: CamState = { pos: new THREE.Vector3(xc, 1.05, -0.95), look: new THREE.Vector3(xc, 1.0, -4.6), fov: 34, roll: 0 };
  cam = shake(cam, T, 0.018, 9, 13);
  const phase = 0.1 + 3.9 * (T - S.D[0]);
  const runSpec = (x: number, ph: number): ActorInShot => ({ id: 'hero', pos: [x, H0[1], H0[2]], rot: 90, pose: { ...gaitPose('dash', ph) }, face: F_RUN });
  const xh = heroDX(T);
  const hero = evalActor(runSpec(xh, phase), CAST.hero, T, 3.1);
  const ghosts = [1, 2, 3].map(k => ({ st: evalActor(runSpec(xh - 0.58 * k, phase - 0.09 * k), CAST.hero, T, 3.1), o: [0.42, 0.26, 0.13][k - 1] }));
  const flick = 0.85 + 0.15 * noise1(T * 30, 4);
  const trail: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const age = ((T * 2.2 + i / 16) % 1);
    const y = 0.5 + ((i * 37) % 11) / 11 * 1.1;
    trail.push(<mesh key={i} position={[xh - 0.3 - age * 2.4, y, H0[2] + (((i * 53) % 7) / 7 - 0.5) * 0.4]} scale={0.018 * (1 - age)}><sphereGeometry args={[1, 8, 6]} /><meshBasicMaterial color={i % 3 ? LAVENDER : '#ffffff'} toneMapped={false} /></mesh>);
  }
  const hudT = T - E.hud;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <svg width={0} height={0} style={{ position: 'absolute' }}>
        <filter id="hblur" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" colorInterpolationFilters="sRGB">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="46 0.6" edgeMode="duplicate" />
        </filter>
      </svg>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: 'url(#hblur)' }}>
        <Stage cam={cam} dpr={1}>
          <Lighting p={PAL} center={[xc, 0, -4.6]} shadowBox={12} rim={false} />
          <Suburb centerX={xc} behind={50} ahead={60} lamps={false} />
        </Stage>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <SpeedLines t={T} n={30} dir={-1} speed={5600} opacity={0.6} seed={4} band={[0.05, 0.95]} />
      <AbsoluteFill>
        <Stage cam={cam} transparent>
          <Lighting p={PAL} center={[xh, 0, -4.6]} shadowBox={6} sky={false} bg={false} rim={false} />
          <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[xh, H0[1] + 0.003, H0[2]]} receiveShadow>
            <planeGeometry args={[12, 6]} />
            <shadowMaterial transparent opacity={0.32} />
          </mesh>
          {ghosts.map((g, i) => <Stickman key={i} s={g.st} ghostOpacity={g.o} ghostColor="#a978ff" ghostOrder={20 + i * 2} shadowBlob={false} />)}
          <Stickman s={hero} faceGlow="#b98aff" shadowBlob={false} />
          <Glow p={hero.anchors.chest.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(-0.35, 0, 0))} size={[3.2, 2.6]} color={PURPLE} opacity={0.3 * flick} />
          {trail}
        </Stage>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <SpeedLines t={T + 0.37} n={8} dir={-1} speed={7800} opacity={0.5} seed={12} band={[0.1, 0.9]} />
      <StatCallout t={hudT} big={k => `×${Math.max(1, Math.round(1 + 99 * k))}`} small={k => `${Math.round(15 + 1485 * k).toLocaleString('en-US')} KM/H`} x={110} y={90} size={150} />
      <Flash t={T} at={S.D[0]} dur={0.12} color="#ffffff" peak={0.45} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const PillSprint: React.FC<{ withAudio?: boolean }> = ({ withAudio = false }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const T = frame / fps;
  const f = (s: number) => Math.round(s * fps);
  // keep the shared look uniforms sane for any shot
  LOOK.uDesat.value = 0;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundColor: '#000' }}>
      <Sequence from={f(S.A[0])} durationInFrames={f(S.A[1]) - f(S.A[0])}>
        <ShotAB T={T} close={false} frame={frame} />
      </Sequence>
      <Sequence from={f(S.B[0])} durationInFrames={f(S.B[1]) - f(S.B[0])}>
        <ShotAB T={T} close frame={frame} />
      </Sequence>
      <Sequence from={f(S.C[0])} durationInFrames={f(S.C[1]) - f(S.C[0])}>
        <ShotC T={T} frame={frame} />
      </Sequence>
      <Sequence from={f(S.D[0])} durationInFrames={f(S.D[1]) - f(S.D[0])}>
        <ShotD T={T} frame={frame} />
      </Sequence>
      <Grade vignette={0.6} grain={0.03} />
      {withAudio && <Audio src={staticFile('audio/pill_sprint_mix.wav')} />}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// A ThreeCanvas configured for the house look: supersampled, soft shadows, no tone mapping
// (flat toon colours stay exactly as specified), driven by an explicit CamState each frame.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { ThreeCanvas } from '@remotion/three';
import { useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { LOOK } from './materials';
import type { CamState } from './cam';

const CameraRig: React.FC<{ c: CamState }> = ({ c }) => {
  const { camera, size } = useThree();
  const cam = camera as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  cam.fov = c.fov;
  cam.aspect = size.width / size.height;
  cam.near = 0.05;
  cam.far = 900;
  cam.position.copy(c.pos);
  cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
  cam.lookAt(c.look);
  if (c.roll) cam.rotateZ((c.roll * Math.PI) / 180);
  cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  cam.updateMatrixWorld();
  return null;
};

/** Writes the view-space rim direction: from upper-left-behind of the subject, as on IFOLOGY. */
export function setRim(dirView: [number, number, number] = [-0.55, 0.8, 0.0], color?: string, tint?: string, ambient = 0) {
  LOOK.uRimView.value.set(...dirView).normalize();
  if (color) LOOK.uRimColor.value.set(color);
  LOOK.uTint.value.set(tint || '#ffffff');
  LOOK.uRimAmbient.value = ambient;
}

export const Stage: React.FC<{
  cam: CamState; width?: number; height?: number; dpr?: number; transparent?: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties; children?: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ cam, width = 1920, height = 1080, dpr = 2, transparent, style, children }) => (
  <ThreeCanvas
    width={width}
    height={height}
    dpr={dpr}
    shadows="soft"
    flat
    style={style}
    gl={{ antialias: true, alpha: !!transparent, preserveDrawingBuffer: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }}
    camera={{ fov: cam.fov, near: 0.05, far: 900, position: cam.pos.toArray() }}
  >
    <CameraRig c={cam} />
    {children}
  </ThreeCanvas>
);

// The stickman, modelled on the IFOLOGY look: matte black sphere head with a cream crescent,
// tiny line-art face, puffy cel-shaded clothing with thin black contours, stick limbs, mitten hands.
import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { ActorState, FullFace } from './actor';
import { DIM } from './actor';
import { clothMaterial, flat, inkMaterial, outlineMaterial, toon } from './materials';
import { HandProp } from '../sets/props';

const geoCache = new Map<string, THREE.BufferGeometry>();
const memo = (key: string, make: () => THREE.BufferGeometry) => {
  if (!geoCache.has(key)) geoCache.set(key, make());
  return geoCache.get(key)!;
};
const capsule = (len: number, r: number) => memo(`cap|${len.toFixed(3)}|${r.toFixed(3)}`, () => new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r, Math.max(0.001, len), 8, 16));
const sphere = memo('sphere', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28));
const headGeo = memo('head', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(DIM.headR, 64, 48));
const cyl = memo('cyl', () => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 24));

/** Puffy hoodie body: a lathe profile (waist → chest → shoulders → neck), flattened front-to-back.
 *  The upper part rides the spine; the hem part rides the hips so bending never flares it like a bell. */
const lathe = (key: string, pts: number[][]) =>
  memo(key, () => {
    // bottom → top so the lathe faces point outward
    const g = new THREE.LatheGeometry(new THREE.SplineCurve(pts.map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector2(x, y))).getPoints(40), 48);
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });
const hoodieGeo = (len: number) =>
  lathe(`hoodie|${len}`, [
    [0.0, -0.035], [0.15, -0.034], [0.167, 0.0], [0.165, len * 0.45], [0.168, len - 0.16],
    [0.155, len - 0.06], [0.11, len - 0.01], [0.06, len + 0.015], [0.0, len + 0.02],
  ]);
const hemSkirtGeo = lathe('hemSkirt', [[0.0, -0.13], [0.15, -0.128], [0.171, -0.105], [0.17, -0.03], [0.16, 0.06], [0.15, 0.13], [0.0, 0.135]]);
// long coat tails (lab coats) and a flared dress, also riding the hips
const coatTailGeo = lathe('coatTail', [[0.0, -0.5], [0.2, -0.49], [0.215, -0.45], [0.19, -0.2], [0.168, 0.02], [0.15, 0.13], [0.0, 0.135]]);
const dressGeo = lathe('dress', [[0.0, -0.46], [0.28, -0.45], [0.29, -0.42], [0.2, -0.15], [0.16, 0.06], [0.15, 0.13], [0.0, 0.135]]);
const hemGeo = memo('hem', () => new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.16, 12, 48));
/** Trapezoid kangaroo pocket with rounded corners, slightly puffy. */
const pocketGeo = memo('pocket', () => {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  const w0 = 0.075, w1 = 0.1, h = 0.11, r = 0.018;
  s.moveTo(-w1 + r, 0);
  s.lineTo(w1 - r, 0);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(w1, 0, w1, r);
  s.lineTo(w0, h - r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(w0, h, w0 - r, h);
  s.lineTo(-w0 + r, h);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(-w0, h, -w0, h - r);
  s.lineTo(-w1, r);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(-w1, 0, -w1 + r, 0);
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 0.008, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.006, bevelSize: 0.006, bevelSegments: 3, curveSegments: 6 });
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
});
const hoodGeo = memo('hood', () => new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.1, 0.045, 14, 32, Math.PI * 1.15));

type Mat = THREE.Material;

/** Contours are switched off for a whole character (afterimages) through context. */
const OutlineCtx = createContext(true);

/** Mesh plus its inverted-hull contour. */
const O: React.FC<{
  g: THREE.BufferGeometry; m: Mat; p?: [number, number, number]; r?: [number, number, number]; s?: number | [number, number, number];
  outline?: boolean; shadow?: boolean;
}> = ({ g, m, p, r, s, outline = true, shadow = true }) => {
  const allowed = useContext(OutlineCtx);
  return (
    <group position={p} rotation={r} scale={s as never}>
      <mesh geometry={g} material={m} castShadow={shadow && allowed} />
      {outline && allowed && <mesh geometry={g} material={outlineMaterial()} />}
    </group>
  );
};

/** A bone: world transform decomposed into props so three's normal update path applies. */
const Bone: React.FC<{ m: THREE.Matrix4; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ m, children }) => {
  const p = new THREE.Vector3(), q = new THREE.Quaternion(), s = new THREE.Vector3();
  m.decompose(p, q, s);
  return <group position={p} quaternion={q} scale={s}>{children}</group>;
};

/** Segment hanging down from its joint (bone-local -Y). */
const Seg: React.FC<{ len: number; r: number; mat: Mat; from?: number; to?: number; outline?: boolean }> = ({ len, r, mat, from = 0, to = 1, outline = true }) => {
  const l = len * (to - from);
  return <O g={capsule(l, r)} m={mat} p={[0, -len * from - l / 2, 0]} outline={outline} />;
};

// --- face ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const FACE_PHI = (112 * Math.PI) / 180;
const FACE_THETA0 = (38 * Math.PI) / 180;
const FACE_THETA = (104 * Math.PI) / 180;
const faceGeo = memo('face', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(DIM.headR * 1.003, 64, 48, Math.PI / 2 - FACE_PHI / 2, FACE_PHI, FACE_THETA0, FACE_THETA));
const INK = '#fbf3e4';

/** Thin white line-art face, drawn fresh every frame. Canvas units are 0..1 across the face patch. */
function drawFace(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, f: FullFace, mouthOpen: number, glow?: string) {
  const S = ctx.canvas.width;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, S, S);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.scale(S, S);
  ctx.strokeStyle = INK;
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  if (glow) {
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0.02 * S;
  }
  // feature scale around the face centre (thumbnails exaggerate)
  const fs = f.size ?? 1;
  if (fs !== 1) {
    ctx.translate(0.5, 0.55);
    ctx.scale(fs, fs);
    ctx.translate(-0.5, -0.55);
  }
  const lx = (f.look?.[0] ?? 0) * 0.018, ly = (f.look?.[1] ?? 0) * 0.014;
  const eyeY = 0.515 + ly, dx = 0.068;
  const open = Math.max(0, f.eyes);
  const wide = open > 1.12;
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    const cx = 0.5 + side * dx + lx;
    if (open < 0.18) {
      // closed: ∩ when smiling, ‿ otherwise
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.011;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const up = f.mouth > 0.45 ? -1 : 1;
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.024, eyeY + 0.004);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, eyeY + up * 0.026, cx + 0.024, eyeY + 0.004);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (wide) {
      const r = 0.026 + (open - 1.12) * 0.03;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, eyeY - 0.005, r, r * 1.12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (f.pupils) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0d';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx + lx * 0.8, eyeY - 0.003, r * 0.34, r * 0.38, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, eyeY, 0.0145, 0.026 * Math.min(1, open), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    const lid = f.lid ?? 0;
    if (lid > 0.02 && open >= 0.18) {
      // heavy upper lid: cut the top of the eye along a line tilted by the brow (inner end lower when sly)
      const ry = wide ? 0.03 + (open - 1.12) * 0.034 : 0.026 * Math.min(1, open);
      const cut = eyeY - ry + 2 * ry * lid;
      const tilt = side * (f.lidTilt ?? f.brow ?? 0) * 0.012 * (wide ? 1.4 : 1);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 0.06, cut - tilt - 0.2);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 0.06, cut + tilt - 0.2);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 0.06, cut + tilt);
      ctx.lineTo(cx - 0.06, cut - tilt);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (Math.abs(f.brow) > 0.12 || f.browY > 0.1) {
      const by = eyeY - 0.058 - f.browY * 0.03 - (wide ? 0.02 : 0);
      const tilt = f.brow * 0.018;
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.011;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + side * 0.03, by + tilt * 0.4);
      ctx.lineTo(cx - side * 0.022, by - tilt);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    if (f.blush) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,130,150,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx + side * 0.03, eyeY + 0.06, 0.024, 0.012, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (f.tears) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,205,255,0.95)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx + side * 0.012, eyeY + 0.05, 0.008, 0.016, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
  if (f.sweat) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,215,255,0.95)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0.63, 0.43, 0.011, 0.02, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // mouth
  const mx = 0.5 + lx * 0.6, my = 0.6 + ly * 0.5;
  const mw = 0.03 * (f.width ?? 1);
  const curve = f.mouth;
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.011;
  if (mouthOpen > 0.08) {
    const h = 0.008 + mouthOpen * 0.03;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (curve > 0.4) {
      ctx.moveTo(mx - mw * 1.1, my - h * 0.2);
      ctx.lineTo(mx + mw * 1.1, my - h * 0.2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx + mw, my + h * 1.5, mx, my + h * 1.4);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx - mw, my + h * 1.5, mx - mw * 1.1, my - h * 0.2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.ellipse(mx, my + h * 0.2, mw * (0.45 + 0.2 * (1 - mouthOpen)), h, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx - mw, my - curve * 0.01);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx, my + curve * 0.024, mx + mw, my - curve * 0.01);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

const FaceShell: React.FC<{ face: FullFace; mouthOpen: number; glow?: string; opacity?: number }> = ({ face, mouthOpen, glow, opacity = 1 }) => {
  const { tex, ctx } = useMemo(() => {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = 1024;
    const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    t.anisotropy = 8;
    return { tex: t, ctx: c.getContext('2d')! };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => () => tex.dispose(), [tex]);
  drawFace(ctx, face, mouthOpen, glow);
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  return (
    <mesh geometry={faceGeo} renderOrder={2}>
      <meshBasicMaterial map={tex} transparent toneMapped={false} depthWrite={false} opacity={opacity} polygonOffset polygonOffsetFactor={-4} />
    </mesh>
  );
};

// --- clothing -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function shade(hex: string, k: number) {
  const c = new THREE.Color(hex);
  c.multiplyScalar(k);
  return '#' + c.getHexString();
}

const Top: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; ink: Mat; ghost?: Mat }> = ({ s, ink, ghost }) => {
  const c = s.cast;
  const top = c.top ?? 'none';
  const build = c.build ?? 1;
  const L = DIM.torso;
  if (top === 'none') return <O g={capsule(L * 0.8, 0.07 * build)} m={ink} p={[0, L * 0.5, 0]} />;
  const cloth = ghost || clothMaterial(c.topColor || '#6f45b8');
  const trim = ghost || clothMaterial(c.accent || shade(c.topColor || '#6f45b8', 1.35));
  const len = L + 0.02;
  return (
    <group>
      <O g={hoodieGeo(len)} m={cloth} s={[build, 1, 0.74]} />
      {top === 'hoodie' && (
        <>
          {/* hood resting on the shoulders behind the neck */}
          <O g={hoodGeo} m={cloth} p={[0, L - 0.035, -0.045]} r={[Math.PI / 2 + 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 1.075]} s={[build * 0.95, 0.9, 1.0]} />
          {/* drawstrings with tips */}
          {[-1, 1].map(k => (
            <group key={k}>
              <O g={cyl} m={ghost || flat('#f6f2ff')} p={[k * 0.04, L - 0.12, 0.118]} r={[0.1, 0, 0]} s={[0.0055, 0.13, 0.0055]} outline={false} />
              <O g={cyl} m={ghost || flat('#ffffff')} p={[k * 0.04, L - 0.19, 0.125]} r={[0.1, 0, 0]} s={[0.008, 0.02, 0.008]} outline={false} />
            </group>
          ))}
          {/* kangaroo pocket */}
          <O g={pocketGeo} m={ghost || clothMaterial(shade(c.topColor || '#6f45b8', 0.8))} p={[0, 0.0, 0.112]} r={[-0.06, 0, 0]} s={[build, 1, 1]} />
        </>
      )}
      {top === 'jacket' && (
        <O g={memo('placket', () => new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1))} m={ghost || flat(c.accent || '#f4ead6')} p={[0, L * 0.42, 0.122]} s={[0.016, L * 0.86, 0.008]} outline={false} />
      )}
    </group>
  );
};

const HeadGear: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; ink: Mat; ghost?: Mat }> = ({ s, ink, ghost }) => {
  const c = s.cast;
  const r = DIM.headR;
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const hair = c.hair ?? 'none';
  if (hair === 'spiky')
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = -0.8 + (i / 5) * 1.6;
      out.push(<O key={'h' + i} g={memo('cone', () => new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 12))} m={ink} p={[Math.sin(a) * r * 0.62, r * 0.9, -0.04]} r={[-0.5, 0, -a * 0.7]} s={[0.065, 0.2, 0.065]} />);
    }
  if (hair === 'bun') out.push(<O key="bun" g={sphere} m={ink} p={[0, r * 0.7, -r * 0.72]} s={0.1} />);
  if (hair === 'afro') out.push(<O key="afro" g={sphere} m={ink} p={[0, r * 0.15, -r * 0.1]} s={[r * 1.3, r * 1.2, r * 1.22]} />);
  if (hair === 'long' || hair === 'bob') {
    out.push(<O key="hc" g={memo('hairCap', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.06, 48, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.56))} m={ink} p={[0, 0, -0.015]} />);
    const len = hair === 'long' ? 0.4 : 0.18;
    out.push(<O key="hb" g={capsule(len, r * 0.9)} m={ink} p={[0, -len * 0.5, -r * 0.42]} s={[1, 1, 0.55]} />);
  }
  if (hair === 'ponytail') out.push(<O key="pt" g={capsule(0.2, 0.045)} m={ink} p={[0, r * 0.1, -r * 1.12]} r={[0.45, 0, 0]} />);
  if (c.hat === 'cap') {
    const hm = ghost || clothMaterial(c.hatColor || '#f2b632');
    out.push(<O key="cap" g={memo('capDome', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.04, 48, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.43))} m={hm} r={[-0.1, 0, 0]} />);
    out.push(<O key="brim" g={cyl} m={hm} p={[0, r * 0.4, r * 0.84]} r={[0.2, 0, 0]} s={[r * 0.72, 0.016, r * 0.6]} />);
  }
  if (c.hat === 'helmet') {
    // firefighter helmet: tall dome, wide brim that sweeps longer at the back, a cream front shield
    const hm = ghost || clothMaterial(c.hatColor || '#e8b830');
    out.push(<O key="hel" g={memo('helmetDome', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.13, 48, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.47))} m={hm} r={[-0.06, 0, 0]} />);
    out.push(<O key="helBrim" g={cyl} m={hm} p={[0, r * 0.18, -r * 0.2]} r={[-0.1, 0, 0]} s={[r * 1.32, 0.02, r * 1.42]} />);
    out.push(<O key="helShield" g={cyl} m={ghost || flat('#ffd24a')} p={[0, r * 0.78, r * 0.98]} r={[Math.PI / 2 - 0.35, 0, 0]} s={[r * 0.22, 0.02, r * 0.26]} />);
  }
  if (c.hat === 'beanie') out.push(<O key="bn" g={memo('beanie', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.06, 48, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.47))} m={ghost || clothMaterial(c.hatColor || '#6f45b8')} />);
  if (c.hat === 'headband') out.push(<O key="hb2" g={cyl} m={ghost || clothMaterial(c.hatColor || '#c8402f')} p={[0, r * 0.45, 0]} r={[-0.12, 0, 0]} s={[r * 0.93, 0.04, r * 0.93]} />);
  if (c.glasses) {
    // IFOLOGY-style round glasses: tinted lens, white rim, a highlight streak
    const lens = ghost || flat(c.glassesColor || '#8fd0f5', 0.92);
    const rim = ghost || flat('#f4f1ea');
    for (const k of [-1, 1]) {
      const px = k * 0.052, py = -0.008, pz = r * 0.985;
      const ry = k * 0.24;
      out.push(<O key={'gl' + k} g={memo('lensDisc', () => new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 40))} m={lens} p={[px, py, pz]} r={[0, ry, 0]} s={0.04} outline={false} shadow={false} />);
      out.push(<O key={'gr' + k} g={memo('lensRim', () => new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.1, 8, 40))} m={rim} p={[px, py, pz + 0.002]} r={[0, ry, 0]} s={0.041} outline={false} shadow={false} />);
      out.push(<O key={'gh' + k} g={memo('lensHi', () => new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1))} m={ghost || flat('#ffffff', 0.85)} p={[px - 0.008, py + 0.012, pz + 0.004]} r={[0, ry, 0.7]} s={[0.032, 0.006, 1]} outline={false} shadow={false} />);
    }
    out.push(<O key="gb" g={memo('box', () => new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1))} m={rim} p={[0, -0.0, r * 1.0]} s={[0.026, 0.006, 0.006]} outline={false} />);
  }
  if (c.mask) {
    // breathing-apparatus face mask: a tinted visor over the face (features show through), dark rim, respirator
    out.push(<O key="mv" g={memo('maskVisor', () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.07, 40, 20, -Math.PI * 0.32, Math.PI * 0.64, Math.PI * 0.22, Math.PI * 0.5))} m={ghost || flat(c.mask, 0.38)} p={[0, 0, 0]} r={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} outline={false} shadow={false} />);
    out.push(<O key="mr" g={memo('maskRim', () => new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.06, 8, 40))} m={ghost || flat('#2a2d36')} p={[0, -r * 0.05, r * 0.86]} s={[r * 0.62, r * 0.78, r * 0.5]} outline={false} />);
    out.push(<O key="mp" g={cyl} m={ghost || clothMaterial('#3a3f4c')} p={[0, -r * 0.62, r * 0.88]} r={[Math.PI / 2 - 0.4, 0, 0]} s={[r * 0.2, r * 0.22, r * 0.2]} />);
  }
  return <>{out}</>;
};

const Mitten: React.FC<{ kind?: string; ink: Mat; side: 1 | -1 }> = ({ kind, ink, side }) => {
  if (kind === 'point')
    return (
      <group>
        <O g={sphere} m={ink} s={[0.042, 0.045, 0.036]} p={[0, -0.03, 0]} />
        <O g={capsule(0.06, 0.012)} m={ink} p={[0, -0.085, 0.01]} />
      </group>
    );
  const open = kind === 'open';
  return (
    <group>
      <O g={sphere} m={ink} s={open ? [0.05, 0.062, 0.026] : [0.046, 0.05, 0.04]} p={[0, -0.04, 0]} />
      {/* thumb */}
      <O g={capsule(0.03, 0.014)} m={ink} p={[side * -0.005, -0.03, 0.03]} r={[0.9, 0, side * 0.5]} />
    </group>
  );
};

let glowTex: THREE.Texture | null = null;
export function glowTexture() {
  if (glowTex) return glowTex;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 256;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  const grd = g.createRadialGradient(128, 128, 0, 128, 128, 128);
  grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
  grd.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)');
  grd.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
  grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  g.fillStyle = grd;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
  glowTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  return glowTex;
}

const depthOnly = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ colorWrite: false, depthWrite: true, transparent: true });

function ghostMaterial(color: string, opacity: number) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthFunc: THREE.EqualDepth, toneMapped: false,
    uniforms: { uCol: { value: new THREE.Color(color) }, uEdge: { value: new THREE.Color('#f3e9ff') }, uOp: { value: opacity } },
    vertexShader: `varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV;
      void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal); vV = normalize(-mv.xyz); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
    fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uCol; uniform vec3 uEdge; uniform float uOp; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV;
      void main(){ float f = 1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV))); vec3 c = mix(uCol, uEdge, pow(f, 2.2));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, uOp * (0.6 + 0.4 * f)); gl_FragColor = linearToOutputTexel(gl_FragColor); }`,
  });
}

/** Stamp a render order on a whole subtree. three resets the sort group at every nested Group,
 *  so a renderOrder on the outer group alone is not enough. Runs at commit, before the frame renders. */
const orderRef = (order: number) => (g: THREE.Object3D | null) => {
  if (g) g.traverse(o => { o.renderOrder = order; });
};

/** Afterimage: a single clean translucent silhouette — a depth-only pass, then a colour pass that
 *  only draws the front-most surface (EqualDepth), so limbs never show through the torso. */
const Ghost: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; opacity: number; color: string; order: number }> = ({ s, opacity, color, order }) => {
  const mat = useMemo(() => ghostMaterial(color, opacity), [color, opacity]);
  useEffect(() => () => mat.dispose(), [mat]);
  return (
    <>
      <group ref={orderRef(order)}><StickmanBody s={s} ghostMat={depthOnly} /></group>
      <group ref={orderRef(order + 1)}><StickmanBody s={s} ghostMat={mat} /></group>
    </>
  );
};

export const Stickman: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; shadowBlob?: boolean; ghostOpacity?: number; ghostColor?: string; ghostOrder?: number; faceGlow?: string }> = ({ s, shadowBlob = true, ghostOpacity, ghostColor, ghostOrder = 20, faceGlow }) => {
  if (s.spec.ghost || ghostOpacity !== undefined) return <Ghost s={s} opacity={ghostOpacity ?? 0.3} color={ghostColor || s.spec.glow || '#b48cff'} order={ghostOrder} />;
  return <StickmanBody s={s} shadowBlob={shadowBlob} faceGlow={faceGlow} />;
};

const StickmanBody: React.FC<{ s: ActorState; shadowBlob?: boolean; faceGlow?: string; ghostMat?: THREE.Material }> = ({ s, shadowBlob = true, faceGlow, ghostMat }) => {
  const c = s.cast;
  const isGhost = !!ghostMat;
  const ink = ghostMat || inkMaterial();
  const b = s.bones;
  const hasTop = c.top && c.top !== 'none';
  const sleeve = hasTop ? ghostMat || clothMaterial(c.topColor || '#6f45b8') : null;
  const cuff = hasTop ? ghostMat || clothMaterial(c.accent || shade(c.topColor || '#6f45b8', 1.35)) : null;
  const longSleeve = c.top === 'hoodie' || c.top === 'jacket' || c.top === 'coat' || c.top === 'suit';
  const pants = c.bottom && c.bottom !== 'none' ? ghostMat || clothMaterial(c.bottomColor || '#3a2a5c') : null;
  const shoe = ghostMat || (c.shoes ? clothMaterial(c.shoes) : ink);
  const sole = ghostMat || clothMaterial('#ffffff');
  const R = DIM.limbR;
  const ol = !ghostMat;
  const arm = (side: 'L' | 'R') => {
    const up = side === 'L' ? b.upperArmL : b.upperArmR, fo = side === 'L' ? b.forearmL : b.forearmR, ha = side === 'L' ? b.handL : b.handR;
    const kind = side === 'L' ? s.pose.handL : s.pose.handR;
    const held = s.spec.hold?.[side];
    const heldScale = s.spec.hold?.[side === 'L' ? 'scaleL' : 'scaleR'] ?? 1;
    return (
      <group key={side}>
        <Bone m={up}>
          {sleeve ? <Seg len={DIM.upperArm} r={0.054} mat={sleeve} from={0.06} to={c.top === 'tee' ? 0.5 : 1.02} outline={ol} /> : <Seg len={DIM.upperArm} r={R} mat={ink} outline={ol} />}
          {sleeve && c.top === 'tee' && <Seg len={DIM.upperArm} r={R} mat={ink} from={0.5} outline={ol} />}
        </Bone>
        <Bone m={fo}>
          {sleeve && longSleeve ? (
            <>
              <Seg len={DIM.forearm} r={0.05} mat={sleeve} to={0.78} outline={ol} />
              <O g={cyl} m={cuff!} p={[0, -DIM.forearm * 0.8, 0]} s={[0.047, 0.05, 0.047]} outline={ol} />
              <Seg len={DIM.forearm} r={R} mat={ink} from={0.8} outline={ol} />
            </>
          ) : (
            <Seg len={DIM.forearm} r={R} mat={ink} outline={ol} />
          )}
        </Bone>
        <Bone m={ha}>
          <Mitten kind={held ? 'fist' : kind} ink={ink} side={side === 'L' ? 1 : -1} />
          {held && !ghostMat && (heldScale === 1 ? <HandProp type={held} /> : <group scale={heldScale}><HandProp type={held} /></group>)}
        </Bone>
      </group>
    );
  };
  const leg = (side: 'L' | 'R') => {
    const th = side === 'L' ? b.thighL : b.thighR, sh = side === 'L' ? b.shinL : b.shinR, ft = side === 'L' ? b.footL : b.footR;
    return (
      <group key={side}>

          <meshBasicMaterial color="#000" transparent opacity={0.22} depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>
      )}
    </group>
    </OutlineCtx.Provider>
  );
};

// The renderer and the camera solver both use this, so framing always matches what is drawn.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { ActorInShot, CastMember, Gait, Vec3 } from '../types';
import {
  blendFace, blendPose, deg, ease, FACE_BASE, full, gaitPose, GAIT_STRIDE, idleOffset,
  resolveFace, resolvePose, talkOffset, track,

export type FullPose = ReturnType<typeof full>;
export type FullFace = typeof FACE_BASE;

// Skeleton dimensions for an adult (height 1). Kids scale down and get bigger heads.
export const DIM = {
  thigh: 0.43, shin: 0.43, foot: 0.045, torso: 0.46, neck: 0.0, headR: 0.212,
  shoulderW: 0.135, hipW: 0.075, upperArm: 0.31, forearm: 0.29, limbR: 0.03,
};
export const HIP_H = DIM.thigh + DIM.shin + DIM.foot;

export type Bones = {
  root: THREE.Matrix4; hips: THREE.Matrix4; chest: THREE.Matrix4; spine: THREE.Matrix4; head: THREE.Matrix4;
  upperArmL: THREE.Matrix4; forearmL: THREE.Matrix4; handL: THREE.Matrix4;
  upperArmR: THREE.Matrix4; forearmR: THREE.Matrix4; handR: THREE.Matrix4;
  thighL: THREE.Matrix4; shinL: THREE.Matrix4; footL: THREE.Matrix4;
  thighR: THREE.Matrix4; shinR: THREE.Matrix4; footR: THREE.Matrix4;
};

export type ActorState = {
  spec: ActorInShot;
  cast: CastMember;
  pos: Vec3;
  rot: number; // degrees
  scale: number;
  headScale: number;
  pose: FullPose;
  face: FullFace;
  mouthOpen: number;
  moving: boolean;
  speed: number;
  bones: Bones;
  anchors: Record<'head' | 'headTop' | 'chest' | 'hips' | 'handL' | 'handR' | 'feet', THREE.Vector3>;
};

const T = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(x, y, z);
const R = (x: number, y: number, z: number, order: THREE.EulerOrder = 'XYZ') =>
  new THREE.Matrix4().makeRotationFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(deg(x), deg(y), deg(z), order));
const mul = (...ms: THREE.Matrix4[]) => ms.reduce((a, b) => a.clone().multiply(b));

export function skeleton(pos: Vec3, rot: number, scale: number, headScale: number, p: FullPose): Bones {
  const root = mul(T(...pos), R(0, rot, 0), new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(scale, scale, scale));
  const hips = mul(root, T(0, HIP_H + p.hipY, 0), R(p.body[0], p.body[1], p.body[2]));
  const spine = mul(hips, R(p.spine[0], p.spine[2], -p.spine[1], 'YXZ'));
  const chest = mul(spine, T(0, DIM.torso, 0));
  const head = mul(chest, T(0, DIM.neck, 0), R(p.head[0], p.head[1], -p.head[2], 'YXZ'),
    new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(headScale, headScale, headScale), T(0, DIM.headR * 0.84, 0));

    const upper = mul(chest, T(side * DIM.shoulderW, -0.035, 0), R(-a[0], side * a[2], side * a[1], 'XZY'));
    const fore = mul(upper, T(0, -DIM.upperArm, 0), R(-a[3], 0, 0));
    const hand = mul(fore, T(0, -DIM.forearm, 0));
    return [upper, fore, hand];
  };
  const leg = (side: 1 | -1, l: number[]) => {
    const thigh = mul(hips, T(side * DIM.hipW, 0, 0), R(-l[0], 0, side * l[1], 'XZY'));
    const shin = mul(thigh, T(0, -DIM.thigh, 0), R(l[2], 0, 0));
    const foot = mul(shin, T(0, -DIM.shin, 0));

  const [upperArmR, forearmR, handR] = arm(-1, p.armR);

// --- two-bone arm IK ------------------------------------------------------------------------
const LANDMARK: Record<string, { bone: 'head' | 'chest' | 'hips'; p: [number, number, number] }> = {

  mouth: { bone: 'head', p: [0, -0.165, DIM.headR + 0.075] },
  chin: { bone: 'head', p: [0, -0.17, DIM.headR - 0.02] },
  face: { bone: 'head', p: [0, -0.06, DIM.headR + 0.07] },
  forehead: { bone: 'head', p: [0, 0.02, DIM.headR + 0.06] },
  temple: { bone: 'head', p: [0.17, -0.02, 0.1] },
  chest: { bone: 'chest', p: [0, -0.2, 0.2] },
  heart: { bone: 'chest', p: [0.06, -0.16, 0.19] },
  hip: { bone: 'hips', p: [0.2, 0.02, 0.02] },
  pocket: { bone: 'hips', p: [0.0, 0.08, 0.2] },
};

/** Replace armL/armR angles with IK solutions for any reachL/reachR in the pose. */
export function withReach(p: FullPose): FullPose {
  if (!p.reachL && !p.reachR) return p;
  const b = skeleton([0, 0, 0], 0, 1, 1, p);
  const out = { ...p };
  for (const side of [1, -1] as const) {
    const r = side === 1 ? p.reachL : p.reachR;
    if (!r) continue;
    let target: THREE.Vector3;
    if (Array.isArray(r.to)) target = new THREE.Vector3(...r.to);
    else {
      const lm = LANDMARK[r.to];
      const m = lm.bone === 'head' ? b.head : lm.bone === 'chest' ? b.chest : b.hips;
      // landmarks on the side (temple, hip, heart) mirror for the right hand
      const x = r.to === 'temple' || r.to === 'hip' || r.to === 'heart' ? lm.p[0] * side : lm.p[0];
      target = new THREE.Vector3(x, lm.p[1], lm.p[2]).applyMatrix4(m);
    }
    if (r.offset) target.add(new THREE.Vector3(...r.offset));
    const arm = solveArm(side, b.chest, target, r.pole);
    if (side === 1) out.armL = arm;
    else out.armR = arm;
  }
  return out;
}

function solveArm(side: 1 | -1, chest: THREE.Matrix4, targetRoot: THREE.Vector3, pole?: Vec3): [number, number, number, number] {
  const inv = chest.clone().invert();
  const T = targetRoot.clone().applyMatrix4(inv); // chest-local
  const S = new THREE.Vector3(side * DIM.shoulderW, -0.035, 0);
  const a = DIM.upperArm, bl = DIM.forearm;
  const dv = T.clone().sub(S);
  const d = Math.min(a + bl - 1e-3, Math.max(Math.abs(a - bl) + 1e-3, dv.length()));
  const tHat = dv.clone().normalize();
  const pv = new THREE.Vector3(...(pole || [side * 0.45, -0.6, -0.35])).normalize();
  const pPerp = pv.clone().sub(tHat.clone().multiplyScalar(pv.dot(tHat)));
  if (pPerp.lengthSq() < 1e-6) pPerp.set(0, -1, 0);
  pPerp.normalize();
  const alpha = Math.acos(THREE.MathUtils.clamp((a * a + d * d - bl * bl) / (2 * a * d), -1, 1));
  const u = tHat.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(alpha)).add(pPerp.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.sin(alpha))).normalize();
  const E = S.clone().add(u.clone().multiplyScalar(a));
  const f = S.clone().add(tHat.clone().multiplyScalar(d)).sub(E).normalize();
  const elbow = (Math.acos(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(u.dot(f), -1, 1)) * 180) / Math.PI;
  let w = f.clone().sub(u.clone().multiplyScalar(f.dot(u)));
  if (w.lengthSq() < 1e-6) w = pPerp.clone().multiplyScalar(-1);
  w.normalize();
  const Y = u.clone().multiplyScalar(-1);
  const X = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(Y, w).normalize();
  const Z = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(X, Y).normalize();
  const m = new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(X, Y, Z);
  const e = new THREE.Euler().setFromRotationMatrix(m, 'XZY');

}
export const at = (m: THREE.Matrix4, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).applyMatrix4(m);

function hash(n: number) {
  const x = Math.sin(n * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453;
  return x - Math.floor(x);
}

function angleLerp(a: number, b: number, k: number) {
  let d = ((b - a + 540) % 360) - 180;
  return a + d * k;
}

/** Position, heading and gait phase along the waypoint path. */
function locomotion(a: ActorInShot, t: number) {
  const base: Vec3 = a.pos || [0, 0, 0];
  const path = a.path;
  if (!path || path.length === 0) return { pos: base, rot: a.rot ?? 0, moving: false, gait: 'walk' as Gait, dist: 0, speed: 0, w: 0 };
  const pts = path[0].t > 0 || !a.pos ? path : [{ t: 0, pos: base }, ...path];

  }
  let dist = 0;
  let prevHeading = a.rot ?? headingOf(pts[0].pos, pts[1]?.pos) ?? 0;
  let moveStart = -1; // when the actor (re)starts moving: the gait eases in from there
  let prevSeg = 0;
  let wEnd = 0; // gait weight left when the previous segment ended (a stop leaves a short stride to settle)
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i], p1 = pts[i + 1];
    const seg = Math.hypot(p1.pos[0] - p0.pos[0], p1.pos[2] - p0.pos[2]);
    if (seg > 0.01 && (moveStart < 0 || prevSeg <= 0.01)) moveStart = p0.t;
    const p2 = pts[i + 2];
    const stopping = seg > 0.01 && (!p2 || Math.hypot(p2.pos[0] - p1.pos[0], p2.pos[2] - p1.pos[2]) <= 0.01); // decelerating into a stop or a hold
    const heading = seg > 0.01 ? headingOf(p0.pos, p1.pos)! : prevHeading;
    const gait = (p1 as { gait?: Gait }).gait || a.gait || 'walk';
    if (t < p1.t) {
      const k = (t - p0.t) / Math.max(1e-3, p1.t - p0.t);
      // ease in at the first segment's start and out at the last segment's end
      const first = i === 0, last = i === pts.length - 2;
      const kk = first && last ? ease(k) * 0.5 + k * 0.5 : first ? k * k * 0.3 + k * 0.7 : last ? 1 - (1 - k) * (1 - k) * 0.3 - (1 - k) * 0.7 : k;
      const pos: Vec3 = [p0.pos[0] + (p1.pos[0] - p0.pos[0]) * kk, p0.pos[1] + (p1.pos[1] - p0.pos[1]) * kk, p0.pos[2] + (p1.pos[2] - p0.pos[2]) * kk];
      const turnK = Math.min(1, (t - p0.t) / 0.25);
      const rot = angleLerp(prevHeading, heading, ease(turnK));
      const speed = seg / Math.max(1e-3, p1.t - p0.t);
      // gait weight: eases in on a (re)start, shrinks the stride while braking, fades out during a hold
      let w = seg <= 0.01 ? wEnd * Math.max(0, 1 - (t - p0.t) / 0.2) : moveStart >= 0 ? Math.min(1, (t - moveStart) / 0.22) : 1;
      if (stopping) w = Math.min(w, 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.min(1, (p1.t - t) / 0.3));
      return { pos, rot: a.strafe ? a.rot ?? 0 : rot, moving: seg > 0.01, gait, dist: dist + seg * kk, speed, w };
    }
    wEnd = seg > 0.01 ? (stopping ? 0.35 : 1) : wEnd * Math.max(0, 1 - (p1.t - p0.t) / 0.2);
    prevSeg = seg;
    dist += seg;

  const lastP = pts[pts.length - 1];
  const endRot = (lastP as { rot?: number }).rot ?? prevHeading;
  const since = t - lastP.t;
  const rot = angleLerp(prevHeading, endRot, ease(Math.min(1, since / 0.35)));
  return { pos: lastP.pos, rot: a.strafe ? a.rot ?? 0 : rot, moving: false, gait: (lastP as { gait?: Gait }).gait || a.gait || 'walk' as Gait, dist, speed: 0, w: wEnd * Math.max(0, 1 - since / 0.2) };

function headingOf(a: Vec3, b?: Vec3): number | undefined {
  if (!b) return undefined;
  const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[2] - a[2];

function talkWeight(talk: [number, number][] | undefined, t: number) {
  let w = 0;
  for (const [s, e] of talk || []) {
    if (t < s - 0.15 || t > e + 0.15) continue;
    w = Math.max(w, Math.min(1, (t - s + 0.15) / 0.3, (e + 0.15 - t) / 0.3));

  return Math.max(0, w);
}

/**
 * Evaluate an actor at shot time `t`. `clock` (default t) drives the always-on motion — breathing,
 * blinks, talk gestures — so pass absolute episode time to keep it continuous across shot boundaries.
 */
export function evalActor(
  a: ActorInShot, cast: CastMember, t: number, seed: number,
  lookAt?: (target: string | Vec3) => THREE.Vector3 | undefined,
  clock: number = t,
): ActorState {
  const height = cast.height ?? 1;
  const scale = (a.scale ?? 1) * height;
  const headScale = height < 1 ? 1 + (1 - height) * 0.75 : 1;
  const loco = locomotion(a, t);

  // keyframed pose track
  // pose transitions never shorter than 0.1 s (3 frames), so nothing pops in a single frame
  const poseKeys = [{ t: -1, v: withReach(resolvePose(a.pose)), blend: 0 }, ...(a.poses || []).map(k => ({ t: k.t, v: withReach(resolvePose(k.pose)), blend: Math.max(0.1, k.blend ?? 0.35) }))];
  let pose = track(poseKeys, t, blendPose);
  const sitting = pose.hipY < -0.3 || Math.abs(pose.body[0]) > 45;

  // locomotion cycle overrides the body while moving, blending out at the end ('carried' keeps the keyed pose)
  if (loco.w > 0 && loco.gait !== 'carried') {
    const g = loco.gait;
    const phase = loco.dist / GAIT_STRIDE[g];
    const gp = gaitPose(g, phase);
    pose = blendPose(pose, gp, ease(Math.min(1, loco.w)));
  }

  pose = idleOffset(pose, clock, seed, loco.moving ? 0 : sitting ? 0.5 : 1);
  const talkW = loco.moving ? 0 : talkWeight(a.talk, t);
  if (talkW > 0) pose = blendPose(pose, talkOffset(pose, clock, seed), talkW);

  // face track + blink
  const faceKeys = [{ t: -1, v: resolveFace(a.face), blend: 0 }, ...(a.faces || []).map(k => ({ t: k.t, v: resolveFace(k.face), blend: k.blend ?? 0.15 }))];
  const face = { ...track(faceKeys, t, blendFace, 0.15) };
  const blinkPeriod = 3.2 + hash(seed) * 2.2;
  const bp = (clock + hash(seed + 1) * blinkPeriod) % blinkPeriod;
  if (bp < 0.13 && face.eyes > 0.2) face.eyes *= 0.08;
  let mouthOpen = face.open;
  if (talkW > 0) mouthOpen = Math.max(mouthOpen, talkW * (0.15 + 0.35 * Math.abs(Math.sin(clock * 11 + seed) * Math.sin(clock * 4.3))));

  // head look-at (turn + nod), spills into the spine past 60°
  if (a.look && lookAt) {
    const target = lookAt(a.look);
    if (target) {
      const pre = skeleton(loco.pos, loco.rot, scale, headScale, pose);
      const headPos = at(pre.head);
      const d = target.clone().sub(headPos);
      const yawWorld = (Math.atan2(d.x, d.z) * 180) / Math.PI;
      let rel = ((yawWorld - loco.rot - pose.spine[2] + 540) % 360) - 180;
      rel = Math.max(-110, Math.min(110, rel));
      const headTurn = Math.max(-65, Math.min(65, rel));
      const spill = rel - headTurn;
      const pitch = (-Math.atan2(d.y, Math.hypot(d.x, d.z)) * 180) / Math.PI;
      pose = {
        ...pose,
        head: [Math.max(-35, Math.min(40, pitch - pose.spine[0] * 0.5)) + pose.head[0] * 0.3, headTurn, pose.head[2]],
        spine: [pose.spine[0], pose.spine[1], pose.spine[2] + spill * 0.8],
      };
    }
  }

  return composeState(a, cast, loco.pos, loco.rot, scale, headScale, pose, face, mouthOpen, loco.moving, loco.speed);
}

/** Build a full ActorState (bones + anchors) from a pose; used directly to blend across shots. */
export function composeState(
  a: ActorInShot, cast: CastMember, pos: Vec3, rot: number, scale: number, headScale: number,
  pose: FullPose, face: FullFace, mouthOpen: number, moving = false, speed = 0,
): ActorState {
  const bones = skeleton(pos, rot, scale, headScale, pose);
  const r = DIM.headR;
  return {
    spec: a, cast, pos, rot, scale, headScale, pose, face, mouthOpen, moving, speed, bones,
    anchors: {
      head: at(bones.head),
      headTop: at(bones.head, 0, r * 1.15, 0),
      chest: at(bones.chest, 0, -0.12, 0),
      hips: at(bones.hips),
      handL: at(bones.handL),
      handR: at(bones.handR),
      feet: new THREE.Vector3(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]),
    },
  };
}

/** Blend two states of the same actor (shot-to-shot continuity). */
export function blendStates(a: ActorState, b: ActorState, k: number): ActorState {
  const pos: Vec3 = [a.pos[0] + (b.pos[0] - a.pos[0]) * k, a.pos[1] + (b.pos[1] - a.pos[1]) * k, a.pos[2] + (b.pos[2] - a.pos[2]) * k];
  const d = ((b.rot - a.rot + 540) % 360) - 180;
  return composeState(b.spec, b.cast, pos, a.rot + d * k, b.scale, b.headScale, blendPose(a.pose, b.pose, k), blendFace(a.face, b.face, k), a.mouthOpen + (b.mouthOpen - a.mouthOpen) * k, b.moving, b.speed);
}

export { P0 };

// Keyframed cameras, smooth shake, and 3D→2D projection for overlays.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';

export type CamKey = { t: number; pos: Vec3; look: Vec3; fov?: number; roll?: number; ease?: keyof typeof EASE };
export type CamState = { pos: THREE.Vector3; look: THREE.Vector3; fov: number; roll: number };

const EASE = {
  linear: (x: number) => x,
  inOut: (x: number) => (x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2),
  in: (x: number) => x * x * x,
  out: (x: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 3),
  snap: (x: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 6),
  // trapezoid speed: short ramp up, constant cruise, short ramp down (pans that track a mover)
  cruise: (x: number) => {
    const r = 0.15, v = 1 / (1 - r);
    return x < r ? (v * x * x) / (2 * r) : x < 1 - r ? v * (x - r / 2) : 1 - (v * (1 - x) * (1 - x)) / (2 * r);
  },
};

export function camAt(keys: CamKey[], t: number): CamState {
  let a = keys[0], b = keys[0], k = 0;
  if (t <= keys[0].t) a = b = keys[0];
  else if (t >= keys[keys.length - 1].t) a = b = keys[keys.length - 1];
  else
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length - 1; i++)
      if (t >= keys[i].t && t < keys[i + 1].t) {
        a = keys[i];
        b = keys[i + 1];
        k = EASE[b.ease || 'inOut']((t - a.t) / (b.t - a.t));
      }
  const lerp = (x: Vec3, y: Vec3) => new THREE.Vector3(x[0] + (y[0] - x[0]) * k, x[1] + (y[1] - x[1]) * k, x[2] + (y[2] - x[2]) * k);
  return {
    pos: lerp(a.pos, b.pos),
    look: lerp(a.look, b.look),
    fov: (a.fov ?? 32) + ((b.fov ?? 32) - (a.fov ?? 32)) * k,
    roll: (a.roll ?? 0) + ((b.roll ?? 0) - (a.roll ?? 0)) * k,
  };
}

// Smooth value noise (deterministic).
function hash(n: number) {
  const x = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453;
  return x - Math.floor(x);
}
export function noise1(x: number, seed = 0) {
  const i = Math.floor(x), f = x - i;
  const u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f);
  return (hash(i + seed * 101.3) * (1 - u) + hash(i + 1 + seed * 101.3) * u) * 2 - 1;
}

/** Add shake: `amp` metres of positional jitter (look point gets half), `freq` Hz. */
export function shake(c: CamState, t: number, amp: number, freq = 18, seed = 1): CamState {
  if (amp <= 0) return c;
  const o = new THREE.Vector3(noise1(t * freq, seed), noise1(t * freq, seed + 1), noise1(t * freq, seed + 2)).multiplyScalar(amp);
  return { ...c, pos: c.pos.clone().add(o), look: c.look.clone().add(o.clone().multiplyScalar(0.5)), roll: c.roll + noise1(t * freq * 0.7, seed + 3) * amp * 8 };
}

/** Exponential decay envelope for impacts: 1 at t0, decaying with `tau` seconds. */
export function impulse(t: number, t0: number, tau = 0.25) {
  return t < t0 ? 0 : Math.exp(-(t - t0) / tau);
}

export function makeCamera(c: CamState, aspect: number) {
  const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(c.fov, aspect, 0.05, 900);
  cam.position.copy(c.pos);
  cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
  cam.lookAt(c.look);
  if (c.roll) cam.rotateZ((c.roll * Math.PI) / 180);
  cam.updateMatrixWorld();
  cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  return cam;
}

/** Project a world point to pixel coordinates of a W×H frame. z>1 means behind the camera. */
export function project(p: THREE.Vector3, c: CamState, W: number, H: number) {
  const cam = makeCamera(c, W / H);
  const v = p.clone().project(cam);
  return { x: (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * W, y: (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * H, z: v.z, visible: v.z < 1 && v.z > -1 };
}

/** Pixel size of a world-space length at a point (for sizing 2D overlays). */
export function pxPerMetre(p: THREE.Vector3, c: CamState, H: number) {
  const d = p.distanceTo(c.pos);
  return H / (2 * d * Math.tan((c.fov * Math.PI) / 360));
}
