// Single source of truth for "what is where" in an episode shot at time t: actors (marks, word
// cues, swap power, continuity blending), camera (solver, shake, flow across near-identical cuts)
// and props. The renderer (ShotView), the scene audit, the self-tests and the review overlay all
// call evalShot, so what gets checked is exactly what gets drawn.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { blendStates, evalActor, type ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { project, pxPerMetre, shake, type CamState } from '../engine/cam';
import { ease } from '../engine/rig';
import { SETS, type SetDef } from '../sets';
import type { ActorInShot, CastMember, PropSpec, Shot3D, Vec3 } from '../types';
import { solveCamera } from './camsolve';
import { cue, type Words } from './cue';
import { place, resolveActor } from './resolve';

const W = 1920, H = 1080;

export type ShotCtx = { shot: Shot3D; dur: number; start: number; words?: Words };
export type SwapInfo = { t: number; ids: [string, string]; keepPaths?: boolean; pre: [ActorInShot, ActorInShot] };
export type FlowInfo = { on: boolean; camBlend: number; actorBlend: number; reason: string; screenShift?: number; angle?: number; scale?: number };
export type SceneState = {
  setKey: string;
  def: SetDef;
  palKey: string;
  actors: ActorInShot[];
  states: ActorState[];
  byId: Record<string, ActorState>;
  cam: CamState;
  swap?: SwapInfo;
  frozen: boolean;
  props: PropSpec[];
  flow?: FlowInfo;
  camOut: number; // metres the camera was pulled back inside the room walls (0 = it was inside)
};

/** Stable per-character seed, so breathing/blinks don't jump when the same character is in the next shot. */
export function seedOf(id: string, dup = 0) {
  let h = 7;
  for (const c of id) h = (h * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 100003;
  return (h % 997) * 0.37 + dup * 5.1;
}

/** Resolve marks + word cues, then apply the swap power. Swapper = swap.ids[0]. */
export function resolveShotActors(shot: Shot3D, t: number, words: Words, setKey: string): { actors: ActorInShot[]; swap?: SwapInfo } {
  let actors = (shot.actors || []).filter(a => !a.hidden).map(a => resolveActor({
    ...a,
    poses: a.poses?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
    faces: a.faces?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
    path: a.path?.map(w => ({ ...w, t: cue(w.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
  }, setKey));
  const sw = shot.fx?.swap;
  if (!sw) return { actors };
  const st = cue(sw.t, words, 0.5);
  const i0 = actors.findIndex(a => a.id === sw.ids[0]);
  const i1 = actors.findIndex(a => a.id === sw.ids[1]);
  if (i0 < 0 || i1 < 0) return { actors };
  const pre: [ActorInShot, ActorInShot] = [actors[i0], actors[i1]];
  const blink = (eyes: number) => ({ eyes, brow: -0.35, mouth: 0.35 });
  actors = actors.map((a, i) => {
    if (i === i0) {
      const faces = [...(a.faces || []), { t: st - 0.42, face: blink(0.05), blend: 0.04 }, { t: st - 0.31, face: blink(1), blend: 0.04 },
        { t: st - 0.2, face: blink(0.05), blend: 0.04 }, { t: st - 0.09, face: blink(1), blend: 0.04 }];
      return t >= st && !sw.keepPaths ? { ...a, faces, pos: pre[1].pos, rot: pre[1].rot, path: undefined } : { ...a, faces };
    }
    if (i === i1 && t >= st && !sw.keepPaths) return { ...a, pos: pre[0].pos, rot: pre[0].rot, path: undefined };
    return a;
  });
  return { actors, swap: { t: st, ids: sw.ids, keepPaths: sw.keepPaths, pre } };
}

/** Interpolate cameras by orbiting around a moving look point (never cuts through the subject). */
export function orbitBlend(a: CamState, b: CamState, k: number): CamState {
  const look = a.look.clone().lerp(b.look, k);
  const oa = a.pos.clone().sub(a.look), ob = b.pos.clone().sub(b.look);
  const ra = Math.max(1e-3, oa.length()), rb = Math.max(1e-3, ob.length());
  const ya = Math.atan2(oa.x, oa.z), yb = Math.atan2(ob.x, ob.z);
  let dy = yb - ya;
  while (dy > Math.PI) dy -= 2 * Math.PI;
  while (dy < -Math.PI) dy += 2 * Math.PI;
  const pa = Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(oa.y / ra, -1, 1)), pb = Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(ob.y / rb, -1, 1));
  const r = ra * Math.pow(rb / ra, k), yaw = ya + dy * k, pitch = pa + (pb - pa) * k;
  const pos = look.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch), Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch)).multiplyScalar(r));
  return { pos, look, fov: a.fov + (b.fov - a.fov) * k, roll: a.roll + (b.roll - a.roll) * k };
}

/** How different two framings look on screen: mean subject shift (fraction of width), view angle, scale ratio. */
export function framingDelta(a: CamState, b: CamState, points: THREE.Vector3[]) {
  const pts = points.length ? points : [a.look, b.look];
  let shift = 0, n = 0;
  for (const p of pts) {
    const pa = project(p, a, W, H), pb = project(p, b, W, H);
    if (!pa.visible && !pb.visible) continue;
    // a point only visible in one framing counts as fully different
    shift += pa.visible && pb.visible ? Math.min(1, Math.hypot(pa.x - pb.x, pa.y - pb.y) / W) : 1;
    n++;
  }
  const da = a.look.clone().sub(a.pos).normalize(), db = b.look.clone().sub(b.pos).normalize();
  const angle = (Math.acos(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(da.dot(db), -1, 1)) * 180) / Math.PI;
  const ref = pts[0];
  const scale = pxPerMetre(ref, b, H) / Math.max(1e-6, pxPerMetre(ref, a, H));
  return { shift: n ? shift / n : 1, angle, scale };
}

const rot0Cache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, Record<string, number>>();

/** Actors' facing at t=0 (cached per shot). Cameras orient on this so a swap/turn never flips the camera. */
function rotAtStart(ctx: ShotCtx, cast: Record<string, CastMember>, now: Record<string, ActorState>, t: number): Record<string, number> {
  let r = rot0Cache.get(ctx.shot);
  if (r) return r;
  if (t === 0) r = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(now).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.rot]));
  else {
    const setKey = SETS[ctx.shot.set] ? ctx.shot.set : 'suburb';
    const { actors } = resolveShotActors(ctx.shot, 0, ctx.words, setKey);
    r = {};
    actors.forEach(a => { if (!(a.id in r!)) r![a.id] = evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, 0, seedOf(a.id), undefined, ctx.start).rot; });
  }
  rot0Cache.set(ctx.shot, r);
  return r;
}

const flowCache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, FlowInfo>();

/**
 * Decide whether the cut from `prev` into `cur` should play as one continuous camera move.
 * Same set + same lighting + the framings barely differ on screen = a "jump cut" → flow.
 * Real angle changes stay cuts. `cut: "flow"` forces flow; any other explicit cut type forces a cut.
 */
export function flowInfo(prev: ShotCtx, cur: ShotCtx, cast: Record<string, CastMember>): FlowInfo {
  const cached = flowCache.get(cur.shot);
  if (cached) return cached;
  let info: FlowInfo;
  const sameSet = prev.shot.set === cur.shot.set && (prev.shot.time || '') === (cur.shot.time || '');
  if (!sameSet) info = { on: false, camBlend: 0, actorBlend: 0, reason: 'different set/lighting' };
  else if (cur.shot.cut && cur.shot.cut !== 'flow') info = { on: false, camBlend: 0, actorBlend: 0, reason: `explicit ${cur.shot.cut}` };
  else {
    const a = evalShot(prev, prev.dur, cast);
    const b = evalShot(cur, 0, cast);
    // measure on characters present in both shots (the subject the eye tracks across the cut)
    const common = b.states.filter(s => a.byId[s.spec.id]);
    const pts = common.length ? [...common.map(s => a.byId[s.spec.id].anchors.head), ...common.map(s => s.anchors.head)] : [];
    const d = framingDelta(a.cam, b.cam, pts);
    const jump = d.shift < 0.14 && d.angle < 20 && d.scale > 0.78 && d.scale < 1.28;
    const force = cur.shot.cut === 'flow';
    const on = force || jump;
    info = {
      on,
      camBlend: on ? THREE.MathUtils.clamp(0.5 + d.shift * 3 + d.angle / 40 + Math.abs(Math.log(d.scale)) * 1.2, 0.5, force ? 1.6 : 1.1) : 0,
      actorBlend: on ? 0.45 : 0,
      reason: force ? 'cut: flow' : jump ? 'near-identical framing (jump cut) → continuous move' : 'different view → cut',
      screenShift: +d.shift.toFixed(3), angle: +d.angle.toFixed(1), scale: +d.scale.toFixed(2),
    };
  }
  flowCache.set(cur.shot, info);
  return info;
}

/** Pull a camera that ended up behind a wall / under the floor / above the ceiling back inside the
 *  room along its sight line (keeps the direction, tightens the framing). Returns how far it moved. */
function keepInRoom(cam: CamState, room: { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 }, m = 0.15): number {
  const L = cam.look, P = cam.pos;
  let s = 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const l = L.getComponent(k), p = P.getComponent(k), d = p - l;
    const lo = room.min[k] + m, hi = room.max[k] - m;
    if (p < lo && d < 0) s = Math.min(s, (lo - l) / d);
    if (p > hi && d > 0) s = Math.min(s, (hi - l) / d);
  }
  if (s >= 1) return 0;
  s = Math.max(0.05, s);
  const moved = P.distanceTo(L) * (1 - s);
  cam.pos = L.clone().add(P.clone().sub(L).multiplyScalar(s));
  return moved;
}

export function evalShot(ctx: ShotCtx, t: number, cast: Record<string, CastMember>, prev?: ShotCtx): SceneState {
  const { shot, dur, words } = ctx;
  const def = SETS[shot.set] || SETS.suburb;
  const setKey = SETS[shot.set] ? shot.set : 'suburb';
  const palKey = shot.time || def.palette;
  const clock = ctx.start + t;
  const { actors, swap } = resolveShotActors(shot, t, words, setKey);
  const dup: Record<string, number> = {};
  const seeds = actors.map(a => { const n = dup[a.id] = (dup[a.id] ?? -1) + 1; return seedOf(a.id, n); });
  // pass 1: bodies without head look-at, so the camera can frame them
  const first: Record<string, ActorState> = {};
  actors.forEach((a, i) => { const k = first[a.id] ? `${a.id}#${i}` : a.id; first[k] = evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, t, seeds[i], undefined, clock); });
  const fallback: Vec3 = def.marks.center || Object.values(def.marks)[0] || [0, 0, 0];
  const camSpec = shot.camera && (shot.camera.moveAt || shot.camera.path) ? {
    ...shot.camera,
    moveAt: shot.camera.moveAt?.map(x => cue(x, words, 0)) as [number, number] | undefined,
    path: shot.camera.path?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t, words, 0) })),
  } : shot.camera;
  let cam = solveCamera(camSpec, t, dur, first, fallback, rotAtStart(ctx, cast, first, t));
  const camOut = def.room ? keepInRoom(cam, def.room) : 0;
  if (shot.fx?.shake) cam = shake(cam, t, 0.03 * shot.fx.shake, 18, 4);
  // continuity with the previous shot (same set, near-identical framing): one flowing move
  const flow = prev ? flowInfo(prev, ctx, cast) : undefined;
  let prevEnd: SceneState | undefined;
  if (flow?.on && (t < flow.camBlend || t < flow.actorBlend)) prevEnd = evalShot(prev!, prev!.dur, cast);
  if (flow?.on && prevEnd && t < flow.camBlend) cam = orbitBlend(prevEnd.cam, cam, ease(t / flow.camBlend));
  // pass 2: with look-at targets (other actors' heads, points, or the camera)
  let states = actors.map((a, i) =>
    evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, t, seeds[i], target =>
      target === 'camera' ? cam.pos : typeof target === 'string' ? first[target]?.anchors.head : new THREE.Vector3(...target), clock),
  );
  if (flow?.on && prevEnd && t < flow.actorBlend) {
    const k = ease(t / flow.actorBlend);
    states = states.map(s => (prevEnd!.byId[s.spec.id] ? blendStates(prevEnd!.byId[s.spec.id], s, k) : s));
  }
  const byId: Record<string, ActorState> = {};
  states.forEach(s => { if (!byId[s.spec.id]) byId[s.spec.id] = s; });
  const frozen = shot.fx?.freeze !== undefined && shot.fx.freeze !== false && t >= (typeof shot.fx.freeze === 'number' ? shot.fx.freeze : 0);
  const props = (shot.props || []).map(p => {
    let pos = place(p.pos, setKey);
    if (p.follow) {
      // ride along under an actor (e.g. a skateboard), optionally switching actor at given times
      const keys = typeof p.follow === 'string' ? [{ t: 0, id: p.follow }] : p.follow.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) }));
      const cur = [...keys].reverse().find(k => t >= k.t) || keys[0];
      const st = byId[cur.id];
      if (st) pos = [st.pos[0], st.pos[1] - 0.1, st.pos[2]];
    }
    const ignite = (p as { ignite?: number | string }).ignite;
    // prop paths take word cues too ("@stops-0.2"), so moving props stay on the narration after re-voicing
    const path = p.follow || !p.path ? undefined : p.path.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) }));
    return { ...p, pos, path, ...(ignite !== undefined ? { ignite: cue(ignite, words, 0) } : {}) } as PropSpec;
  });
  return { setKey, def, palKey, actors, states, byId, cam, swap, frozen, props, flow, camOut };
}

// Engine self-tests: tiny canned scenes that check each effect keeps its promise. They run in the
// same code path as rendering (evalShot), so a broken effect fails here before any video uses it.
//   node tools/qa.cjs selftest      (also: npm test)
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { at, evalActor, withReach } from '../engine/actor';
import { CAST } from '../cast';
import { resolvePose } from '../engine/rig';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import { rng } from '../sets/kit';
import type { Episode, Shot3D, Timing } from '../types';
import { auditEpisode } from './audit';
import { evalShot, flowInfo, type ShotCtx } from './scene';

export type TestResult = { name: string; pass: boolean; detail: string };

const cast = CAST;
const M = SETS.void.marks;
const dist = (a: number[], b: number[]) => Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[2] - b[2]);
const ctx = (shot: Shot3D, dur = 3, start = 0): ShotCtx => ({ shot, dur, start });

function test(name: string, fn: () => string | true): TestResult {
  try {
    const r = fn();
    return r === true ? { name, pass: true, detail: 'ok' } : { name, pass: false, detail: r };
  } catch (e) {
    return { name, pass: false, detail: 'threw: ' + String((e as Error).message || e) };
  }
}

export function runSelfTests(): TestResult[] {
  const out: TestResult[] = [];

  out.push(test('swap trades both positions', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'left' }, { id: 'bestie', pos: 'right' }], fx: { swap: { t: 1, ids: ['hero', 'bestie'] } } };
    const before = evalShot(ctx(shot), 0.9, cast), after = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.05, cast);
    if (dist(before.byId.hero.pos, M.left) > 0.01) return 'hero moved before the swap';

// Checks an episode spec against the registries so mistakes fail fast with a readable list.
// Runs inside calculateMetadata; check from the CLI with:
//   npx remotion compositions src/index.ts --props='{"slug":"<slug>"}'
import { CARDS } from '../cards';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import { PALETTES } from '../sets/look';
import { FACES, POSES } from '../engine/rig';
import type { Episode, Shot3D } from '../types';
import { castOf } from './resolve';

// Mirrors LIB in tools/sfx/episode_audio.py
export const SFX_NAMES = ['whoosh', 'whooshUp', 'swoosh', 'boom', 'farBoom', 'thud', 'footsteps', 'gulp', 'click', 'pop', 'cloth', 'heartbeat',
  'subdrop', 'riser', 'swell', 'zap', 'crackle', 'wind', 'debris', 'rustle', 'chime', 'glint', 'ticks', 'ring', 'bell', 'whistle', 'groan', 'groanLow'];
const PROPS = ['table', 'roundTable', 'chair', 'bed', 'desk', 'deskLamp', 'door', 'window', 'shelf', 'plant', 'tree', 'bush', 'lamp', 'fence', 'car', 'house',
  'building', 'clock', 'rug', 'crowd', 'sign', 'screen', 'box', 'crate', 'ball', 'basketball', 'cup', 'phone', 'book', 'laptop', 'glow', 'pillar', 'wall', 'portal', 'cone', 'trophy', 'skateboard', 'spot',
  'fire', 'smoke', 'firetruck', 'basket', 'binoculars', 'trafficlight', 'pizza', 'jar'];
const SHOTS = ['establishing', 'wide', 'full', 'medium', 'close', 'xclose', 'insert'];
const MOVES = ['static', 'drift', 'pushIn', 'pullOut', 'orbitL', 'orbitR', 'craneUp', 'craneDown', 'truckL', 'truckR', 'track', 'crashIn', 'shake', 'handheld'];
const OVERLAYS = ['label', 'title', 'stopwatch', 'stat', 'bubble', 'thought', 'crush', 'caption', 'flash', 'counter', 'news', 'hudList'];

export function validate(ep: Episode): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const cast = castOf(ep);
  if (!ep.voice?.id) out.push('voice.id missing');
  const speakers = ['narrator', 'male', 'female', ...Object.keys(ep.voices || {})];
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const at = `shot ${i}`;
    if (shot.who && !speakers.includes(shot.who)) out.push(`${at}: unknown speaker who:"${shot.who}" (have: ${speakers.join(', ')})`);
    if (!shot.vo && !shot.hold) out.push(`${at}: needs "vo" or "hold"`);
    (shot.sfx || []).forEach(c => { if (!SFX_NAMES.includes(c.name)) out.push(`${at}: unknown sfx "${c.name}"`); });
    (shot.overlays || []).forEach(o => { if (!OVERLAYS.includes(o.type)) out.push(`${at}: unknown overlay "${o.type}"`); });
    if (shot.kind === 'card') {
      if (!CARDS[shot.card as string]) out.push(`${at}: unknown card "${shot.card}" (have: ${Object.keys(CARDS).join(', ')})`);
      return;
    }
    const s = shot as Shot3D;
    const set = SETS[s.set];
    if (!set) {
      out.push(`${at}: unknown set "${s.set}" (have: ${Object.keys(SETS).join(', ')})`);
      return;
    }
    if (s.time && !PALETTES[s.time]) out.push(`${at}: unknown time/palette "${s.time}"`);
    const mark = (p: unknown, what: string) => {
      if (typeof p !== 'string') return;
      const name = p.split('+')[0].trim();
      if (!set.marks[name]) out.push(`${at}: ${what} mark "${name}" not in set ${s.set} (have: ${Object.keys(set.marks).join(', ')})`);
    };
    (s.actors || []).forEach(a => {
      if (!cast[a.id]) out.push(`${at}: unknown cast "${a.id}"`);
      mark(a.pos, `actor ${a.id}`);
      (a.path || []).forEach(w => mark(w.pos, `actor ${a.id} path`));
      const poses = [a.pose, ...(a.poses || []).map(k => k.pose)];
      poses.forEach(p => { if (typeof p === 'string' && !POSES[p]) out.push(`${at}: unknown pose "${p}"`); });
      const faces = [a.face, ...(a.faces || []).map(k => k.face)];
      faces.forEach(f => { if (typeof f === 'string' && !FACES[f]) out.push(`${at}: unknown face "${f}"`); });
    });
    (s.props || []).forEach(p => { if (!PROPS.includes(p.type)) out.push(`${at}: unknown prop "${p.type}"`); mark(p.pos, `prop ${p.type}`); });
    const c = s.camera;
    if (c) {
      if (c.shot && !SHOTS.includes(c.shot)) out.push(`${at}: unknown camera.shot "${c.shot}"`);
      if (c.move && !MOVES.includes(c.move)) out.push(`${at}: unknown camera.move "${c.move}"`);
      const ids = Array.isArray(c.target) ? (typeof c.target[0] === 'string' ? (c.target as string[]) : []) : typeof c.target === 'string' ? [c.target] : [];
      ids.forEach(id => { if (!(s.actors || []).some(a => a.id === id)) out.push(`${at}: camera target "${id}" is not in this shot`); });
    }
  });
  (ep.music || []).forEach(m => { if (m.shot >= ep.shots.length) out.push(`music cue at shot ${m.shot} is past the last shot`); });
  return out;
}

// White rounded speech (or thought) bubble with handwritten text and a tail that points at a screen
// point — usually a character's mouth/head from `project()`. Pops out of the tail tip, bobs gently,
// and shrinks back into the tip at the end.
//
// Props
//   t         seconds since the bubble appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   text      the line (Patrick Hand; wraps at maxWidth)
//   x, y      screen point the tail points to (px)
//   kind      'speech' (default) | 'thought' (rounder bubble, tail of shrinking dots)
//   side      'auto' (default: bubble grows away from the nearer frame edge) | 'left' | 'right'
//   place     'auto' (default: above the point, below when y < 340) | 'above' | 'below'
//   gap       vertical gap between the point and the bubble edge (default 90)
//   size      font size in px (default 46)
//   maxWidth  max bubble text width in px (default 560)
//   dur       seconds on screen; pops back over the last 0.22 s (omit = stays)
//   W, H      frame size (default 1920×1080)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, HAND, backOut, clamp01, easeIn, f, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const Bubble: React.FC<{
  t: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; kind?: 'speech' | 'thought'; side?: 'auto' | 'left' | 'right'; place?: 'auto' | 'above' | 'below';
  gap?: number; size?: number; maxWidth?: number; dur?: number; W?: number; H?: number;
}> = ({ t, text, x, y, kind = 'speech', side = 'auto', place = 'auto', gap = 90, size = 46, maxWidth = 560, dur, W = 1920, H = 1080 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.22, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const sx = side === 'left' ? -1 : side === 'right' ? 1 : x > W * 0.55 ? -1 : 1; // direction the bubble extends
  const below = place === 'below' || (place === 'auto' && y < 340);
  const sy = below ? 1 : -1;
  const thought = kind === 'thought';

  const pop = backOut(seg(t, 0, 0.3), 2.2) * (1 - outK);
  const textIn = clamp01((t - 0.04) / 0.1);
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 3;

  const ax = x - sx * 70; // near vertical edge of the bubble
  const by = y + sy * gap; // bubble edge nearest the point
  const b1 = ax + sx * 52, b2 = ax + sx * 122; // tail base on that edge
  const inset = sy * 9; // tuck the tail base inside the bubble
  const tail = thought
    ? null
    : `M${f(b1)},${f(by + inset)} Q${f((b1 + x) / 2 + sx * 6)},${f((by + y) / 2)} ${f(x)},${f(y)} Q${f((b2 + x) / 2 + sx * 18)},${f((by + y) / 2 - sy * 8)} ${f(b2)},${f(by + inset)} Z`;
  const dots = thought
    ? [0.28, 0.58, 0.86].map((k, i) => ({ cx: x + (ax + sx * 90 - x) * k, cy: y + (by - y) * k, r: 7 + i * 5 }))
    : [];

  const box: React.CSSProperties = {
    position: 'absolute',
    [sx > 0 ? 'left' : 'right']: sx > 0 ? ax : W - ax,
    [below ? 'top' : 'bottom']: below ? by : H - by,
    minWidth: 210, maxWidth: maxWidth + 2 * 36, padding: thought ? '30px 46px' : '22px 36px',
    background: '#fffdf8', borderRadius: thought ? 999 : 38,
    fontFamily: HAND, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1.12, color: C.ink, textAlign: 'center',
    boxShadow: 'inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(40,30,80,0.08)',
  };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill
      style={{
        pointerEvents: 'none', transform: `translateY(${bob}px) scale(${pop})`, transformOrigin: `${x}px ${y}px`,
        filter: 'drop-shadow(0 6px 0 rgba(20,14,40,0.28)) drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35))', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.06),
      }}
    >
      <svg width={W} height={H} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
        {tail && <path d={tail} fill="#fffdf8" />}
        {dots.map((d, i) => (
          <circle key={i} cx={d.cx} cy={d.cy} r={d.r} fill="#fffdf8" opacity={clamp01((t - i * 0.06) / 0.12)} />
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div style={box}>
        <span style={{ opacity: textIn }}>{text}</span>
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// Pink heart badge with a percentage floating above a character's head: how much they like the hero.
// Anchored with `project()` like Bubble. Counts from `from` to `value` over `countDur`, pops in,
// bobs gently, and pulses when the number climbs. 0% draws a dim, hollow heart.
//
// Props
//   t         seconds since the badge appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   x, y      screen point above the head (px), from project(headTop)
//   value     target percentage 0..100
//   from      starting percentage (default: value, i.e. no count)
//   countDur  seconds for the count (default 0.9)
//   scale     px per metre at the head, so far-away badges shrink
//   dur       seconds on screen; shrinks out over the last 0.2 s (omit = stays)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { COND, backOut, clamp01, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

const HEART = 'M12 21.3l-1.4-1.3C5.4 15.4 2 12.3 2 8.5 2 5.4 4.4 3 7.5 3c1.7 0 3.4.8 4.5 2.1C13.1 3.8 14.8 3 16.5 3 19.6 3 22 5.4 22 8.5c0 3.8-3.4 6.9-8.6 11.5L12 21.3z';

export const CrushMeter: React.FC<{
  t: number; x: number; y: number; value: number; from?: number; countDur?: number; scale?: number; dur?: number;
}> = ({ t, x, y, value, from, countDur = 0.9, scale = 400, dur }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.2, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const start = from ?? value;
  const k = easeOut(seg(t, 0.15, 0.15 + countDur));
  const v = Math.round(start + (value - start) * k);
  const rising = value > start && k > 0 && k < 1;
  const pop = backOut(seg(t, 0, 0.28), 2.4) * (1 - outK);
  const pulse = rising ? 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 22) : 1;
  const size = Math.max(30, Math.min(58, scale * 0.11)); // number px, shrinks with distance
  const empty = v <= 0;
  const pink = empty ? '#c9b8c4' : '#ff4f9a';
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 3;
  const top = Math.max(y - size * 0.55 + bob, size * 1.45 + 14); // keep the whole badge inside the frame when the head is near the top
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.06) }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: x, top, transform: `translate(-50%, -100%) scale(${pop * pulse})`, transformOrigin: '50% 100%',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: size * 0.18, padding: `${size * 0.12}px ${size * 0.34}px ${size * 0.12}px ${size * 0.22}px`,
          background: empty ? 'rgba(40,30,48,0.78)' : 'rgba(58,14,40,0.82)', borderRadius: 999,
          border: `${Math.max(2, size * 0.06)}px solid ${pink}`,
          boxShadow: empty ? '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' : `0 0 ${size * 0.5}px rgba(255,79,154,0.75), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)`,
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        }}
      >
        <svg width={size * 0.95} height={size * 0.95} viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path d={HEART} fill={empty ? 'none' : pink} stroke={pink} strokeWidth={empty ? 2 : 0.5} />
        </svg>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1, color: empty ? '#d9cdd5' : '#ffffff', letterSpacing: 1 }}>
          {v}%
        </span>
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// 2D effect overlays drawn over (or between) 3D layers: electric crackles around a character,
// anime speed lines, full-frame flashes.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { rand } from '../engine/fx';

export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };

function bolt(r: () => number, a: Pt, b: Pt, jag: number, segs: number): string {
  const pts: Pt[] = [a];
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;
  for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
    const k = i / segs;
    const off = (r() * 2 - 1) * jag * Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
    pts.push({ x: a.x + dx * k + nx * off, y: a.y + dy * k + ny * off });
  }
  pts.push(b);
  return 'M' + pts.map(p => `${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' L');
}

/**
 * Electric arcs hugging a silhouette. `anchors` are screen points on/near the body (head, shoulders,
 * hands, hips); `scale` is px per metre at the subject so arcs keep a sensible size in any framing.
 */
export const Crackles: React.FC<{ frame: number; anchors: Pt[]; scale: number; center?: Pt; intensity?: number; seed?: number; color?: string; W?: number; H?: number }> = ({
  frame, anchors, scale, center, intensity = 1, seed = 1, color = '#a66bff', W = 1920, H = 1080,
}) => {
  if (intensity <= 0 || anchors.length === 0) return null;
  const bucket = Math.floor(frame / 2); // new pattern every 2 frames
  const r = rand(seed * 1000 + bucket * 17 + 3);
  const count = Math.round((1 + r() * 2.5) * intensity);
  const paths: { d: string; w: number; o: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (r() > 0.85) continue; // occasional gaps = flicker
    const a = anchors[Math.floor(r() * anchors.length)];
    // arcs leave the silhouette outward (away from the body centre) so they never scribble across the face
    const ang = center ? Math.atan2(a.y - center.y, a.x - center.x) + (r() - 0.5) * 1.3 : r() * Math.PI * 2;
    const len = (0.12 + r() * 0.28) * scale;
    const start = { x: a.x + Math.cos(ang) * 0.06 * scale, y: a.y + Math.sin(ang) * 0.06 * scale };
    const end = { x: start.x + Math.cos(ang + (r() - 0.5) * 0.6) * len, y: start.y + Math.sin(ang + (r() - 0.5) * 0.6) * len };
    paths.push({ d: bolt(r, start, end, len * 0.25, 6), w: 1 + r(), o: 0.7 + r() * 0.3 });
    if (r() < 0.5) {
      const mid = { x: (start.x + end.x) / 2, y: (start.y + end.y) / 2 };
      const end2 = { x: mid.x + (r() - 0.5) * len * 0.7, y: mid.y + (r() - 0.5) * len * 0.7 };
      paths.push({ d: bolt(r, mid, end2, len * 0.15, 4), w: 0.7, o: 0.6 });
    }
  }
  const sw = Math.max(1.5, scale * 0.006);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <svg width={W} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}>
        <defs>
          <filter id={`cglow${seed}`} x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={sw * 2.2} result="b" />
            <feMerge>
              <feMergeNode in="b" />
              <feMergeNode in="b" />
              <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
            </feMerge>
          </filter>
        </defs>
        <g filter={`url(#cglow${seed})`} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" fill="none">
          {paths.map((p, i) => (
            <g key={i} opacity={p.o * Math.min(1, intensity)}>
              <path d={p.d} stroke={color} strokeWidth={sw * 2.6 * p.w} />
              <path d={p.d} stroke="#f4ecff" strokeWidth={sw * p.w} />
            </g>
          ))}
        </g>
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Anime speed lines streaking horizontally (dir -1 = moving left). */
export const SpeedLines: React.FC<{ t: number; n?: number; dir?: 1 | -1; speed?: number; opacity?: number; seed?: number; band?: [number, number]; W?: number; H?: number }> = ({
  t, n = 34, dir = -1, speed = 5200, opacity = 0.75, seed = 4, band = [0.04, 0.96], W = 1920, H = 1080,
}) => {
  const r = rand(seed);
  const lines: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const y = H * (band[0] + r() * (band[1] - band[0]));
    const len = 160 + r() * 700;
    const th = 1.2 + r() * 3.8;
    const span = W + len * 2;
    const x0 = r() * span;
    const v = speed * (0.6 + r() * 0.8);
    const x = ((((x0 + dir * v * t) % span) + span) % span) - len;
    const o = opacity * (0.25 + r() * 0.75);
    lines.push(
      <rect key={i} x={x} y={y - th / 2} width={len} height={th} rx={th / 2} fill={`url(#sl${seed})`} opacity={o} />,
    );
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <svg width={W} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`sl${seed}`} x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity={dir < 0 ? 0.95 : 0} />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity={dir < 0 ? 0 : 0.95} />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        {lines}
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const Flash: React.FC<{ t: number; at: number; dur?: number; color?: string; peak?: number }> = ({ t, at, dur = 0.16, color = '#ffffff', peak = 0.85 }) => {
  const k = (t - at) / dur;
  if (k < 0 || k > 1) return null;
  const o = peak * (k < 0.15 ? k / 0.15 : Math.pow(1 - (k - 0.15) / 0.85, 1.6));
  return <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: color, opacity: o, mixBlendMode: 'screen', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />;
};
@@@@ END

// Final-look overlays: IFOLOGY's heavy vignette plus fine animated film grain.
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';

export const Grade: React.FC<{ vignette?: number; grain?: number; tint?: string }> = ({ vignette = 0.55, grain = 0.035, tint }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  // A few pre-baked grain tiles cycled per frame (deterministic, cheap).
  const tiles = useMemo(() => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = c.height = 256;
      const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
      const img = g.createImageData(256, 256);
      let s = 1234 + k * 999;
      for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
        s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
        const v = s >>> 24;
        img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
        img.data[i + 3] = 255;
      }
      g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
      out.push(c.toDataURL());
    }
    return out;
  }, []);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      {tint && <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: tint, mixBlendMode: 'soft-light' }} />}
      <AbsoluteFill
        style={{
          background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 70% at 50% 48%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 52%, rgba(10,6,14,${vignette * 0.55}) 78%, rgba(6,4,10,${vignette}) 100%)`,
        }}
      />
      {grain > 0 && (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${tiles[frame % tiles.length]})`, backgroundSize: '256px 256px', opacity: grain, mixBlendMode: 'overlay' }} />
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// Chapter tag in a corner over a 3D shot: small cream condensed caps with a gold tick, typed on
// (typewriter with a gold cursor) or slid in. "RULE 3", "DAY 1", "EARTH. EARLIER THAT NIGHT."
//
// Props
//   t        seconds since the label appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   text     the tag text (rendered in caps)
//   corner   'tl' (default) | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br'
//   mode     'type' (default, typewriter) | 'slide'
//   dur      seconds on screen; slides/fades out over the last 0.3 s (omit = stays)
//   size     font size in px (default 46)
//   accent   tick/cursor colour (default gold)
//   W, H     frame size (default 1920×1080)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, COND, clamp01, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const Label: React.FC<{
  t: number; text: string; corner?: 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br'; mode?: 'type' | 'slide'; dur?: number; size?: number; accent?: string; W?: number; H?: number;
}> = ({ t, text, corner = 'tl', mode = 'type', dur, size = 46, accent = C.goldHi, W = 1920, H = 1080 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const right = corner === 'tr' || corner === 'br';
  const bottom = corner === 'bl' || corner === 'br';
  const chars = Array.from(text.toUpperCase());
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.3, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;

  const bar = easeOut(seg(t, 0, 0.18));
  const typeStart = 0.12;
  const cps = Math.max(22, chars.length / 0.7); // whole tag typed in ≤ 0.7 s
  const typed = mode === 'type' ? Math.floor(clamp01((t - typeStart) * cps / chars.length) * chars.length + 1e-6) : chars.length;
  const typingDone = typeStart + chars.length / cps;
  const cursorOn = mode === 'type' && t < typingDone + 0.9 && (t < typingDone || Math.floor((t - typingDone) * 3.4) % 2 === 0);
  const slide = mode === 'slide' ? easeOut(seg(t, 0.08, 0.45)) : 1;

  const shadow = `0 2px 0 rgba(10,8,25,0.85), 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)`;
  const tick = (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'relative', width: Math.max(5, size * 0.12), height: size * 1.05 * bar, borderRadius: 4, background: accent, alignSelf: 'center',
        boxShadow: `0 0 10px rgba(255,200,90,0.55), 0 2px 0 rgba(10,8,25,0.7)`,
      }}
    />
  );
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', [right ? 'right' : 'left']: 86, [bottom ? 'bottom' : 'top']: 76,
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: right ? 'row-reverse' : 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: size * 0.38,
          opacity: 1 - outK, transform: `translateX(${(right ? 1 : -1) * outK * 40}px)`,
        }}
      >
        {/* soft dark scrim so cream text reads over bright daytime shots */}
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', [right ? 'right' : 'left']: -size * 0.9, top: -size * 0.5, bottom: -size * 0.5,
            width: `calc(${(100 * Math.max(typed, 1)) / chars.length}% + ${size * 2.4}px)`,
            background: `linear-gradient(${right ? 270 : 90}deg, rgba(8,10,30,0.42) 0%, rgba(8,10,30,0.3) 60%, rgba(8,10,30,0) 100%)`,
            filter: `blur(${size * 0.3}px)`, opacity: bar, borderRadius: size,
          }}
        />
        {tick}
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden', padding: '6px 4px', margin: '-6px -4px' }}>
          <div
            style={{
              fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1, letterSpacing: '0.2em', color: '#fff8ea', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              textShadow: shadow, transform: `translateX(${(1 - slide) * (right ? 1 : -1) * 110}%)`, textAlign: right ? 'right' : 'left',
            }}
          >
            {chars.map((ch, i) => (
              <React.Fragment key={i}>
                <span style={{ opacity: i < typed ? 1 : 0 }}>{ch}</span>
                {cursorOn && i === typed - 1 && <Cursor size={size} color={accent} />}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
            {cursorOn && typed === 0 && <Cursor size={size} color={accent} />}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

const Cursor: React.FC<{ size: number; color: string }> = ({ size, color }) => (
  <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-block', width: 0 }}>
    <span style={{ position: 'absolute', left: size * 0.06, top: -size * 0.82, width: size * 0.09, height: size * 0.9, background: color, boxShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(255,200,90,0.6)' }} />
  </span>
);

// Lower-third "viral video" bar over a 3D shot: a red tag ("TRENDING"), the headline in white caps
// on a dark band, and a gold ticker line under it (view counts, channel). Slides in from the left.
//
// Props
//   t         seconds since the bar appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   headline  the video title / headline
//   ticker    small line under it, e.g. "2,000,000 VIEWS · FILMED BY THEO"
//   tag       red tag text (default "TRENDING")
//   dur       seconds on screen; slides out over the last 0.3 s (omit = stays)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, COND, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const NewsBar: React.FC<{ t: number; headline: string; ticker?: string; tag?: string; dur?: number }> = ({ t, headline, ticker, tag = 'TRENDING', dur }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.3, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const inK = easeOut(seg(t, 0, 0.35));
  const tickK = easeOut(seg(t, 0.25, 0.55));
  const x = -900 * (1 - inK) - 900 * outK;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 90 + x, bottom: 120, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'stretch', boxShadow: '0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' }}>
          <div style={{ background: '#e03a2f', color: '#fff', fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 34, letterSpacing: '0.06em', padding: '10px 18px' }}>{tag.toUpperCase()}</div>
          <div style={{ background: 'rgba(14,16,30,0.92)', color: '#fff', fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 52, letterSpacing: '0.02em', padding: '6px 26px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{headline.toUpperCase()}</div>
        </div>
        {ticker && (
          <div style={{ opacity: tickK, transform: `translateX(${(1 - tickK) * -30}px)`, background: 'rgba(14,16,30,0.78)', color: C.goldHi, fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 30, letterSpacing: '0.08em', padding: '6px 18px' }}>{ticker.toUpperCase()}</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// IFOLOGY-style stat callout: chunky gold serif number with a cream condensed label.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { loadFont as loadSerif } from '@remotion/google-fonts/BreeSerif';
import { loadFont as loadCond } from '@remotion/google-fonts/BarlowCondensed';

const serif = loadSerif('normal', { weights: ['400'], subsets: ['latin'] }).fontFamily;
const cond = loadCond('normal', { weights: ['700', '800'], subsets: ['latin'] }).fontFamily;

const clamp01 = (x: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
const backOut = (x: number) => {
  const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1;
  return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2);
};

export const StatCallout: React.FC<{
  t: number; // seconds since the callout starts
  big: (k: number) => string; // value text for count-up progress k (0..1)
  small?: (k: number) => string;
  countDur?: number;
  x?: number; y?: number;
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
  size?: number;
}> = ({ t, big, small, countDur = 0.35, x = 120, y = 110, align = 'left', size = 150 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const pop = backOut(clamp01(t / 0.22));
  const k = clamp01(t / countDur);
  const kk = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
  const line = clamp01((t - 0.12) / 0.25);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: x, top: y, transform: `translate(${align === 'center' ? '-50%' : align === 'right' ? '-100%' : '0'}, 0) scale(${0.6 + 0.4 * pop})`,
          transformOrigin: align === 'left' ? 'left center' : 'center', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.08), textAlign: align,
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            fontFamily: serif, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 0.95, letterSpacing: 2,
            background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #fff1c2 0%, #ffd56b 45%, #f0a531 100%)',
            WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', backgroundClip: 'text', color: 'transparent',
            filter: 'drop-shadow(0 5px 0 rgba(46,18,84,0.95)) drop-shadow(0 12px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.5))',
          }}
        >
          {big(kk)}
        </div>
        <div style={{ height: 6, marginTop: 10, width: `${line * 100}%`, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd56b,#f0a531)', borderRadius: 3, boxShadow: '0 3px 0 rgba(40,16,70,0.8)' }} />
        {small && (
          <div style={{ fontFamily: cond, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size * 0.36, letterSpacing: 5, color: '#fff6e2', marginTop: 10, textShadow: '0 3px 0 rgba(46,18,84,0.95), 0 0 18px rgba(20,8,40,0.7)' }}>
            {small(kk)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

@@@@ FILE src/overlays/Stopwatch.tsx | text-crlf | 5485 | 2b8d43e0906d39ca46c9209eebeb5e689d21c64e310279a408cbfa6a64a5a6f6
// Corner HUD stopwatch (Ifverse "reaction time" look): a white line-art stopwatch whose gold hand
// spins, with a value under it that can change, e.g. "0.25 s" → "0.025 s" (old value flips up and
// away, the new one pops in gold with a ring flash, and the hand slows to match).
//
// Props
//   t           seconds since the HUD appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   from        first value text, e.g. "0.25 s"
//   to          optional second value text, e.g. "0.025 s"
//   switchAt    seconds (since appear) when `from` changes to `to` (default 1.2)
//   corner      'tr' (default) | 'tl' | 'br' | 'bl'
//   size        icon size in px (default 112); the value text scales with it
//   speed       hand revolutions per second (default 1)
//   speedAfter  revolutions per second after the switch (default speed / 10)
//   dur         seconds on screen; fades out over the last 0.3 s (omit = stays)
//   persist     already on screen (a countdown continuing across cuts): no draw-on / value pop-in
//   W, H        frame size (default 1920×1080)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { Icon } from '../cards/icons';
import { C, COND, backOut, clamp01, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const Stopwatch: React.FC<{
  t: number; from: string; to?: string; switchAt?: number; corner?: 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br'; size?: number; speed?: number; speedAfter?: number;
  dur?: number; persist?: boolean; tick?: number; keep?: boolean; W?: number; H?: number;
}> = ({ t, from: from0, to, switchAt = 1.2, corner = 'tr', size = 112, speed = 1, speedAfter, dur, persist, tick, keep, W = 1920, H = 1080 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  // tick: live countdown — `from` ("M:SS") runs down at `tick` story-seconds per second, stopping at 0:00
  let from = from0;
  const mm = tick ? /^(\d+):(\d\d)$/.exec(from0) : null;
  if (mm && tick) {
    const left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(+mm[1] * 60 + +mm[2] - t * tick));
    from = `${Math.floor(left / 60)}:${String(left % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  // keep: the countdown continues into the next shot, so don't fade out at the cut
  const outK = dur != null && !keep ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.3, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const right = corner === 'tr' || corner === 'br';
  const bottom = corner === 'bl' || corner === 'br';
  const sa = speedAfter ?? speed / 10;
  const hasSwitch = !!to;
  const sw = hasSwitch ? switchAt : Infinity;
  const turns = t <= sw ? speed * t : speed * sw + sa * (t - sw);
  const pad = 70;
  const cx = right ? W - pad - size / 2 : pad + size / 2;
  const cy = bottom ? H - pad - size * 1.2 : pad + size / 2;
  const draw = persist ? 1 : seg(t, 0, 0.4);
  const ds = t >= sw ? t - sw : -1;
  const ring = ds >= 0 ? seg(ds, 0, 0.5) : 0;
  const fontSize = Math.round(size * 0.46);
  const oldK = ds >= 0 ? easeOut(seg(ds, 0, 0.2)) : 0;
  const newK = ds >= 0 ? seg(ds, 0.08, 0.38) : 0;
  const valIn = persist ? 1 : easeOut(seg(t, 0.2, 0.5));

  const valStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, textAlign: 'center', fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 700, fontSize, lineHeight: 1, letterSpacing: '0.04em',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textShadow: '0 2px 0 rgba(10,8,25,0.85), 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)',
  };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', opacity: 1 - outK }}>
      <svg width={W} height={H} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, overflow: 'visible', filter: 'drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.55))' }}>
        <defs>
          <filter id="swhud-glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={6} />
          </filter>
          <radialGradient id="swhud-scrim">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor="#080a1e" stopOpacity={0.55} />
            <stop offset="0.6" stopColor="#080a1e" stopOpacity={0.32} />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor="#080a1e" stopOpacity={0} />
          </radialGradient>
        </defs>
        <ellipse cx={cx} cy={cy + size * 0.45} rx={size * 1.25} ry={size * 1.05} fill="url(#swhud-scrim)" opacity={draw} />
        {ring > 0 && ring < 1 && (
          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy + size * 0.07} r={size * (0.36 + 0.4 * easeOut(ring))} fill="none" stroke={C.goldHi} strokeWidth={6 * (1 - ring) + 1} opacity={1 - ring} />
        )}
        {ds >= 0 && <circle cx={cx} cy={cy + size * 0.07} r={size * 0.42} fill={C.goldHi} opacity={0.18 * Math.exp(-ds * 3)} filter="url(#swhud-glow)" />}
        <Icon name="stopwatch" x={cx} y={cy} size={size} p={draw} t={turns * 2} sw={Math.max(3, size * 0.04)} />
      </svg>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: cx - 200, width: 400, top: cy + size * 0.62, height: fontSize * 1.2 }}>
        <div style={{ ...valStyle, color: persist ? C.goldHi : '#ffffff', opacity: valIn * (1 - oldK), transform: `translateY(${-oldK * fontSize * 0.45 + (1 - valIn) * 10}px)` }}>{from}</div>
        {hasSwitch && newK > 0 && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...valStyle, color: C.goldHi, opacity: clamp01(newK * 3),
              transform: `translateY(${(1 - easeOut(newK)) * fontSize * 0.7}px) scale(${0.7 + 0.3 * backOut(newK, 2.4)})`,
              textShadow: `${valStyle.textShadow}, 0 0 18px rgba(255,190,80,${0.6 * Math.exp(-ds * 2)})`,
            }}
          >
            {to}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
@@@@ END
@@@@ FILE src/overlays/TitleOverlay.tsx | text | 3098 | 8162e24c9570302beaa6b86bc3c252ce09f85269fd2954d89750c1105423b358
// IFOLOGY episode title for laying over an establishing shot (or a navy card):
//   small cream serif line   "WHAT IF YOU COULD"
//   big gold gradient serif  "STOP TIME?"   (letters pop up in a quick stagger, then a shimmer)
//
// Props
//   t       seconds since the title appears (nothing is drawn for t < 0)
//   big     the big gold line (required)
//   small   the small cream line above it (optional)
//   dur     seconds the title stays; it animates out over the last `out` s (omit = stays forever)
//   out     out-animation length (default 0.4)
//   pos     'top' (default, IFOLOGY placement over 3D) | 'center' | number (top of block in px)
//   size    big-line font size in px (default 150; long lines shrink to fit 84% of the width)
//   W, H    frame size (default 1920×1080)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, GoldText, SERIF, clamp01, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const TitleOverlay: React.FC<{
  t: number; big: string; small?: string; dur?: number; out?: number; pos?: 'top' | 'center' | number; size?: number; W?: number; H?: number;
}> = ({ t, big, small, dur, out = 0.4, pos = 'top', size = 150, W = 1920, H = 1080 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const chars = Array.from(big).length;
  const bigSize = Math.min(size, (W * 0.84) / Math.max(1, chars * 0.62));
  const smallSize = Math.max(34, Math.round(bigSize * 0.36));
  const step = Math.min(0.04, 0.32 / Math.max(1, chars));
  const smallIn = easeOut(seg(t, 0, 0.35));
  const bigEnd = 0.1 + chars * step + 0.32;
  const shimmerK = seg(t, bigEnd + 0.25, bigEnd + 1.05);
  const shimmer = shimmerK > 0 && shimmerK < 1 ? -0.25 + 1.5 * shimmerK : null;
  const life = dur ?? 8;
  const drift = 1 + 0.035 * clamp01(t / Math.max(2, life));
  const o = dur != null ? 1 - easeIn(seg(t, dur - out, dur)) : 1;
  if (o <= 0.001) return null;
  const lift = dur != null ? -14 * easeIn(seg(t, dur - out, dur)) : 0;
  const top = pos === 'top' ? H * 0.085 : pos === 'center' ? H * 0.5 - (bigSize + smallSize * 1.4) / 2 : pos;

  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: W / 2, top, transform: `translate(-50%, ${lift}px) scale(${drift})`, transformOrigin: 'center top',
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', opacity: o,
        }}
      >
        {small && (
          <div
            style={{
              fontFamily: SERIF, fontSize: smallSize, lineHeight: 1, color: C.creamSoft, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              letterSpacing: `${0.06 + 0.1 * (1 - smallIn)}em`, opacity: smallIn, transform: `translateY(${(1 - smallIn) * -14}px)`,
              textShadow: `0 ${Math.max(2, smallSize * 0.07)}px 0 ${C.shadow}, 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)`, marginBottom: smallSize * 0.18,
            }}
          >
            {small}
          </div>
        )}
        <GoldText text={big} size={bigSize} tabular={false} spacing={0.025} shimmer={shimmer} stagger={{ t, start: 0.1, step, dur: 0.32 }} />
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
@@@@ END
@@@@ FILE src/sets/apartments.tsx | text-crlf | 9838 | 6a51a47d5b8bfad32c838532ce4dece5f2f1d0a5d16e19de5fab8e2ad82617d4
// Apartment street for the fire set piece: a five-storey pastel apartment block with balconies,
// facing a two-lane street. The middle flat on the 4th floor (level 3) is on fire: flames in its
// balcony doorway and window, soot on the wall, smoke pouring up the facade. Neighbouring blocks
// on both sides, a row of buildings across the street, towers behind.
//
// Layout (metres, y up):
//   road (asphalt, top y = 0)       |z| < 5, yellow centre dashes
//   sidewalks (top y = 0.15)        5 < |z| < 9.5
//   block front                     z = -9.5, x ∈ [-14, 14], floors every 3 m from y = 0.15
//   balconies (levels 1–4)          bays x = -8, 0, 8; 3.0 m wide, 1.4 m deep (front rail z = -8.1)
//   fire                            level 3 (floor y = 9.15), bay 0 doorway + window at x = 4
import React from 'react';
import { envMaterial } from '../engine/materials';
import { Glow } from '../engine/fx';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import { At, Box, Building, Car, G, mix, Plane, Tree } from './kit';
import { CityLamp, decalMaterial, Hydrant, Inst, Instances, lampsOn, nightness, TrashCan } from './outdoorKit';
import { Smoke, WorldProp } from './props';

const WALK_Y = 0.15;
const FRONT = -9.5;
const FLOOR = 3;
const LEVELS = 5;
const HALF_W = 14;
const BAYS = [-8, 0, 8];
const WIN_X = [-12, -4, 4, 12];
const BAL_W = 3.0, BAL_D = 1.4;
const FIRE_LEVEL = 3;
const fy = (k: number) => WALK_Y + k * FLOOR;
const WALL = '#e6c9a8', BAND = '#cfae8b', PLINTH = '#b98f74', TRIM = '#f4ede2', RAIL = '#3d4150';
const GLASS = '#7f9bb8';

/** Railing bars of every balcony (one instanced mesh). */
function railItems(): Inst[] {
  const out: Inst[] = [];
  for (let k = 1; k < LEVELS; k++)
    for (const bx of BAYS) {
      const y = fy(k) + 0.5, zf = FRONT + BAL_D;
      for (let i = 0; i <= 14; i++) out.push({ p: [bx - BAL_W / 2 + (i * BAL_W) / 14, y, zf - 0.03], s: [0.035, 1.0, 0.035] });
      for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) out.push({ p: [bx + sx * (BAL_W / 2 - 0.02), y, FRONT + (i * BAL_D) / 7], s: [0.035, 1.0, 0.035] });
    }
  return out;
}

const Balcony: React.FC<{ x: number; k: number }> = ({ x, k }) => {
  const y = fy(k), zf = FRONT + BAL_D;
  return (
    <group>
      <Box p={[x, y - 0.1, FRONT + BAL_D / 2]} s={[BAL_W, 0.2, BAL_D]} c={TRIM} />
      <Box p={[x, y + 1.02, zf - 0.03]} s={[BAL_W + 0.04, 0.06, 0.07]} c={RAIL} />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => <Box key={s} p={[x + s * (BAL_W / 2 - 0.02), y + 1.02, FRONT + BAL_D / 2]} s={[0.07, 0.06, BAL_D]} c={RAIL} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

/** One window or balcony door on the facade: frame + glass (or a burning opening). */
const Opening: React.FC<{ x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; fire?: boolean; lit?: boolean }> = ({ x, y, w, h, fire, lit }) => (
  <group>
    <Box p={[x, y + h / 2, FRONT + 0.03]} s={[w + 0.24, h + 0.24, 0.06]} c={fire ? '#2b2526' : TRIM} />
    <Plane p={[x, y + h / 2, FRONT + 0.07]} s={[w, h, 1]} c={fire ? '#ff7a2a' : lit ? '#ffd27e' : GLASS} glow={fire || lit} />
    {!fire && <Box p={[x, y + h / 2, FRONT + 0.08]} s={[0.05, h, 0.02]} c={TRIM} />}
  </group>
);

const Facade: React.FC<{ night: boolean; t: number }> = React.memo(({ night }) => {
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < LEVELS; k++) {
    const y = fy(k);
    if (k > 0) parts.push(<Box key={`band${k}`} p={[0, y - 0.08, FRONT + 0.06]} s={[HALF_W * 2 + 0.1, 0.16, 0.14]} c={BAND} />);
    WIN_X.forEach((x, j) => {
      const fire = k === FIRE_LEVEL && x === 4;
      if (k === 0 && x === -4) return; // the entrance takes this slot
      parts.push(<Opening key={`w${k}-${j}`} x={x} y={y + 0.85} w={1.5} h={1.5} fire={fire} lit={night && (k * 7 + j * 3) % 5 === 1} />);
    });
    BAYS.forEach((x, j) => {
      const fire = k === FIRE_LEVEL && x === 0;
      if (k === 0) parts.push(<Opening key={`s${j}`} x={x} y={y + 0.3} w={2.4} h={2.0} lit={night} />);
      else parts.push(<Opening key={`d${k}-${j}`} x={x} y={y} w={1.7} h={2.25} fire={fire} lit={night && (k + j) % 3 === 0} />);
    });
  }
  return (
    <group>
      {/* the block */}
      <Box p={[0, WALK_Y + (LEVELS * FLOOR) / 2, FRONT - 5.75]} s={[HALF_W * 2, LEVELS * FLOOR, 11.5]} c={WALL} />
      <Box p={[0, WALK_Y + 1.6, FRONT + 0.05]} s={[HALF_W * 2 + 0.1, 3.2, 0.12]} c={PLINTH} />
      <Box p={[0, WALK_Y + LEVELS * FLOOR + 0.3, FRONT - 5.75]} s={[HALF_W * 2 + 0.4, 0.6, 11.9]} c={BAND} />
      {parts}
      {/* entrance: door, canopy, number */}
      <Box p={[-4, WALK_Y + 1.15, FRONT + 0.08]} s={[1.6, 2.3, 0.08]} c="#3d5c86" />
      <Box p={[-4, WALK_Y + 2.55, FRONT + 0.6]} s={[2.4, 0.12, 1.2]} c="#2f6b4f" />
      {BAYS.map(x => [1, 2, 3, 4].map(k => <Balcony key={`b${x}${k}`} x={x} k={k} />))}
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={envMaterial(RAIL)} items={railItems} k="aptRails" cast />
      {/* soot above the burning openings */}
      <Plane p={[0, fy(FIRE_LEVEL) + 2.75, FRONT + 0.09]} s={[2.4, 1.1, 1]} c="#2e2a2d" />
      <Plane p={[4, fy(FIRE_LEVEL) + 2.75, FRONT + 0.09]} s={[2.0, 1.3, 1]} c="#2e2a2d" />
    </group>
  );
});

const Street: React.FC = React.memo(() => {
  const dashes: Inst[] = [];
  for (let x = -120; x <= 120; x += 6) dashes.push({ p: [x, 0.006, 0], s: [3, 0.012, 0.14] });
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#474a55')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[600, 600, 1]} receiveShadow />
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#f2c94c')} items={() => dashes} k="aptDash" />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Box p={[0, WALK_Y / 2, s * 7.25]} s={[300, WALK_Y, 4.5]} c="#d4cdc0" />
          <Box p={[0, WALK_Y / 2 + 0.01, s * 5.05]} s={[300, WALK_Y + 0.02, 0.18]} c="#b6afa3" />
        </group>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
});

/** Neighbours: lower blocks either side, a row across the street (facing -z), towers behind. */
const Neighbours: React.FC = React.memo(() => {
  const side: [number, number, number, string][] = [[-21, 12, 10.5, '#a9b6c8'], [21, 12, 12.2, '#c9b7cf'], [-34.5, 14, 8.6, '#d6cbb8'], [34.5, 14, 13.4, '#9fb1c6'], [-48, 12, 11, '#c4bdd0'], [48, 12, 9.4, '#d9bfae']];
  const across: [number, number, number, string][] = [[-26, 13, 9, '#bfc6cf'], [-12, 13, 12, '#d6cbb8'], [2, 13, 8, '#a9a7c2'], [16, 13, 13, '#c9d2c0'], [30, 13, 10, '#e0d3bd']];
  return (
    <group>
      {side.map(([x, w, h, c], i) => <Building key={'s' + i} p={[x, 0, FRONT - 6]} w={w} d={12} h={h} c={c} seed={i + 3} />)}
      {across.map(([x, w, h, c], i) => (
        <At key={'a' + i} p={[x, 0, 9.5 + 6]} r={Math.PI}>
          <Building w={w} d={12} h={h} c={c} seed={i + 11} />
        </At>
      ))}
      {[-40, -22, -6, 10, 26, 42].map((x, i) => <Building key={'t' + i} p={[x, 0, -48]} w={12} d={12} h={24 + ((i * 7) % 5) * 4} c={mix('#9c9ab8', '#c2bccd', (i % 3) / 2)} seed={i + 21} />)}
    </group>
  );
});

export const Apartments: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t, time }) => {
  const night = nightness(time) >= 0.6;
  const on = lampsOn(time);
  const fireY = fy(FIRE_LEVEL);
  return (
    <group>
      <Street />
      <Facade night={night} t={0} />
      <Neighbours />
      {[-11, 11, -25, 25].map(x => <Tree key={x} p={[x, WALK_Y, -6.6]} s={1.1} />)}
      {[-18, 10, 22].map(x => <Tree key={'f' + x} p={[x, WALK_Y, 6.9]} s={1.0} kind={x === 10 ? 'autumn' : 'round'} />)}
      {[-17, 17].map(x => <CityLamp key={x} p={[x, WALK_Y, -5.7]} on={on} />)}
      <Hydrant p={[5.6, WALK_Y, -6.1]} />
      <TrashCan p={[-6.6, WALK_Y, -6.2]} />
      {[[-20, 4.2, -1], [-12.5, 4.2, -1], [24, 4.2, 1]].map(([x, z, d], i) => <Car key={i} p={[x, 0, z]} r={(d * Math.PI) / 2} c={['#3d6fb6', '#e9e4da', '#4e9a6b'][i]} />)}
      {/* the fire: flames in the balcony doorway and the window, glow, smoke up the facade */}
      <WorldProp spec={{ type: 'fire', pos: [-0.35, fireY + 0.02, FRONT - 0.4], size: 0.75 }} t={t} />
      <WorldProp spec={{ type: 'fire', pos: [0.45, fireY + 0.02, FRONT - 0.5], size: 0.6, seed: 1.7 }} t={t} />
      <WorldProp spec={{ type: 'fire', pos: [4, fireY + 0.85, FRONT - 0.3], size: 0.6, seed: 3 }} t={t} />
      <Glow p={[0, fireY + 1.2, FRONT + 0.4]} size={4.2} color="#ff7a2f" opacity={0.45} />
      <Glow p={[4, fireY + 1.6, FRONT + 0.4]} size={3.4} color="#ff7a2f" opacity={0.4} />
      <group position={[0, fireY + 2.1, FRONT + 0.45]}>
        <Smoke t={t} h={11} r={0.75} n={46} wind={[0.18, 0.06]} speed={1.2} seed={2} out={0.9} />
      </group>
      {/* smoke pressing down under the balcony ceiling, just above standing head height: clear air near the floor */}
      <group position={[0, fireY + 1.95, FRONT + 0.25]}>
        <Smoke t={t + 1.3} h={0.9} r={0.36} n={30} wind={[0.0, 0.8]} speed={0.3} seed={9} out={0.7} />
      </group>
      <group position={[4, fireY + 2.25, FRONT + 0.4]}>
        <Smoke t={t + 3.7} h={10} r={0.6} n={36} wind={[0.22, 0.05]} speed={1.1} seed={5} out={0.7} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Where the ladder truck parks (rot 0, cab toward -x) and its ladder pivot (turntable top). */
export const APT_TRUCK: Vec3 = [9, 0, -2.4];
export const APT_PIVOT: Vec3 = [APT_TRUCK[0] + 2.6, 2.75, APT_TRUCK[2]];

export const APARTMENTS_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  street: [0, WALK_Y, -6.6], // sidewalk under the burning balcony (rot 180 looks up at it, rot 0 faces the road)
  crowd: [0, WALK_Y, 7.2], // far sidewalk, across the road
  balcony: [0, fy(FIRE_LEVEL), FRONT + 0.8], // on the burning 4th-floor balcony
  doorway: [0, fy(FIRE_LEVEL), FRONT + 0.25], // right in front of the burning balcony door
  truck: APT_TRUCK,
  pivot: APT_PIVOT,
  road: [0, 0, 0],
};

// Teen bedroom: bed against the back wall (left), window with pink curtains, gaming desk with
// glowing monitor (right), bookshelf, wardrobe, posters, round rug. Room x∈[-4.5,4.5],
// back wall z=-4, ceiling 2.8, open toward +z (one-sided fourth wall at z=5).
import React from 'react';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { At, Box, Cone, Cyl, DeskLamp, Door, G, Shelf, WallClock, mix } from './kit';
import { envMaterial } from '../engine/materials';
import { Batch, Batched, CeilingPanel, isNight, LeafPlant, Picture, plankFloor, RoomWindow, Shell } from './roomkit';

export const BEDROOM = { x0: -4.5, x1: 4.5, z0: -4, z1: 5, h: 2.8 };

const DUVET = '#e8806a';

function buildFloor(b: Batch) {
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1 } = BEDROOM;
  plankFloor(b, x0, x1, z0, z1, 0.22, ['#d6b48b', '#cdaa7f', '#dcbd97'], 9);
  // round rug: two layers
  b.add('cyl', '#f2c45a', [0.5, 0.005, -0.4], [1.35, 0.01, 1.35], 0, { cast: false });
  b.add('cyl', '#f7dc8f', [0.5, 0.007, -0.4], [1.0, 0.014, 1.0], 0, { cast: false });
  b.add('cyl', '#f2c45a', [0.5, 0.009, -0.4], [0.55, 0.018, 0.55], 0, { cast: false });
}

function buildFurniture(b: Batch) {
  const Z = BEDROOM.z0;
  // ---- bed (headboard against the back wall), faces +z
  b.at([-2.55, 0, Z + 1.12], 0, () => {
    const wood = '#8a5e43';
    b.box([0, 0.2, 0], [1.68, 0.28, 2.14], wood);
    b.box([0, 0.42, 0.02], [1.56, 0.2, 2.0], '#f4f1ea');
    b.box([0, 0.44, 0.32], [1.64, 0.3, 1.5], DUVET);
    b.box([0, 0.53, 0.32], [1.6, 0.12, 1.48], DUVET);
    b.box([0, 0.535, -0.42], [1.645, 0.13, 0.16], mix(DUVET, '#ffffff', 0.55));
    b.box([0, 0.545, 0.86], [1.65, 0.13, 0.3], '#f2b632');
    b.box([-0.38, 0.62, -0.72], [0.6, 0.14, 0.38], '#fbf8f2', [0.25, 0.08, 0]);
    b.box([0.38, 0.62, -0.72], [0.6, 0.14, 0.38], '#fbf8f2', [0.25, -0.06, 0]);
    b.box([0, 0.63, -1.06], [1.74, 1.06, 0.08], wood);
    b.box([0, 1.18, -1.06], [1.82, 0.07, 0.12], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.2));
    b.box([0, 0.3, 1.08], [1.68, 0.5, 0.06], wood);
    // teddy bear
    b.at([0.45, 0.6, -0.25], 0.4, () => {
      b.add('sphere', '#b07a4f', [0, 0.1, 0], [0.12, 0.13, 0.1]);
      b.add('sphere', '#b07a4f', [0, 0.29, 0], 0.085);
      b.add('sphere', '#b07a4f', [-0.07, 0.36, 0], 0.035);
      b.add('sphere', '#b07a4f', [0.07, 0.36, 0], 0.035);
      b.add('sphere', '#e6c9a8', [0, 0.27, 0.07], [0.035, 0.03, 0.025]);
    });
  });
  // nightstand
  b.at([-1.32, 0, Z + 0.28], 0, () => {
    b.box([0, 0.3, 0], [0.5, 0.56, 0.44], '#a87652');
    b.box([0, 0.42, 0.225], [0.44, 0.2, 0.012], '#c08c63', 0, { cast: false });
    b.add('sphere', '#e4c27a', [0, 0.42, 0.24], 0.022);
    b.add('cyl', '#3d6fb6', [0.12, 0.66, 0.05], [0.04, 0.12, 0.04]);
  });

  // ---- desk (right of the window)
  b.at([2.75, 0, Z + 0.37], 0, () => {
    const top = '#f3efe7', side = '#ddd6c9';
    b.box([0, 0.735, 0], [1.6, 0.05, 0.7], top);
    b.box([-0.56, 0.355, 0], [0.44, 0.71, 0.66], side);
    [0.15, 0.35, 0.55].forEach(y => {
      b.box([-0.56, y, 0.335], [0.4, 0.17, 0.012], mix(side, '#ffffff', 0.4), 0, { cast: false });
      b.box([-0.56, y + 0.04, 0.345], [0.12, 0.02, 0.02], '#8a8f9a', 0, { cast: false });
    });
    b.box([0.76, 0.355, 0], [0.05, 0.71, 0.66], side);
    // monitor
    b.box([0, 1.13, -0.17], [0.86, 0.5, 0.04], '#17181e');
    b.box([0, 0.86, -0.2], [0.06, 0.2, 0.06], '#17181e');
    b.box([0, 0.765, -0.2], [0.3, 0.02, 0.2], '#17181e');
    // screen UI (unlit)
    b.add('plane', '#5b8fe0', [0, 1.13, -0.148], [0.8, 0.44, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
    b.add('plane', '#2c4f8f', [0, 1.33, -0.147], [0.8, 0.04, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
    b.add('plane', '#f4f6ff', [-0.17, 1.12, -0.146], [0.36, 0.26, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
    b.add('plane', '#ffd36b', [0.2, 1.17, -0.146], [0.26, 0.14, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
    b.add('plane', '#8ee0b0', [0.2, 1.0, -0.146], [0.26, 0.1, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
    // keyboard, mouse, mug, books
    b.box([-0.02, 0.77, 0.08], [0.48, 0.022, 0.16], '#2a2b33');
    b.box([0.34, 0.77, 0.1], [0.06, 0.025, 0.1], '#2a2b33');
    b.add('cyl', '#e2483d', [-0.5, 0.81, 0.12], [0.045, 0.1, 0.045]);
    b.box([-0.62, 0.79, -0.18], [0.24, 0.05, 0.32], '#3d6fb6', 0.1);
    b.box([-0.6, 0.835, -0.18], [0.22, 0.04, 0.3], '#f2b632', -0.15);
    // PC tower with a glow strip
    b.box([0.45, 0.25, -0.02], [0.22, 0.46, 0.46], '#22232b');
    b.add('plane', '#b07cff', [0.45, 0.3, 0.215], [0.03, 0.3, 1], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
  });
  // gaming chair, seat faces -z (towards the desk)
  b.at([2.75, 0, Z + 1.15], Math.PI, () => {
    const red = '#c8402f', blk = '#24252d';
    b.box([0, 0.48, 0], [0.52, 0.09, 0.5], blk);
    b.box([0, 0.5, 0], [0.4, 0.09, 0.44], red);
    b.box([0, 0.83, -0.25], [0.48, 0.56, 0.09], red);
    b.box([-0.2, 0.83, -0.25], [0.08, 0.58, 0.1], blk);
    b.box([0.2, 0.83, -0.25], [0.08, 0.58, 0.1], blk);
    b.box([0, 1.12, -0.25], [0.48, 0.06, 0.1], blk);
    for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
      b.box([sd * 0.27, 0.66, 0.0], [0.05, 0.04, 0.36], blk);
      b.box([sd * 0.27, 0.58, 0.0], [0.035, 0.16, 0.035], blk);
    }
    b.add('cyl', '#8a8f9a', [0, 0.27, 0], [0.03, 0.4, 0.03]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const a = (i / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
      b.box([Math.sin(a) * 0.15, 0.07, Math.cos(a) * 0.15], [0.05, 0.04, 0.3], blk, a);
      b.add('sphere', blk, [Math.sin(a) * 0.29, 0.03, Math.cos(a) * 0.29], 0.03);
    }
  });

  // ---- wardrobe on the left wall (doors face +x)
  b.at([BEDROOM.x0, 0, 1.0], Math.PI / 2, () => {
    const wood = '#d9b48a', dr = '#e6c49b';
    b.box([0, 1.08, 0.31], [1.3, 2.12, 0.62], wood);
    b.box([0, 2.16, 0.32], [1.36, 0.06, 0.66], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.15));
    b.box([0, 0.06, 0.31], [1.26, 0.12, 0.58], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.3));
    for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
      b.box([sd * 0.315, 1.1, 0.625], [0.6, 1.9, 0.012], dr, 0, { cast: false });
      b.box([sd * 0.06, 1.1, 0.645], [0.025, 0.26, 0.03], '#7a5a3a', 0, { cast: false });
    }
  });
  // beanbag
  b.add('sphere', '#3fa7a0', [3.55, 0.27, 0.75], [0.48, 0.3, 0.46]);
  b.add('sphere', mix('#3fa7a0', '#ffffff', 0.1), [3.42, 0.42, 0.88], [0.33, 0.2, 0.3]);
  // laundry basket
  b.add('cyl', '#eef0f2', [-3.9, 0.25, 2.55], [0.24, 0.5, 0.24]);
  b.add('cyl', '#5b8fe0', [-3.9, 0.5, 2.55], [0.2, 0.06, 0.2]);
}

/** Space poster: navy, ringed planet, stars. Local +z out of the wall. */
const PlanetPoster: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0 }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0, 0.01]} s={[0.56, 0.78, 0.02]} c="#1d2647" />
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial('#f08a5d')} position={[0, 0.06, 0.022]} scale={0.13} receiveShadow />
    <mesh geometry={G.torus} material={envMaterial('#f6d38a')} position={[0, 0.06, 0.03]} rotation={[1.25, 0, 0.35]} scale={[0.22, 0.22, 0.22]} />
    {[[-0.18, 0.28], [0.16, 0.3], [0.2, -0.2], [-0.15, -0.25], [0.05, -0.32]].map(([x, y], i) => (
      <mesh key={i} geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial('#fff4c4')} position={[x, y, 0.022]} scale={0.012 + (i % 2) * 0.008} />
    ))}
  </At>
);

export const Bedroom: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t, time }) => {
  const night = isNight(time);
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1, h } = BEDROOM;
  return (
    <group>
      <Batched id="bedroom-floor" build={buildFloor} />
      <Shell x0={x0} x1={x1} z0={z0} z1={z1} h={h} wall="#cbdcf5" lower="#97b2e2" railY={1.0} rail="#f6f3ec" base="#f6f3ec" ceiling="#f2f3f6" ceilingEmissive={night ? '#2a2c34' : '#9a9ca2'} fourth />
      <Batched id="bedroom-furniture" build={buildFurniture} />

      <RoomWindow p={[0.45, 1.72, z0]} w={1.3} h={1.25} cols={2} night={night} seed={3} curtain="#e891a6" />
      <LeafPlant p={[-0.02, 1.032, z0 + 0.1]} s={0.4} pot="#f2b632" seed={2} />
      {/* nightstand lamp */}
      <Cyl p={[-1.45, 0.66, z0 + 0.24]} s={[0.07, 0.18, 0.07]} c="#e9e2d4" />
      <Cone p={[-1.45, 0.86, z0 + 0.24]} s={[0.15, 0.2, 0.15]} c={night ? '#ffe7b0' : '#f7efe0'} glow={night} />
      <DeskLamp p={[3.3, 0.76, z0 + 0.25]} c="#2b2d36" />

      <Picture p={[-2.55, 1.78, z0]} w={0.95} h={0.58} art="landscape" frame="#f6f3ec" />
      <PlanetPoster p={[2.25, 1.95, z0]} />
      <Picture p={[3.05, 2.0, z0]} w={0.5} h={0.66} art="abstract" seed={3} frame="#f6f3ec" />
      <Shelf p={[x1 - 0.16, 0, -1.4]} r={-Math.PI / 2} c="#a87652" seed={7} />
      <Picture p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.55, 0.65]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.6} h={0.6} art="dots" frame="#2a2b33" />
      <WallClock p={[x0 + 0.05, 2.25, -1.6]} r={Math.PI / 2} s={0.75} t={t} />
      <Picture p={[x0 + 0.005, 1.6, -2.7]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={0.45} h={0.6} art="sun" frame="#f6f3ec" />
      <Door p={[x1, 0, 2.6]} r={-Math.PI / 2} c="#f1ece2" frame="#ffffff" />
      <LeafPlant p={[4.0, 0, z0 + 0.4]} s={1.15} pot="#e9e2d4" seed={4} />
      <CeilingPanel p={[0, h, -0.5]} w={0.7} round />
    </group>
  );
};

};

// School cafeteria from IFOLOGY "Stop Time": navy/yellow walls, grey checker floor, long white
// tables with attached navy benches and lunch trays, menu board, dot banner, wall clock, bins.
// Shares the classroom shell: x∈[-6,6], back wall z=-5, ceiling 3.2, one-sided fourth wall z=6.
// Tables run along x in three rows (z=-3.2,-0.8,1.6), two per row (x=±3) with a 2 m centre aisle.
// variant even = seated extras with trays; variant odd = empty hall (trays stay).
import React from 'react';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { Box, Door, WallClock, rng } from './kit';
import { Batch, Batched, BOLD_FONT, isNight, LeafPlant, Painted, Picture, seatedExtra } from './roomkit';
import { DotBanner, PANTS, SCHOOL, SchoolShell, SHIRTS, TextPoster } from './classroom';

const ROWS_Z = [-3.2, -0.8, 1.6];
const TABLES_X = [-3.0, 3.0];
const SEATS = [-1.5, -0.75, 0, 0.75, 1.5];
const BENCH = 0.62; // bench offset from table centre line
// seats kept free for the cast (key = x|z of the seat)
const FREE = new Set(['2.25|0.98', '-3|0.98', '3|2.22', '-2.25|-1.42']);
const k = (x: number, z: number) => `${+x.toFixed(2)}|${+z.toFixed(2)}`;

function tray(b: Batch, p: Vec3, yaw: number, rand: () => number) {
  const trays = ['#4e9a6b', '#e8742f', '#3d6fb6', '#e46f8e'];
  b.at(p, yaw, () => {
    b.box([0, 0.008, 0], [0.4, 0.016, 0.28], trays[Math.floor(rand() * trays.length)], 0, { cast: false });
    b.add('sphere', '#d9a35f', [-0.1, 0.045, -0.04], [0.07, 0.035, 0.05]);
    if (rand() < 0.7) b.add('sphere', rand() < 0.5 ? '#d9332b' : '#9bc53d', [0.05, 0.05, -0.06], 0.04);
    if (rand() < 0.6) {
      b.box([0.13, 0.065, 0.06], [0.06, 0.1, 0.06], '#f4f1ea');
      b.box([0.13, 0.085, 0.091], [0.05, 0.035, 0.004], '#3d6fb6', 0, { cast: false });
    } else b.add('cyl', '#f6a3a8', [0.13, 0.06, 0.06], [0.035, 0.09, 0.035]);
    b.box([-0.05, 0.02, 0.07], [0.16, 0.012, 0.08], '#f2c94c', 0, { cast: false });
  });
}

function buildTables(b: Batch) {
  const rand = rng(53);
  const top = '#eceae4', navy = '#34508f', metal = '#2c3550';
  for (const zt of ROWS_Z)
    for (const xt of TABLES_X) {
      // table top + pedestal legs
      b.box([xt, 0.74, zt], [4.0, 0.05, 0.9], top);
      b.box([xt, 0.705, zt], [3.9, 0.03, 0.8], '#c9c7c0', 0, { cast: false });
      for (const lx of [-1.4, 1.4]) {
        b.box([xt + lx, 0.36, zt], [0.08, 0.7, 0.08], metal);
        b.box([xt + lx, 0.03, zt], [0.1, 0.06, 1.9], metal);
      }
      // benches on both sides
      for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
        b.box([xt, 0.44, zt + sd * BENCH], [3.9, 0.06, 0.32], navy);
        b.box([xt, 0.41, zt + sd * BENCH], [3.8, 0.03, 0.26], '#2a3f75', 0, { cast: false });
        for (const lx of [-1.4, 1.4]) b.box([xt + lx, 0.21, zt + sd * BENCH], [0.06, 0.42, 0.06], metal);
      }
      // trays: in front of most seats
      for (const sd of [-1, 1])
        for (const sx of SEATS)
          if (rand() < 0.55) tray(b, [xt + sx, 0.765, zt + sd * 0.24], sd > 0 ? Math.PI : 0, rand);
    }
}

function buildExtras(b: Batch) {
  const rand = rng(91);
  let n = 0;
  for (const zt of ROWS_Z)
    for (const xt of TABLES_X)
      for (const sd of [-1, 1])
        for (const sx of SEATS) {
          const x = xt + sx, z = zt + sd * BENCH;
          const fill = rand() < 0.5;
          if (FREE.has(k(x, z)) || !fill) continue;
          // north bench (sd=-1) faces +z, south bench faces -z
          seatedExtra(b, [x, 0, z], sd < 0 ? 0 : Math.PI, SHIRTS[Math.floor(rand() * SHIRTS.length)], PANTS[Math.floor(rand() * PANTS.length)], 200 + n++, true, 0.32);
        }
}

function buildProps(b: Batch) {
  // trash bins + tray return on the right wall
  const { x1 } = SCHOOL;
  for (const [z, c] of [[-1.6, '#3a4a7a'], [-0.9, '#2f9e5b']] as [number, string][]) {
    b.add('cyl', c, [x1 - 0.4, 0.42, z], [0.26, 0.84, 0.26]);
    b.add('cyl', '#2a2b33', [x1 - 0.4, 0.85, z], [0.27, 0.04, 0.27]);
  }
  b.box([x1 - 0.35, 0.45, 1.0], [0.7, 0.9, 1.8], '#b9bcc4');
  b.box([x1 - 0.35, 0.92, 1.0], [0.74, 0.05, 1.84], '#d9dbe0');
  [0.4, 0.75, 1.1, 1.45].forEach((z, i) => b.box([x1 - 0.35, 0.96 + i * 0.018, z], [0.4, 0.016, 0.28], ['#4e9a6b', '#e8742f', '#3d6fb6', '#e46f8e'][i]));
}

const drawMenu = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: number, H: number) => {
  g.fillStyle = '#1f2d55';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.fillStyle = '#f2b632';
  g.textAlign = 'center';
  g.textBaseline = 'middle';
  g.font = `800 ${H * 0.16}px ${BOLD_FONT}`;
  g.fillText('CARDÁPIO DE HOJE', W / 2, H * 0.14);
  const items: [string, string][] = [['PIZZA', '5,00'], ['MACARRÃO', '4,00'], ['SALADA', '3,50'], ['MAÇÃ', '1,00'], ['SUCO', '2,00']];
  g.font = `700 ${H * 0.1}px ${BOLD_FONT}`;
  items.forEach(([a, p], i) => {
    const y = H * (0.32 + i * 0.14);
    g.textAlign = 'left';
    g.fillStyle = '#f4f1ea';
    g.fillText(a, W * 0.08, y);
    g.textAlign = 'right';
    g.fillStyle = '#f2b632';
    g.fillText(p, W * 0.92, y);
  });
};

export const Cafeteria: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t, time, variant }) => {
  const night = isNight(time);
  const { x0, x1, z0 } = SCHOOL;
  return (
    <group>
      <SchoolShell night={night} windowsX={[-3.9, 3.9]} panelsX={[-3.0, 0, 3.0]} panelsZ={[-2.8, 0.2, 3.2]} />
      <Batched id="cafeteria-tables" build={buildTables} />
      {variant % 2 === 0 && <Batched id="cafeteria-extras" build={buildExtras} />}
      <Batched id="cafeteria-props" build={buildProps} />
      {/* back wall: menu board between the windows, clock */}
      <Box p={[0, 2.05, z0 + 0.03]} s={[2.5, 1.32, 0.06]} c="#2a2b33" />
      <Painted id="cafeteria-menu" p={[0, 2.05, z0 + 0.062]} w={2.36} h={1.2} draw={drawMenu} />
      <WallClock p={[-1.95, 2.55, z0 + 0.05]} s={0.7} t={t} />
      <TextPoster id="eat" p={[1.75, 2.0, z0]} w={0.55} h={0.75} text="COMA" bg="#7bc043" fg="#f4efe2" sub={'verduras\ntodo dia'} />
      {/* left wall: banner + posters + door */}
      <DotBanner p={[x0 + 0.005, 2.55, -1.0]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={3.6} />
      <Picture p={[x0 + 0.005, 1.8, 1.9]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={0.6} h={0.8} art="abstract" seed={7} frame="#2c3f6e" />
      <Door p={[x0, 0, 4.3]} r={Math.PI / 2} c="#2c3f6e" frame="#eef0f2" />
      <Door p={[x0, 0, -3.4]} r={Math.PI / 2} c="#2c3f6e" frame="#eef0f2" />
      {/* right wall */}
      <TextPoster id="wash" p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.85, -3.4]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.6} h={0.8} text="LAVE" bg="#3fb3c4" fg="#f4efe2" sub={'as\nmãos'} />
      <Picture p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.95, 3.2]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.8} h={0.6} art="dots" frame="#2c3f6e" />
      <LeafPlant p={[x1 - 0.5, 0, z0 + 0.5]} s={1.2} pot="#e8742f" seed={11} />
    </group>
  );
};

export const CAFETERIA_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, 0, 3.8],
  aisle: [0, 0, 0.4],
  seat1: [2.25, 0, 0.98],
  seat2: [-3.0, 0, 0.98],
  seat3: [3.0, 0, 2.22],
  seat4: [-2.25, 0, -1.42],
  menu: [0, 0, -4.0],
  bins: [4.9, 0, -1.25],
  window: [-3.9, 0, -4.2],
  door: [-5.4, 0, 4.3],
};
