@@@@ FILE src/sets/city.tsx | text-crlf | 19137 | 47529b438920bbd295c091d8768baae892561d84134c07b9a80603eab0cf2433
// Downtown street that tiles forever along X (like the suburb), IFOLOGY "10x Faster" downtown look:
// simple tall pastel-grey towers, shop fronts with striped awnings and signs, a wide 4-lane road with
// a zebra crossing every block, and (block k = 0 only) a parking lot with orange cones on the +z side.
//
// Layout (metres, y up):
//   road (asphalt, top y = 0)       |z| < 6, yellow double centre line, lane dashes at z = ±3
//   sidewalks (top y = 0.15)        6 < |z| < 10.5
//   building fronts                 |z| = 10.5 (shops on the ground floor, windows above)
//   zebra crossing                  x = k·40 + 12 (x ∈ [10, 14] in block 0)
//   parking lot (block 0, y = 0)    x ∈ [-18, 18], z ∈ [11, 32]; tall towers behind it at z ≥ 36
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { envMaterial, flat } from '../engine/materials';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import { At, Box, Car, Door, G, mix, rng, Sign } from './kit';
import {
  CityLamp, decalMaterial, facadeWindows, Hydrant, Inst, Instances, lampsOn, mapMaterial, nightness, ParkingSign, PlanterTree, TrafficCone, TrafficLight, TrashCan, WindowSet,
} from './outdoorKit';

export const CITY_SEG = 40;
const FRONT = 10.5; // building front line
const WALK_Y = 0.15; // sidewalk top
const CROSS_X = 12; // zebra crossing (local to block)
const STREET_POOLS: [number, number, number, number, number][] = [[0, -WALK_Y, 1.55, 3.4, 3.0], [0, 0, -1.5, 3.0, 1.75]];

const WALLS = ['#a9a7c2', '#c4bdd0', '#d6cbb8', '#9fb1c6', '#bfc6cf', '#d9bfae', '#b6b0a6', '#c9d2c0', '#e0d3bd', '#8f9ab3'];
const TOWERS = ['#9c9ab8', '#b3b0c9', '#a6b4c6', '#c2bccd', '#8e98b0', '#bdb6c4'];
const SHOPS = ['CAFE', 'PIZZA', 'BOOKS', 'BAKERY', 'FLOWERS', 'DONUTS', 'MARKET', 'SHOES', 'TOYS', 'DINER', 'BURGERS', 'GYM', 'SUSHI', 'TACOS', 'NOODLES', 'DELI', 'ARCADE', 'ICE CREAM'];
const SIGN_BG = ['#1f2a44', '#b8342c', '#2f6b4f', '#f4ead6', '#5a3d8a', '#d9822b', '#2d63b8'];
const AWNINGS: [string, string][] = [['#d8433a', '#f6f1e6'], ['#2f7a5a', '#f6f1e6'], ['#2d63b8', '#f6f1e6'], ['#f2b632', '#f6f1e6'], ['#7a4fa0', '#f6f1e6'], ['#e46f8e', '#f6f1e6'], ['#20283c', '#e9c46a']];
const CARS = ['#c8402f', '#3d6fb6', '#e9e4da', '#2b2f3a', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b', '#e9e4da'];

// Striped canvas texture for awnings (cached by colours/count).
const stripeCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
function stripes(a: string, b: string, n: number) {
  const key = `${a}${b}${n}`;
  let t = stripeCache.get(key);
  if (!t) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 64 * n;
    c.height = 8;
    const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? b : a;
      g.fillRect(i * 64, 0, 64, 8);
    }
    t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    t.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
    stripeCache.set(key, t);
  }
  return t;
}

const AW_TILT = 0.32;
/** Striped awning (local: wall at z = 0, top edge at y = 0, projects to +z). */
const Awning: React.FC<{ w: number; cols: [string, string] }> = ({ w, cols }) => {
  const n = Math.max(4, Math.round(w / 0.55) | 1);
  const m = mapMaterial(stripes(cols[0], cols[1], n));
  const d = 1.45;
  const yF = -Math.sin(AW_TILT) * d, zF = Math.cos(AW_TILT) * d;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={G.box} material={m} position={[0, yF / 2, zF / 2]} rotation={[AW_TILT, 0, 0]} scale={[w, 0.05, d]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={G.box} material={m} position={[0, yF - 0.16, zF]} scale={[w, 0.32, 0.04]} castShadow receiveShadow />
    </group>
  );
};

/** Ground-floor shop (local: facade plane z = 0, facing +z). */
const ShopFront: React.FC<{ w: number; seed: number; night: boolean; wall: string }> = ({ w, seed, night, wall }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed * 17 + 5);
  const name = SHOPS[Math.floor(rand() * SHOPS.length)];
  const bg = SIGN_BG[Math.floor(rand() * SIGN_BG.length)];
  const fg = bg === '#f4ead6' ? '#2a2f45' : '#ffffff';
  const aw = AWNINGS[Math.floor(rand() * AWNINGS.length)];
  const hasAwning = rand() < 0.75;
  const doorLeft = rand() < 0.5;
  const sw = w - 0.8; // usable width
  const dx = (doorLeft ? -1 : 1) * (sw / 2 - 0.75);
  const gw = sw - 1.9, gx = doorLeft ? 0.95 : -0.95; // display glass
  const frame = mix(wall, '#2a2a33', 0.55);
  const glass = night ? '#ffd890' : '#a9cbe0';
  const signW = Math.min(sw * 0.62, 1.0 + name.length * 0.42);
  return (
    <group>
      {/* display window on a low plinth */}
      <Box p={[gx, 0.25, 0.07]} s={[gw + 0.2, 0.5, 0.14]} c={frame} />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={night ? flat(glass) : envMaterial(glass)} position={[gx, 1.775, 0.03]} scale={[gw, 2.45, 1]} receiveShadow={!night} />
      {!night && (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={flat('#ffffff', 0.35)} position={[gx - gw * 0.22, 1.85, 0.04]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.7]} scale={[0.16, 1.5, 1]} />
          <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={flat('#ffffff', 0.3)} position={[gx - gw * 0.22 + 0.32, 1.8, 0.04]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.7]} scale={[0.07, 1.2, 1]} />
        </>
      )}
      <Box p={[gx, 3.03, 0.06]} s={[gw + 0.2, 0.1, 0.12]} c={frame} />
      <Box p={[gx - gw / 2, 1.775, 0.06]} s={[0.1, 2.55, 0.12]} c={frame} />
      <Box p={[gx + gw / 2, 1.775, 0.06]} s={[0.1, 2.55, 0.12]} c={frame} />
      {gw > 3.4 && <Box p={[gx, 1.775, 0.06]} s={[0.07, 2.45, 0.08]} c={frame} />}
      {/* door: glass panel in a dark frame */}
      <Door p={[dx, 0.0, 0.0]} c={night ? '#e9b65a' : mix(frame, '#8fb3cc', 0.45)} frame={frame} />
      {/* sign band */}
      <Box p={[0, 3.75, 0.1]} s={[sw + 0.3, 0.95, 0.2]} c={mix(wall, '#000', 0.12)} />
      <Sign p={[0, 3.75, 0.205]} w={signW} h={0.72} text={name} bg={bg} fg={fg} />
      {hasAwning && (
        <group position={[gx, 3.18, 0.0]}>
          <Awning w={gw + 0.4} cols={aw} />
        </group>
      )}
    </group>
  );
};

type Bld = { x: number; w: number; h: number; d: number; c: string; seed: number; shop: boolean; setback: boolean };

/** Lay buildings shoulder to shoulder across one block side. */
function packBlock(x0: number, seed: number, hMin: number, hMax: number, shop = true): Bld[] {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const out: Bld[] = [];
  let x = x0 - CITY_SEG / 2;
  const end = x0 + CITY_SEG / 2;
  let i = 0;
  while (x < end - 0.5) {
    let w = 7 + Math.floor(rand() * 4) * 2;
    if (end - (x + w) < 6) w = end - x;
    const h = hMin + Math.floor(rand() * ((hMax - hMin) / 3.2 + 1)) * 3.2;
    out.push({ x: x + w / 2, w, h, d: 14, c: WALLS[Math.floor(rand() * WALLS.length)], seed: seed * 10 + i, shop, setback: h > 24 && rand() < 0.6 });
    x += w;
    i++;
  }
  return out;
}

/** One building (local: facade at z = 0 facing +z, body to -d). Windows are emitted separately. */
const CityBuilding: React.FC<{ b: Bld; night: boolean }> = ({ b, night }) => {
  const trim = mix(b.c, '#ffffff', 0.35);
  return (
    <group>
      <Box p={[0, b.h / 2, -b.d / 2]} s={[b.w, b.h, b.d]} c={b.c} />
      <Box p={[0, b.h + 0.22, -b.d / 2 + 0.1]} s={[b.w, 0.44, b.d + 0.2]} c={mix(b.c, '#000', 0.18)} />
      <Box p={[0, 4.62, 0.1]} s={[b.w, 0.22, 0.2]} c={trim} />
      {b.setback && (
        <>
          <Box p={[0, b.h + 3.6, -b.d / 2]} s={[b.w * 0.66, 7.2, b.d * 0.66]} c={mix(b.c, '#ffffff', 0.1)} />
          <Box p={[0, b.h + 7.4, -b.d / 2]} s={[b.w * 0.66 + 0.2, 0.4, b.d * 0.66 + 0.2]} c={mix(b.c, '#000', 0.18)} />
        </>
      )}
      {b.shop && <group position={[0, WALK_Y, 0]}><ShopFront w={b.w} seed={b.seed} night={night} wall={b.c} /></group>}
    </group>
  );
};

/** Background tower (facade at local z = 0 facing +z). */
const Tower: React.FC<{ w: number; h: number; d: number; c: string; crown?: boolean; lit: boolean }> = ({ w, h, d, c, crown, lit }) => (
  <group>
    <Box p={[0, h / 2, -d / 2]} s={[w, h, d]} c={c} shadow={false} />
    <Box p={[0, h + 0.3, -d / 2]} s={[w + 0.4, 0.6, d + 0.4]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.18)} shadow={false} />
    {crown && (
      <>
        <Box p={[0, h + 2.5, -d / 2]} s={[w * 0.5, 4, d * 0.5]} c={mix(c, '#ffffff', 0.12)} shadow={false} />
        <Box p={[0, h + 7, -d / 2]} s={[0.25, 6, 0.25]} c="#5b5e6c" shadow={false} />
        <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={lit ? flat('#ff4a3a') : envMaterial('#c84a3a')} position={[0, h + 10.1, -d / 2]} scale={0.22} />
      </>
    )}
  </group>
);

/** A block side: street buildings + background towers, with all their windows instanced. */
const BlockSide: React.FC<{ k: number; side: 1 | -1; time: string; lot?: boolean }> = React.memo(({ k, side, time, lot }) => {
  const x0 = k * CITY_SEG;
  const n = nightness(time);
  const night = n > 0.3; // shop windows lit from golden hour on
  const litFrac = n >= 1 ? 0.5 : n >= 0.75 ? 0.38 : n > 0.3 ? 0.14 : 0;
  const seed = Math.abs(k * 7919 + (side > 0 ? 3 : 11));
  // back side (side = -1, z < 0) is the detailed "hero" side with taller buildings
  const blds = lot ? [] : side < 0 ? packBlock(x0, seed, 11.2, 33.6) : packBlock(x0, seed, 8, 14.4);
  const rand = rng(seed + 5);
  const towers: { x: number; z: number; w: number; h: number; d: number; c: string; crown: boolean }[] = [];
  if (lot) {
    // tall grey backdrop behind the parking lot (fixed so the lot shot is always the same)
    towers.push({ x: x0 - 13, z: 37, w: 16, h: 52.8, d: 16, c: TOWERS[0], crown: false });
    towers.push({ x: x0 + 3, z: 46, w: 18, h: 72, d: 16, c: TOWERS[2], crown: true });
    towers.push({ x: x0 + 15, z: 37, w: 14, h: 43.2, d: 16, c: TOWERS[3], crown: false });
    towers.push({ x: x0 - 1, z: 38, w: 12, h: 33.6, d: 14, c: TOWERS[5], crown: false });
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const w = 14 + rand() * 6;
      towers.push({ x: x0 - 10 + i * 20 + (rand() - 0.5) * 4, z: 44 + i * 9 + rand() * 6, w, h: 36 + Math.floor(rand() * 10) * 4.8, d: 16, c: TOWERS[Math.floor(rand() * TOWERS.length)], crown: rand() < 0.35 });
    }
  }
  const ry = side < 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
  const zw = (dist: number) => (side < 0 ? -dist : dist);
  const lit: Inst[] = [], dark: Inst[] = [];
  blds.forEach(b => {
    facadeWindows({ x: b.x, z: zw(FRONT), ry, w: b.w - 0.6, h: b.h, y0: 5.3, wall: b.c, seed: b.seed }, litFrac, lit, dark);
    if (b.setback) facadeWindows({ x: b.x, z: zw(FRONT + b.d * 0.17), ry, w: b.w * 0.66 - 0.6, h: b.h + 7.2, y0: b.h + 0.9, wall: b.c, seed: b.seed + 1 }, litFrac, lit, dark);
  });
  towers.forEach((t, i) => facadeWindows({ x: t.x, z: zw(t.z), ry, w: t.w - 1, h: t.h, y0: 2, col: 2.6, floor: 3.6, ww: 1.6, wh: 2.2, off: 0.08, wall: t.c, seed: seed + 100 + i }, litFrac * 1.1, lit, dark, '#9ab3cf'));
  return (
    <group>
      {blds.map((b, i) => (
        <At key={i} p={[b.x, 0, zw(FRONT)]} r={ry}>
          <CityBuilding b={b} night={night} />
        </At>
      ))}
      {towers.map((t, i) => (
        <At key={'t' + i} p={[t.x, 0, zw(t.z)]} r={ry}>
          <Tower w={t.w} h={t.h} d={t.d} c={t.c} crown={t.crown} lit={night} />
        </At>
      ))}
      <WindowSet lit={lit} dark={dark} k={`${k}|${side}|${time}|${lot ? 1 : 0}`} />
    </group>
  );
});

/** Parking lot (block 0, +z side). Stalls in two rows facing an aisle; cones in the aisle. */
const ParkingLot: React.FC<{ night: boolean }> = React.memo(({ night }) => {
  const rand = rng(77);
  const lines: Inst[] = [];
  const cars: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const rows = [{ z0: 11.4, z1: 16.8, face: 1 }, { z0: 25.6, z1: 31.0, face: -1 }];
  rows.forEach((row, ri) => {
    for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
      const x = -16.8 + i * 2.8;
      lines.push({ p: [x, 0.006, (row.z0 + row.z1) / 2], s: [0.12, 0.012, row.z1 - row.z0] });
      if (i < 12 && rand() < (ri === 0 ? 0.42 : 0.6)) {
        const cx = x + 1.4;
        if (ri === 0 && Math.abs(cx) < 4) continue; // keep the camera lane open
        cars.push(<Car key={`${ri}-${i}`} p={[cx, 0, (row.z0 + row.z1) / 2 + row.face * 0.2]} r={row.face > 0 ? Math.PI : 0} c={CARS[Math.floor(rand() * CARS.length)]} />);
      }
    }
    lines.push({ p: [0, 0.006, row.face > 0 ? row.z0 : row.z1], s: [33.6, 0.012, 0.12] });
  });
  // arrows/aisle edge line
  lines.push({ p: [0, 0.006, 21.2], s: [30, 0.012, 0.12] });
  const cones: Vec3[] = [[-2.6, 0, 19.0], [-0.6, 0, 18.6], [1.6, 0, 19.2], [3.6, 0, 18.8], [5.8, 0, 19.4], [8.2, 0, 23.4], [9.4, 0, 22.2]];
  return (
    <group>
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#efece4')} items={() => lines} k="lotlines" />
      {cars}
      {cones.map((p, i) => <TrafficCone key={i} p={p} r={i * 0.7} />)}
      {/* lot lights */}
      {[-11, 11].map(x => (
        <group key={x}>
          <CityLamp p={[x, 0, 21.2]} r={0} on={night} />
          <CityLamp p={[x, 0, 21.2]} r={Math.PI} on={night} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* back wall with a strip of hedge */}
      <Box p={[0, 0.45, 33.2]} s={[40, 0.9, 0.4]} c="#b9b2a6" />
      <Box p={[0, 0.94, 33.2]} s={[40.2, 0.08, 0.5]} c="#d6d0c4" />
      {/* side kerbs */}
      {[-19.6, 19.6].map(x => <Box key={x} p={[x, 0.08, 21.8]} s={[0.4, 0.16, 22.6]} c="#c9c3b6" />)}
      {/* pay booth */}
      <At p={[16.5, 0, 21.2]}>
        <Box p={[0, 1.3, 0]} s={[2.0, 2.6, 2.0]} c="#e9e2d2" />
        <Box p={[0, 2.68, 0]} s={[2.4, 0.16, 2.4]} c="#2f5f8a" />
        <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={night ? flat('#ffd890') : envMaterial('#a9cbe0')} position={[-1.005, 1.6, 0]} rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[1.4, 1.0, 1]} />
        <Box p={[-1.05, 1.05, 0]} s={[0.12, 0.08, 1.5]} c="#c9c3b6" />
      </At>
      <ParkingSign p={[-17.5, 0, 11.6]} r={0} />
    </group>
  );
});

/** One 40 m block: road, sidewalks, furniture, both building rows. */
const Block: React.FC<{ k: number; time: string }> = React.memo(({ k, time }) => {
  const x0 = k * CITY_SEG;
  const xs = x0 - CITY_SEG / 2;
  const rand = rng(Math.abs(k * 131 + 17));
  const night = lampsOn(time);
  const marks: Inst[] = []; // white road paint
  const yellow: Inst[] = [];
  const cx = x0 + CROSS_X;
  // centre double line + lane dashes, broken at the crossing
  [[xs, cx - 2.6], [cx + 2.6, xs + CITY_SEG]].forEach(([a, b]) => {
    [-0.14, 0.14].forEach(z => yellow.push({ p: [(a + b) / 2, 0.006, z], s: [b - a, 0.012, 0.12] }));
    [-3, 3].forEach(z => {
      for (let x = Math.ceil(a / 6) * 6; x + 3 <= b; x += 6) marks.push({ p: [x + 1.5, 0.006, z], s: [3, 0.012, 0.13] });
    });
    [-5.6, 5.6].forEach(z => marks.push({ p: [(a + b) / 2, 0.006, z], s: [b - a, 0.012, 0.13] }));
  });
  // zebra
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) marks.push({ p: [cx, 0.007, -5.1 + i * 1.133], s: [4, 0.014, 0.6] });
  marks.push({ p: [cx - 2.9, 0.006, -3], s: [0.4, 0.012, 5.8] });
  marks.push({ p: [cx + 2.9, 0.006, 3], s: [0.4, 0.012, 5.8] });
  // sidewalk joints
  const joints: Inst[] = [];
  [-1, 1].forEach(sd => {
    for (let i = 0; i < CITY_SEG / 2.5; i++) joints.push({ p: [xs + i * 2.5, WALK_Y + 0.002, sd * 8.3], s: [0.04, 0.004, 4.3] });
    joints.push({ p: [x0, WALK_Y + 0.002, sd * 6.75], s: [CITY_SEG, 0.004, 0.04] });
  });
  const parked: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  [-1, 1].forEach(sd => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const x = xs + 4 + i * 12 + rand() * 4;
      if (Math.abs(x - cx) < 5) continue;
      if (k === 0 && sd < 0 && x < 9) continue; // keep the hero sidewalk + down-street cam clear
      if (rand() < 0.55) parked.push(<Car key={`${sd}${i}`} p={[x, 0, sd * 4.35]} r={sd < 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2} c={CARS[Math.floor(rand() * CARS.length)]} />);
    }
  });
  const moving = k !== 0 && rand() < 0.4 ? <Car p={[x0 + (rand() - 0.5) * 20, 0, rand() < 0.5 ? -1.5 : 1.5]} r={Math.PI / 2} c={CARS[Math.floor(rand() * CARS.length)]} /> : null;
  return (
    <group>
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#f1eee6')} items={() => marks} k={`m${k}`} />
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#f0c33c')} items={() => yellow} k={`y${k}`} />
      {/* sidewalks + kerbs */}
      {[-1, 1].map(sd => (
        <group key={sd}>
          <Box p={[x0, WALK_Y / 2, sd * 8.25]} s={[CITY_SEG, WALK_Y, 4.5]} c="#cfc8bb" shadow={false} />
          <Box p={[x0, WALK_Y / 2 + 0.006, sd * 6.075]} s={[CITY_SEG, WALK_Y, 0.25]} c="#e2ddd2" shadow={false} />
        </group>
      ))}
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#aaa293')} items={() => joints} k={`j${k}`} receive />
      {/* street furniture, back (-z) side */}
      <CityLamp p={[x0 - 14, WALK_Y, -6.7]} on={night} pools={STREET_POOLS} />
      <CityLamp p={[x0 + 4, WALK_Y, -6.7]} on={night} pools={STREET_POOLS} />
      <PlanterTree p={[x0 - 5, WALK_Y, -7.1]} s={0.95} />
      <PlanterTree p={[x0 + 20 - 1.5, WALK_Y, -7.1]} s={1.0} leaf="#4f9b45" />
      <Hydrant p={[x0 - 9, WALK_Y, -6.7]} />
      <TrashCan p={[x0 + 5.2, WALK_Y, -6.9]} />
      <TrafficLight p={[cx - 2.6, WALK_Y, -6.5]} r={0} state={rand() < 0.5 ? 'red' : 'green'} />
      {/* front (+z) side */}
      <CityLamp p={[x0 - 4, WALK_Y, 6.7]} r={Math.PI} on={night} pools={STREET_POOLS} />
      <CityLamp p={[x0 + 16, WALK_Y, 6.7]} r={Math.PI} on={night} pools={STREET_POOLS} />
      {k !== 0 && <PlanterTree p={[x0 + 6, WALK_Y, 7.1]} s={0.9} leaf="#62ad4f" />}
      <PlanterTree p={[x0 - 14, WALK_Y, 7.1]} s={0.95} />
      <TrafficLight p={[cx + 2.6, WALK_Y, 6.5]} r={Math.PI} state="green" />
      {parked}
      {moving}
      <BlockSide k={k} side={-1} time={time} />
      <BlockSide k={k} side={1} time={time} lot={k === 0} />
      {k === 0 && <ParkingLot night={night} />}
    </group>
  );
});

export const City: React.FC<{ centerX?: number; behind?: number; ahead?: number; time: string }> = ({ centerX = 0, behind = 90, ahead = 110, time }) => {
  const k0 = Math.round((centerX - behind) / CITY_SEG), k1 = Math.round((centerX + ahead) / CITY_SEG);
  const blocks: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) blocks.push(<Block key={k} k={k} time={time} />);
  return (
    <group>
      {blocks}
      {/* asphalt ground under everything (road + lot) */}
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#3f4350')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[centerX, 0, 0]} scale={[1200, 600, 1]} receiveShadow />
    </group>
  );
};

export const CitySet: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ center, time }) => <City centerX={center[0]} time={time} />;

export const CITY_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, WALK_Y, -8], // back sidewalk in front of the shops, facing the road (+z)
  shop: [-2, WALK_Y, -9.6], // right at a shop window
  corner: [8.6, WALK_Y, -7.2], // by the traffic light at the crossing
  crosswalk: [12, 0, 0], // middle of the zebra crossing
  road: [0, 0, -1.6], // inner lane (+x traffic side)
  farSidewalk: [0, WALK_Y, 8.2],
  parking: [0, 0, 21.2], // parking-lot aisle
  cones: [1.6, 0, 20.4], // just behind the line of cones
};

// School classroom in IFOLOGY "Stop Time" colours: navy lower walls, white rail, yellow upper
// walls, grey checker floor, light panels. The whiteboard is on the LEFT wall (x=-6) and the
// 4×5 grid of desks faces it (students look -x), so a camera on the open +z side sees the class
// in cross-section, a camera by the board sees faces, and a camera behind the desks sees the board.
// Room x∈[-6,6], back wall z=-5 (windows), ceiling 3.2, one-sided fourth wall at z=6.
// variant even = seated extras fill most desks; variant odd = empty classroom.
import React from 'react';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { At, Box, Chair, Door, G, WallClock, mix, rng } from './kit';
import { envMaterial } from '../engine/materials';
import {
  Batch, Batched, BOLD_FONT, CeilingPanel, checkerFloor, HAND_FONT, isNight, LeafPlant, Painted, Picture, Pinboard, RoomWindow, seatedExtra, Shell,
} from './roomkit';

export const SCHOOL = { x0: -6, x1: 6, z0: -5, z1: 6, h: 3.2 };
export const NAVY = '#3f5c9c';
export const YELLOW = '#efcd72';
export const SHIRTS = ['#2f9e5b', '#e8742f', '#3d6fb6', '#c43c8f', '#f2b632', '#ece6da', '#7a7fd0', '#3fb3c4', '#7bc043'];
export const PANTS = ['#2b2f3d', '#3a4a7a', '#4a3a2a', '#2f3f5f'];

/** Navy/yellow school room shell + floor + windows + ceiling panels (shared with the cafeteria). */
export const SchoolShell: React.FC<{ night: boolean; windowsX: number[]; panelsX: number[]; panelsZ: number[] }> = ({ night, windowsX, panelsX, panelsZ }) => {
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1, h } = SCHOOL;
  return (
    <>
      <Batched id="school-floor" build={b => checkerFloor(b, x0, x1, z0, z1, 0.6, '#cfd1d6', '#aeb2bb')} />
      <Shell x0={x0} x1={x1} z0={z0} z1={z1} h={h} wall={YELLOW} lower={NAVY} railY={1.15} rail="#eef0f2" base="#2c3f6e" ceiling="#ecebe6" ceilingEmissive={night ? '#2c2c2c' : '#9a9994'} fourth />
      {windowsX.map((x, i) => (
        <RoomWindow key={i} p={[x, 2.0, z0]} w={2.0} h={1.45} cols={3} night={night} seed={i + 1} frame="#eef0f2" />
      ))}
      {panelsX.map(x => panelsZ.map(z => <CeilingPanel key={`${x}|${z}`} p={[x, h, z]} w={1.3} d={0.62} />))}
    </>
  );
};

/** Red banner with coloured dots (from the Stop Time cafeteria). Local +z out of the wall. */
export const DotBanner: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 3.0 }) => {
  const cols = ['#f4efe2', '#3d8fd6', '#f2b632', '#f4efe2', '#e46f8e', '#7bc043', '#f4efe2'];
  const n = Math.max(3, Math.round(w / 0.45));
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, 0, 0.015]} s={[w, 0.5, 0.03]} c="#c8364a" />
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial(cols[i % cols.length])} position={[-w / 2 + (i + 0.5) * (w / n), 0, 0.032]} scale={0.14} receiveShadow />
      ))}
    </At>
  );
};

export const TextPoster: React.FC<{ id: string; p: Vec3; r?: number; w: number; h: number; text: string; bg: string; fg: string; sub?: string }> = ({ id, p, r = 0, w, h, text, bg, fg, sub }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0, 0.008]} s={[w + 0.04, h + 0.04, 0.016]} c="#f4f1ea" />
    <Painted
      id={`poster-${id}`}
      p={[0, 0, 0.018]}
      w={w}
      h={h}
      draw={(g, W, H) => {
        g.fillStyle = bg;
        g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        g.fillStyle = fg;
        g.textAlign = 'center';
        g.textBaseline = 'middle';
        g.font = `800 ${Math.min(H * 0.3, (W * 1.5) / text.length)}px ${BOLD_FONT}`;
        g.fillText(text, W / 2, sub ? H * 0.32 : H / 2);
        if (sub) {
          g.font = `600 ${H * 0.11}px ${BOLD_FONT}`;
          sub.split('\n').forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, W / 2, H * (0.62 + i * 0.14)));
        }
      }}
    />
  </At>
);

const drawBoard = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: number, H: number) => {
  g.fillStyle = '#f8f8f4';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,175,195,0.12)';
  g.beginPath();
  g.ellipse(W * 0.55, H * 0.6, W * 0.2, H * 0.3, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  g.fill();
  g.textAlign = 'left';
  g.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  g.fillStyle = '#2a55b8';
  g.font = `bold ${H * 0.16}px ${HAND_FONT}`;
  g.fillText('VULCÕES!', W * 0.05, H * 0.24);
  g.strokeStyle = '#2a55b8';
  g.lineWidth = H * 0.012;
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(W * 0.05, H * 0.29);
  g.bezierCurveTo(W * 0.2, H * 0.27, W * 0.35, H * 0.31, W * 0.52, H * 0.28);
  g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle = '#2a2b33';
  g.font = `${H * 0.11}px ${HAND_FONT}`;
  g.fillText('magma → lava → rocha', W * 0.07, H * 0.5);
  g.fillStyle = '#2f8f4e';
  g.fillText('1.200 °C  (muito quente)', W * 0.07, H * 0.7);
  g.fillStyle = '#d23a3a';
  g.fillText('x 10 = ?', W * 0.07, H * 0.88);
  // red clock doodle
  const cx = W * 0.8, cy = H * 0.48, rr = H * 0.26;
  g.strokeStyle = '#d23a3a';
  g.lineWidth = H * 0.018;
  g.beginPath();
  g.arc(cx, cy, rr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  g.stroke();
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(cx, cy);
  g.lineTo(cx, cy - rr * 0.7);
  g.moveTo(cx, cy);
  g.lineTo(cx + rr * 0.5, cy + rr * 0.15);
  g.stroke();
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(cx + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.82, cy - Math.cos(a) * rr * 0.82);
    g.lineTo(cx + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.92, cy - Math.cos(a) * rr * 0.92);
    g.stroke();
  }
  // stick-figure doodle
  g.strokeStyle = '#2a2b33';
  g.lineWidth = H * 0.012;
  const sx = W * 0.6, sy = H * 0.62;
  g.beginPath();
  g.arc(sx, sy, H * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  g.moveTo(sx, sy + H * 0.05);
  g.lineTo(sx, sy + H * 0.2);
  g.moveTo(sx - H * 0.08, sy + H * 0.1);
  g.lineTo(sx + H * 0.08, sy + H * 0.1);
  g.moveTo(sx, sy + H * 0.2);
  g.lineTo(sx - H * 0.06, sy + H * 0.3);
  g.moveTo(sx, sy + H * 0.2);
  g.lineTo(sx + H * 0.06, sy + H * 0.3);
  g.stroke();
};

const drawMap = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: number, H: number) => {
  g.fillStyle = '#86c5ea';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)';
  g.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo((i * W) / 6, 0);
    g.lineTo((i * W) / 6, H);
    g.stroke();
  }
  for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(0, (i * H) / 4);
    g.lineTo(W, (i * H) / 4);
    g.stroke();
  }
  const land = (pts: [number, number, number, number][], c: string) => {
    g.fillStyle = c;
    pts.forEach(([x, y, rx, ry]) => {
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(x * W, y * H, rx * W, ry * H, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    });
  };
  land([[0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.12], [0.25, 0.45, 0.05, 0.1], [0.28, 0.68, 0.05, 0.14]], '#7bc043');
  land([[0.5, 0.3, 0.06, 0.1], [0.52, 0.55, 0.07, 0.16]], '#f2b632');
  land([[0.7, 0.3, 0.14, 0.13], [0.82, 0.72, 0.06, 0.07]], '#e46f8e');
};

function buildDesks(b: Batch) {
  const rand = rng(77);
  const top = '#efe6d3', metal = '#34405f', seat = '#3b5fa8';
  for (const xs of SEAT_X)
    for (const zs of SEAT_Z)
      b.at([xs, 0, zs], -Math.PI / 2, () => {
        // chair (student faces local +z)
        b.box([0, 0.45, 0], [0.44, 0.04, 0.42], seat);
        b.box([0, 0.8, -0.21], [0.44, 0.3, 0.035], seat, [-0.08, 0, 0]);
        for (const [x, z] of [[-0.19, -0.18], [0.19, -0.18], [-0.19, 0.18], [0.19, 0.18]]) b.box([x, 0.22, z], [0.03, 0.45, 0.03], metal);
        b.box([-0.19, 0.64, -0.2], [0.03, 0.36, 0.03], metal);
        b.box([0.19, 0.64, -0.2], [0.03, 0.36, 0.03], metal);
        // desk
        b.box([0, 0.74, 0.47], [0.72, 0.04, 0.52], top);
        b.box([0, 0.6, 0.5], [0.64, 0.02, 0.4], metal, 0, { cast: false });
        for (const [x, z] of [[-0.32, 0.25], [0.32, 0.25], [-0.32, 0.69], [0.32, 0.69]]) b.box([x, 0.36, z], [0.035, 0.72, 0.035], metal);
        // a few things on desks
        const k = rand();
        if (k < 0.35) {
          b.box([-0.08, 0.766, 0.5], [0.3, 0.012, 0.22], '#f8f6f0', [0, 0.15, 0], { cast: false });
          b.box([0.15, 0.768, 0.5], [0.012, 0.012, 0.16], '#2a55b8', [0, 0.4, 0], { cast: false });
        } else if (k < 0.65) {
          b.box([0.1, 0.775, 0.48], [0.2, 0.03, 0.26], SHIRTS[Math.floor(rand() * SHIRTS.length)], [0, -0.2, 0]);
        } else if (k < 0.8) {
          b.box([-0.12, 0.765, 0.45], [0.22, 0.01, 0.28], '#f8f6f0', [0, -0.1, 0], { cast: false });
        }
      });
}

export const SEAT_X = [-1.6, 0.2, 2.0, 3.8];
export const SEAT_Z = [-3.4, -1.7, 0, 1.7, 3.4];
const FREE = new Set(['0.2|1.7', '2|1.7', '0.2|0']);

function buildExtras(b: Batch) {
  const rand = rng(31);
  let n = 0;
  for (const xs of SEAT_X)
    for (const zs of SEAT_Z) {
      const fill = rand() < 0.75;
      if (FREE.has(`${xs}|${zs}`) || !fill) continue;
      seatedExtra(b, [xs, 0, zs], -Math.PI / 2, SHIRTS[Math.floor(rand() * SHIRTS.length)], PANTS[Math.floor(rand() * PANTS.length)], n++);
    }
}

function buildTeacherArea(b: Batch) {
  // teacher's desk, front panel faces the class (+x)
  b.at([-4.3, 0, 2.2], Math.PI / 2, () => {
    const wood = '#b98a5e';
    b.box([0, 0.76, 0], [1.5, 0.05, 0.75], wood);
    b.box([0, 0.4, 0.33], [1.46, 0.66, 0.04], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.12));
    b.box([-0.71, 0.37, 0], [0.04, 0.74, 0.7], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.2));
    b.box([0.71, 0.37, 0], [0.04, 0.74, 0.7], mix(wood, '#000000', 0.2));
    // apple, books, papers, globe
    b.add('sphere', '#d9332b', [0.5, 0.84, 0.15], 0.05);
    b.box([0.5, 0.9, 0.15], [0.008, 0.03, 0.008], '#5b3d2e');
    b.box([-0.45, 0.8, -0.05], [0.28, 0.04, 0.36], '#3d6fb6', 0.1);
    b.box([-0.45, 0.84, -0.05], [0.26, 0.04, 0.34], '#e8742f', -0.12);
    b.box([0.05, 0.79, 0.0], [0.3, 0.01, 0.22], '#f8f6f0', 0.3, { cast: false });
    b.add('cyl', '#3a3438', [0.0, 0.8, -0.22], [0.08, 0.02, 0.08]);
    b.add('cyl', '#3a3438', [0.0, 0.88, -0.22], [0.012, 0.16, 0.012]);
    b.add('sphere', '#3d8fd6', [0.0, 1.06, -0.22], 0.13);
    b.add('ico', '#7bc043', [0.07, 1.1, -0.15], [0.07, 0.06, 0.05]);
    b.add('ico', '#7bc043', [-0.06, 1.0, -0.13], [0.05, 0.06, 0.05]);
  });
  // whiteboard frame + tray on the left wall (board face drawn separately)
  b.at([SCHOOL.x0, 0, -0.6], Math.PI / 2, () => {
    b.box([0, 1.6, 0.025], [4.36, 1.42, 0.05], '#b9bcc4');
    b.box([0, 0.86, 0.08], [3.2, 0.035, 0.12], '#b9bcc4');
    ['#d23a3a', '#2a55b8', '#2f8f4e'].forEach((c, i) => b.add('cyl', c, [-0.4 + i * 0.16, 0.893, 0.09], [0.012, 0.12, 0.012], [0, 0, Math.PI / 2]));
    b.box([0.6, 0.895, 0.09], [0.14, 0.035, 0.06], '#2a2b33');
  });
  // cubbies with coloured bins on the right wall (open side faces -x)
  b.at([SCHOOL.x1, 0, -1.6], -Math.PI / 2, () => {
    const wood = '#d8b27c';
    b.box([0, 0.46, 0.2], [2.6, 0.92, 0.4], wood);
    const bins = ['#d94040', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#2f9e5b', '#e8742f', '#3fb3c4'];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++)
      for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) b.box([-1.08 + i * 0.432, 0.25 + j * 0.42, 0.33], [0.38, 0.33, 0.16], bins[(i + j * 3) % 6]);
    // trash bin by the cubbies
    b.add('cyl', '#3a4a7a', [1.65, 0.33, 0.3], [0.2, 0.66, 0.2]);
  });
}

export const Classroom: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t, time, variant }) => {
  const night = isNight(time);
  const { x0, x1, z0 } = SCHOOL;
  return (
    <group>
      <SchoolShell night={night} windowsX={[-3.4, 0.4, 4.0]} panelsX={[-3.2, 0.6, 4.0]} panelsZ={[-2.8, 0.2, 3.2]} />
      <Batched id="classroom-desks" build={buildDesks} />
      {variant % 2 === 0 && <Batched id="classroom-extras" build={buildExtras} />}
      <Batched id="classroom-teacher" build={buildTeacherArea} />
      {/* board face, clock, door, posters (left wall faces +x) */}
      <Painted id="classroom-board" p={[x0 + 0.052, 1.6, -0.6]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={4.2} h={1.28} draw={drawBoard} />
      <WallClock p={[x0 + 0.05, 2.72, -0.6]} r={Math.PI / 2} s={0.75} t={t} />
      <Door p={[x0, 0, 4.2]} r={Math.PI / 2} c="#2c3f6e" frame="#eef0f2" />
      <TextPoster id="read" p={[x0 + 0.005, 1.85, -3.75]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={0.7} h={0.95} text="LEIA!" bg="#f2b632" fg="#2c3f6e" sub={'todo dia\ntoda noite'} />
      <Chair p={[-4.95, 0, 2.2]} r={Math.PI / 2} c="#2c3f6e" />
      {/* right wall: banner, pin board, map, posters */}
      <DotBanner p={[x1 - 0.005, 2.62, -1.6]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={3.0} />
      <Painted id="classroom-map" p={[x1 - 0.03, 1.85, 1.6]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={1.7} h={1.05} draw={drawMap} />
      <Box p={[x1 - 0.0125, 1.85, 1.6]} s={[0.025, 1.13, 1.78]} c="#2a2b33" />
      <Pinboard p={[x1, 1.75, 3.9]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={1.3} h={0.9} seed={4} />
      <TextPoster id="science" p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.75, -4.1]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.62} h={0.85} text="CIÊNCIAS" bg="#3fb3c4" fg="#f4efe2" sub={'pergunte por quê'} />
      {/* back wall between windows */}
      <Picture p={[-1.5, 2.05, z0]} w={0.55} h={0.75} art="dots" frame="#2c3f6e" />
      <TextPoster id="math" p={[2.2, 2.05, z0]} r={0} w={0.6} h={0.8} text="MATEMÁTICA" bg="#e46f8e" fg="#f4efe2" sub={'1 + 1 = 2'} />
      <LeafPlant p={[-5.4, 0, z0 + 0.5]} s={1.3} pot="#e8742f" seed={6} />
      <LeafPlant p={[5.45, 0, z0 + 0.5]} s={1.2} pot="#3fb3c4" seed={9} />
    </group>
  );
};

export const CLASSROOM_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0.4, 0, 4.9],
  board: [-5.0, 0, -0.6],
  front: [-3.2, 0, -0.6],
  teacher: [-4.95, 0, 2.2],
  seat1: [0.2, 0, 1.7],
  seat2: [2.0, 0, 1.7],
  seat3: [0.2, 0, 0],
  aisle: [1.1, 0, 0.85],
  window: [0.4, 0, -4.2],
  door: [-5.4, 0, 4.2],
};

// Open-plan home: IFOLOGY "Shapeshift" kitchen (purple cabinets, white tiled backsplash, fridge,
// oven, hood) on the left (x<0.4, checker floor) and a living area on the right (wood floor, rug,
// couch facing a wall TV). Room x∈[-6,6], back wall z=-5, ceiling 3.0, open toward +z
// (a one-sided fourth wall at z=6 shows only in reverse shots from inside).
import React from 'react';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { Ball, Box, Chair, Cone, Cyl, Door, Table, WallClock, mix, rng } from './kit';
import { Batch, Batched, CeilingPanel, checkerFloor, FloorLamp, FruitBowl, isNight, LeafPlant, Picture, Pinboard, plankFloor, RoomWindow, Shell, Sofa } from './roomkit';

export const HOME = { x0: -6, x1: 6, z0: -5, z1: 6, h: 3.0 };

const PURPLE = '#3f2f6e';
const PURPLE_DOOR = '#5a4590';
const COUNTER = '#efe7d8';
const STEEL = '#c9ccd3';
const GROUT = '#cfc8bc';
const TILE = '#f7f4ee';

function buildKitchen(b: Batch) {
  const Z = HOME.z0;
  // ---- fridge (back-left corner) + cupboard above
  b.span([-5.96, 0.02, Z], [-5.14, 1.95, Z + 0.7], '#f1efea');
  b.span([-5.95, 1.31, Z + 0.7], [-5.15, 1.335, Z + 0.705], '#b9b7b0');
  b.span([-5.25, 1.42, Z + 0.7], [-5.21, 1.75, Z + 0.74], STEEL);
  b.span([-5.25, 0.85, Z + 0.7], [-5.21, 1.22, Z + 0.74], STEEL);
  ['#e2483d', '#3d8fd6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b'].forEach((c, i) => b.box([-5.75 + (i % 2) * 0.22, 1.05 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 0.32 + (i % 2) * 0.06, Z + 0.705], [0.07, 0.07, 0.012], c));
  b.box([-5.62, 1.6, Z + 0.703], [0.22, 0.28, 0.006], '#f8f4ea', [0, 0, 0.08]);
  b.box([-5.62, 1.62, Z + 0.707], [0.12, 0.1, 0.004], '#f2a7b5', [0, 0, 0.08]);
  b.span([-5.96, 2.06, Z], [-5.14, 2.62, Z + 0.4], PURPLE);
  b.span([-5.93, 2.08, Z + 0.4], [-5.17, 2.6, Z + 0.415], PURPLE_DOOR);

  // ---- lower run x∈[-5.1,-0.8]
  const X0 = -5.1, X1 = -0.8, FZ = Z + 0.6; // carcass front
  b.span([X0, 0.1, Z], [X1, 0.88, FZ], PURPLE);
  b.span([X0, 0, Z], [X1, 0.1, FZ - 0.05], '#231b3a');
  b.span([X0 - 0.02, 0.88, Z], [X1 + 0.02, 0.93, FZ + 0.06], COUNTER);
  const door = (xa: number, xb: number, ya = 0.12, yb = 0.86, handleTop = true) => {
    b.span([xa + 0.012, ya, FZ], [xb - 0.012, yb, FZ + 0.02], PURPLE_DOOR);
    b.box([(xa + xb) / 2, handleTop ? yb - 0.07 : (ya + yb) / 2, FZ + 0.035], [Math.min(0.2, (xb - xa) * 0.4), 0.022, 0.025], '#e4e4ea');
  };
  const drawers = (xa: number, xb: number) => {
    door(xa, xb, 0.12, 0.36, false);
    door(xa, xb, 0.38, 0.62, false);
    door(xa, xb, 0.64, 0.86, false);
  };
  drawers(-5.1, -4.45);
  door(-4.45, -3.7);
  door(-3.7, -2.95);
  door(-2.95, -2.4);
  // oven
  b.span([-2.38, 0.12, FZ], [-1.62, 0.72, FZ + 0.02], '#1d1e25');
  b.span([-2.28, 0.2, FZ + 0.02], [-1.72, 0.56, FZ + 0.024], '#3b3f4f');
  b.box([-2.0, 0.64, FZ + 0.05], [0.56, 0.025, 0.03], STEEL);
  b.span([-2.38, 0.74, FZ], [-1.62, 0.86, FZ + 0.02], '#dcdce2');
  [-2.25, -2.12, -1.88, -1.75].forEach(x => b.add('cyl', '#2a2b33', [x, 0.8, FZ + 0.03], [0.022, 0.03, 0.022], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]));
  drawers(-1.6, -0.8);
  // hob
  b.span([-2.35, 0.93, Z + 0.06], [-1.65, 0.945, Z + 0.56], '#1f2027', { cast: false });
  [[-2.17, Z + 0.2], [-1.83, Z + 0.2], [-2.17, Z + 0.42], [-1.83, Z + 0.42]].forEach(([x, z]) => b.add('cyl', '#43454f', [x, 0.948, z], [0.075, 0.006, 0.075], 0, { cast: false }));
  // sink + tap
  b.span([-4.15, 0.93, Z + 0.06], [-3.25, 0.948, Z + 0.56], STEEL, { cast: false });
  b.span([-4.05, 0.948, Z + 0.12], [-3.35, 0.952, Z + 0.5], '#8f94a0', { cast: false });
  b.add('cyl', STEEL, [-3.7, 1.07, Z + 0.07], [0.02, 0.26, 0.02]);
  b.stick([-3.7, 1.2, Z + 0.07], [-3.7, 1.17, Z + 0.26], 0.017, STEEL);
  // backsplash: white square tiles over grout
  const BT = 0.93, rows = 4, cols = 28, pitch = (X1 - X0) / cols, ph = 0.15;
  b.span([X0, BT, Z], [X1, BT + rows * ph, Z + 0.006], GROUT, { cast: false });
  for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++)
    for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) b.box([X0 + (i + 0.5) * pitch, BT + (j + 0.5) * ph, Z + 0.011], [pitch - 0.013, ph - 0.013, 0.01], TILE, 0, { cast: false });
  // upper cabinets
  const upper = (xa: number, xb: number, hinge: 1 | -1) => {
    b.span([xa, 1.68, Z], [xb, 2.48, Z + 0.34], PURPLE);
    b.span([xa + 0.012, 1.69, Z + 0.34], [xb - 0.012, 2.47, Z + 0.355], PURPLE_DOOR);
    b.box([hinge > 0 ? xb - 0.07 : xa + 0.07, 1.8, Z + 0.37], [0.022, 0.15, 0.025], '#e4e4ea');
  };
  upper(-5.1, -4.42, 1);
  upper(-3.0, -2.44, -1);
  upper(-1.56, -1.18, 1);
  upper(-1.18, -0.8, -1);
  // range hood
  b.span([-2.42, 1.86, Z], [-1.58, 1.97, Z + 0.52], STEEL);
  b.span([-2.36, 1.97, Z], [-1.64, 2.12, Z + 0.38], mix(STEEL, '#ffffff', 0.2));
  b.span([-2.16, 2.12, Z], [-1.84, HOME.h, Z + 0.26], STEEL);
  // microwave
  b.span([-1.56, 0.93, Z + 0.04], [-0.98, 1.27, Z + 0.44], '#ebe8e2');
  b.span([-1.52, 0.97, Z + 0.44], [-1.18, 1.23, Z + 0.445], '#2b2d36');
  b.span([-1.14, 0.98, Z + 0.44], [-1.02, 1.22, Z + 0.445], '#c9c6c0');
  // kettle, canisters, cutting board, bottles
  b.add('cyl', '#d9433a', [-2.75, 1.03, Z + 0.32], [0.085, 0.2, 0.085]);
  b.add('cyl', '#2a2b33', [-2.75, 1.14, Z + 0.32], [0.05, 0.03, 0.05]);
  b.stick([-2.66, 1.1, Z + 0.32], [-2.64, 0.98, Z + 0.32], 0.015, '#2a2b33');
  ['#f2b632', '#f4efe2', '#4e9a6b'].forEach((c, i) => {
    b.add('cyl', c, [-4.95 + i * 0.16, 1.02 + i * 0.01, Z + 0.18], [0.06, 0.18 + i * 0.02, 0.06]);
    b.add('cyl', '#8b6146', [-4.95 + i * 0.16, 1.12 + i * 0.02, Z + 0.18], [0.062, 0.025, 0.062]);
  });
  b.span([-3.15, 0.93, Z + 0.1], [-2.98, 1.23, Z + 0.13], '#c9945e', { cast: true });
  b.box([-0.95, 0.95, Z + 0.45], [0.26, 0.02, 0.18], '#c9945e', [0, 0.3, 0]);
}

function buildFloor(b: Batch) {
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1 } = HOME;
  checkerFloor(b, x0, 0.4, z0, z1, 0.5, '#e6e3de', '#c6c4c0');
  plankFloor(b, 0.4, x1, z0, z1, 0.24, ['#c99a6d', '#bf8f62', '#d2a477'], 5);
  b.span([0.37, 0, z0], [0.43, 0.008, z1], '#8a6446', { cast: false });
}

function buildLiving(b: Batch) {
  // rug (three thin layers so the stripe reads), under the coffee table
  b.span([1.45, 0, -2.05], [5.15, 0.008, 1.25], '#7d2a30', { cast: false });
  b.span([1.6, 0, -1.9], [5.0, 0.012, 1.1], '#efdcb6', { cast: false });
  b.span([1.7, 0, -1.8], [4.9, 0.016, 1.0], '#b6434a', { cast: false });
  // TV console against the right wall (front faces -x)
  b.at([HOME.x1, 0, -0.4], -Math.PI / 2, () => {
    b.box([0, 0.3, 0.24], [2.2, 0.4, 0.46], '#c89a6a');
    b.box([0, 0.08, 0.24], [2.1, 0.06, 0.4], '#8a6446');
    [-0.72, 0, 0.72].forEach(x => {
      b.box([x, 0.3, 0.475], [0.68, 0.32, 0.012], '#d9ae7f', 0, { cast: false });
      b.box([x, 0.4, 0.49], [0.16, 0.022, 0.02], '#6b4a35', 0, { cast: false });
    });
    // TV on the wall
    b.box([0, 1.2, 0.06], [1.6, 0.92, 0.06], '#16171c');
    b.add('plane', '#262c3e', [0, 1.2, 0.092], [1.52, 0.84, 1], 0, { cast: false });
    b.add('plane', '#323a52', [0.3, 1.32, 0.094], [0.12, 0.62, 1], [0, 0, -0.6], { cast: false });
    b.add('plane', '#323a52', [0.46, 1.3, 0.094], [0.05, 0.62, 1], [0, 0, -0.6], { cast: false });
    // speaker + small plant on the console
    b.box([-0.95, 0.68, 0.24], [0.16, 0.36, 0.16], '#2a2b33');
    b.add('cyl', '#3a3b44', [-0.95, 0.72, 0.325], [0.045, 0.01, 0.045], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
    b.add('cyl', '#e9e2d4', [0.85, 0.58, 0.25], [0.07, 0.16, 0.07]);
    b.add('ico', '#4e9a45', [0.85, 0.72, 0.25], [0.13, 0.12, 0.13]);
  });
  // coffee table items
  b.box([3.05, 0.47, -0.65], [0.3, 0.025, 0.22], '#3d6fb6', [0, 0.2, 0]);
  b.box([3.05, 0.495, -0.62], [0.28, 0.02, 0.2], '#f2b632', [0, -0.1, 0]);
  b.add('cyl', '#f4efe2', [3.1, 0.5, -0.05], [0.045, 0.1, 0.045]);
  b.box([2.95, 0.465, 0.2], [0.06, 0.02, 0.17], '#2a2b33', [0, 0.4, 0]);
  // wall shelf with books + tiny plant above the pin board
  const rand = rng(21);
  b.box([0.75, 2.12, HOME.z0 + 0.12], [1.0, 0.035, 0.24], '#8b6146');
  let x = 0.3;
  const bc = ['#c8402f', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b', '#e7e1d3', '#7a4fa0'];
  while (x < 0.85) {
    const w = 0.05 + rand() * 0.04, h = 0.18 + rand() * 0.08;
    b.box([x + w / 2, 2.14 + h / 2, HOME.z0 + 0.12], [w, h, 0.18], bc[Math.floor(rand() * bc.length)]);
    x += w + 0.008;
  }
  b.add('cyl', '#c46b47', [1.08, 2.2, HOME.z0 + 0.12], [0.07, 0.13, 0.07]);
  b.add('ico', '#5aa54a', [1.08, 2.33, HOME.z0 + 0.12], [0.12, 0.11, 0.12]);
}

export const Home: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t, time }) => {
  const night = isNight(time);
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1, h } = HOME;
  return (
    <group>
      <Batched id="home-floor" build={buildFloor} />
      <Shell x0={x0} x1={x1} z0={z0} z1={z1} h={h} wall="#ebc9aa" base="#f6f1e8" ceiling="#f3ece2" ceilingEmissive={night ? '#2a2622' : '#8a8278'} fourth />
      <Batched id="home-kitchen" build={buildKitchen} />
      <Batched id="home-living" build={buildLiving} />

      {/* kitchen window over the sink + sill plant */}
      <RoomWindow p={[-3.7, 2.07, z0]} w={1.2} h={0.92} cols={2} cross={false} night={night} seed={1} />
      <LeafPlant p={[-3.35, 1.53, z0 + 0.1]} s={0.42} pot="#e2483d" seed={3} />

      {/* dining */}
      <Table p={[-3.0, 0, -1.3]} w={1.7} d={0.95} h={0.76} c="#d8b27c" />
      <Chair p={[-3.45, 0, -2.02]} c="#c0563f" />
      <Chair p={[-2.55, 0, -2.02]} c="#c0563f" />
      <Chair p={[-4.2, 0, -1.3]} r={Math.PI / 2} c="#c0563f" />
      <Chair p={[-1.8, 0, -1.3]} r={-Math.PI / 2} c="#c0563f" />
      <FruitBowl p={[-3.0, 0.79, -1.3]} />
      <Box p={[-3.45, 0.795, -1.55]} s={[0.36, 0.01, 0.26]} c="#f4efe2" shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[-2.55, 0.795, -1.55]} s={[0.36, 0.01, 0.26]} c="#f4efe2" shadow={false} />
      <Cyl p={[-2.45, 0.85, -1.5]} s={[0.04, 0.1, 0.04]} c="#f6a04d" />
      {/* pendant lamp */}
      <Cyl p={[-3.0, 2.62, -1.3]} s={[0.008, 0.76, 0.008]} c="#2a2b33" shadow={false} />
      <Cone p={[-3.0, 2.12, -1.3]} s={[0.27, 0.24, 0.27]} c="#2f6f73" shadow={false} />
      <Ball p={[-3.0, 2.0, -1.3]} s={0.06} c="#fff2c4" glow />

      {/* living */}
      <Sofa p={[1.62, 0, -0.4]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={2.3} c="#3e5c8a" />
      <Table p={[3.1, 0, -0.4]} w={0.75} d={1.25} h={0.43} c="#efe6d6" />
      <FloorLamp p={[1.3, 0, -2.05]} on={night} />
      <RoomWindow p={[3.3, 1.68, z0]} w={2.2} h={1.4} cols={3} night={night} seed={2} curtain="#e2b04a" />
      <LeafPlant p={[5.35, 0, z0 + 0.55]} s={1.5} pot="#e9e2d4" seed={5} />
      <LeafPlant p={[-5.45, 0, 1.1]} s={1.3} pot="#c46b47" seed={8} leaf="#5aa54a" />
      <Door p={[x1, 0, -3.6]} r={-Math.PI / 2} c="#3f7a52" frame="#f6f1e8" />
      <Picture p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.72, -2.3]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.55} h={0.72} art="abstract" seed={1} />
      <Picture p={[x1 - 0.005, 1.65, 1.45]} r={-Math.PI / 2} w={0.82} h={0.6} art="landscape" frame="#f4efe2" />
      <Picture p={[x0 + 0.005, 1.72, -1.85]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={0.55} h={0.72} art="abstract" seed={4} />
      <Picture p={[x0 + 0.005, 1.78, -0.85]} r={Math.PI / 2} w={0.5} h={0.5} art="sun" frame="#f4efe2" />
      <Pinboard p={[0.75, 1.55, z0]} />
      <WallClock p={[-0.2, 2.3, z0 + 0.06]} s={0.85} t={t} />

      {/* ceiling lights */}
      <CeilingPanel p={[3.2, h, -0.4]} w={0.7} round />
      <CeilingPanel p={[-3.4, h, -3.9]} w={0.55} round />
    </group>
  );
};

export const HOME_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, 0, 1.0],
  kitchen: [-3.0, 0, -3.5],

// Set registry. Every set is a React component drawn around the origin plus named "marks"
// (staging spots) so episode specs can say `"pos": "desk"` instead of raw coordinates.
// To add a set: build it in src/sets/<name>.tsx from kit.tsx pieces, then register it here.
import React from 'react';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { Suburb } from './suburb';
import { INDOOR_SETS } from './indoor';
import { OUTDOOR_SETS } from './outdoor';

export type SetProps = {
  t: number; // seconds since shot start (for clocks, flickers, ambient motion)
  center: Vec3; // where the camera is looking (tiling sets build around this)
  variant: number; // deterministic dressing variation
  time: string; // palette key in use (sets may switch window glow, lamps, etc.)
};

export type SetDef = {
  component: React.FC<SetProps>;
  palette: string; // default PALETTES key
  marks: Record<string, Vec3>; // named standing spots, y = floor height there
  shadowCenter?: Vec3; // centre of the sun's shadow frustum (defaults to camera look point)
  shadowBox?: number; // half-size of the shadow frustum
  interior?: boolean; // true = no sky dome needed
  room?: { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 }; // walls/floor/ceiling the camera must stay inside (open side = large max); the engine pulls a camera that ends up outside back in along its sight line
  description: string; // one line for Claude when picking sets
};

const SuburbSet: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ center }) => React.createElement(Suburb, { centerX: center[0], behind: 80, ahead: 120 });

export const SETS: Record<string, SetDef> = {
  suburb: {
    component: SuburbSet,
    palette: 'afternoon',
    marks: {
      sidewalk: [0, 0.1, -4.6], // home-side sidewalk, facing the road (+z)
      lawn: [6.5, 0.08, -9.5],
      door: [8.45, 0.36, -12.9], // front step of the house at x≈6.5
      road: [0, 0, 0],
      farSidewalk: [0, 0.1, 4.6],
      mailbox: [10.2, 0.1, -5.2],
    },
    shadowBox: 16,
    description: 'IFOLOGY-style pastel suburban street, tiles forever along x. Sidewalk z=-4.6 (y 0.1), road |z|<3.5, houses at z=-17.',
  },
  ...INDOOR_SETS,
  ...OUTDOOR_SETS,
};

// Low-poly building blocks shared by all sets and props. Everything is toon-shaded and
// casts/receives shadows; "glow" colours are unlit (windows at night, screens, bulbs).
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { envMaterial, flat, inkMaterial } from '../engine/materials';

export const G = {
  box: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
  sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14),
  ico: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1),
  cyl: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 20),
  cyl8: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8),
  cone: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 16),
  cone4: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 4),
  plane: new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1),
  circle: new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 40),
  torus: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.08, 8, 40),
};

type P = { p?: Vec3; r?: Vec3 | number; s?: Vec3 | number; c: string; glow?: boolean; shadow?: boolean; opacity?: number };
const rot = (r?: Vec3 | number): Vec3 => (typeof r === 'number' ? [0, r, 0] : r || [0, 0, 0]);
const scl = (s?: Vec3 | number): Vec3 => (typeof s === 'number' ? [s, s, s] : s || [1, 1, 1]);
const mat = (c: string, glow?: boolean, opacity?: number) => (glow ? flat(c, opacity ?? 1) : envMaterial(c));

export const Box: React.FC<P> = ({ p, r, s, c, glow, shadow = true, opacity }) => (
  <mesh geometry={G.box} material={mat(c, glow, opacity)} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)} castShadow={shadow && !glow} receiveShadow={!glow} />
);
export const Ball: React.FC<P & { ico?: boolean }> = ({ p, r, s, c, glow, shadow = true, ico }) => (
  <mesh geometry={ico ? G.ico : G.sphere} material={mat(c, glow)} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)} castShadow={shadow && !glow} receiveShadow={!glow} />
);
export const Cyl: React.FC<P & { seg8?: boolean }> = ({ p, r, s, c, glow, shadow = true, seg8 }) => (
  <mesh geometry={seg8 ? G.cyl8 : G.cyl} material={mat(c, glow)} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)} castShadow={shadow && !glow} receiveShadow={!glow} />
);
export const Cone: React.FC<P & { four?: boolean }> = ({ p, r, s, c, glow, shadow = true, four }) => (
  <mesh geometry={four ? G.cone4 : G.cone} material={mat(c, glow)} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)} castShadow={shadow && !glow} receiveShadow={!glow} />
);
export const Plane: React.FC<P> = ({ p, r, s, c, glow, opacity }) => (
  <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={mat(c, glow, opacity)} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)} receiveShadow={!glow} />
);

/** Translate a whole group. */
export const At: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number | Vec3; s?: number | Vec3; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ p, r, s, children }) => (
  <group position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={scl(s)}>{children}</group>
);

/** Ground plane (large) receiving shadows. */
export const Ground: React.FC<{ c: string; size?: number; y?: number }> = ({ c, size = 400, y = 0 }) => (
  <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial(c)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, y, 0]} scale={[size, size, 1]} receiveShadow />
);

// Deterministic pseudo-random for set dressing.
export function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = (((seed * 9301 + 49297) % 233280) + 233280) % 233280; // JS % keeps the sign: negative seeds gave negative values (undefined colours → white trees)
  return () => {
    s = (s * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
    return s / 233280;
  };
}

export function mix(a: string, b: string, k: number) {
  return '#' + new THREE.Color(a).lerp(new THREE.Color(b), k).getHexString();
}

/** Text drawn to a canvas and shown on a plane (signs, posters, screens, boards). */
const texCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
export function textTexture(text: string, o: { w?: number; h?: number; bg?: string; fg?: string; font?: string; size?: number } = {}) {
  const key = JSON.stringify([text, o]);
  if (texCache.has(key)) return texCache.get(key)!;
  const W = o.w ?? 512, H = o.h ?? 256;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = W;
  c.height = H;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  if (o.bg) {
    g.fillStyle = o.bg;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  g.fillStyle = o.fg ?? '#ffffff';
  g.textAlign = 'center';
  g.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  const size = o.size ?? Math.min(H / (lines.length * 1.25), (W * 1.6) / Math.max(...lines.map(l => l.length || 1)));
  g.font = `${o.font ?? '800'} ${size}px "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif`;
  lines.forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, W / 2, H / 2 + (i - (lines.length - 1) / 2) * size * 1.15));
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  t.anisotropy = 4;
  texCache.set(key, t);
  return t;
}

export const Sign: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number | Vec3; w: number; h: number; text: string; bg?: string; fg?: string; glow?: boolean }> = ({ p, r, w, h, text, bg = '#1d2333', fg = '#ffffff', glow = true }) => {
  const tex = textTexture(text, { w: Math.round(256 * (w / h)), h: 256, bg, fg });
  return (
    <mesh geometry={G.plane} position={p} rotation={rot(r)} scale={[w, h, 1]}>
      {glow ? <meshBasicMaterial map={tex} toneMapped={false} /> : <meshToonMaterial map={tex} />}
    </mesh>
  );
};

// Furniture & architecture

export const Window: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number; h?: number; frame?: string; glass: string; lit?: boolean; bars?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 1.2, h = 1.4, frame = '#e9e2d4', glass, lit = true, bars = 1 }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Plane p={[0, 0, 0.005]} s={[w, h, 1]} c={glass} glow={lit} />
    <Box p={[0, h / 2, 0.03]} s={[w + 0.1, 0.07, 0.06]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[0, -h / 2, 0.05]} s={[w + 0.16, 0.07, 0.12]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[-w / 2, 0, 0.03]} s={[0.07, h, 0.06]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[w / 2, 0, 0.03]} s={[0.07, h, 0.06]} c={frame} />
    {bars >= 1 && <Box p={[0, 0, 0.03]} s={[0.04, h, 0.04]} c={frame} />}
    {bars >= 2 && <Box p={[0, 0, 0.03]} s={[w, 0.04, 0.04]} c={frame} />}
  </At>
);

export const Door: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string; frame?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#8a4b3a', frame = '#e9e2d4' }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 1.05, 0.02]} s={[0.95, 2.1, 0.05]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 2.14, 0.04]} s={[1.08, 0.08, 0.08]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[-0.52, 1.07, 0.04]} s={[0.07, 2.14, 0.08]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[0.52, 1.07, 0.04]} s={[0.07, 2.14, 0.08]} c={frame} />
    <Ball p={[0.34, 1.0, 0.08]} s={0.035} c="#d9b45a" />
  </At>
);

export const Table: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number; d?: number; h?: number; c?: string; round?: boolean; cloth?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 1.4, d = 0.8, h = 0.75, c = '#9b6a4a', round, cloth }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    {round ? (
      <>
        <Cyl p={[0, h, 0]} s={[w / 2, 0.05, w / 2]} c={cloth || c} />
        {cloth && <Cyl p={[0, h - 0.2, 0]} s={[w / 2 + 0.01, 0.38, w / 2 + 0.01]} c={cloth} />}
        <Cyl p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[0.05, h, 0.05]} c="#3a3438" />
        <Cyl p={[0, 0.02, 0]} s={[0.28, 0.04, 0.28]} c="#3a3438" />
      </>
    ) : (
      <>
        <Box p={[0, h, 0]} s={[w, 0.06, d]} c={c} />
        {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => (
          <Box key={i} p={[x * (w / 2 - 0.06), h / 2, z * (d / 2 - 0.06)]} s={[0.06, h, 0.06]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.25)} />
        ))}
      </>
    )}
  </At>
);

export const Chair: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#6d4a3a' }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0.45, 0]} s={[0.46, 0.05, 0.44]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.78, -0.2]} s={[0.46, 0.6, 0.05]} c={c} />
    {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => (
      <Box key={i} p={[x * 0.2, 0.22, z * 0.19]} s={[0.04, 0.45, 0.04]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.3)} />
    ))}
  </At>
);

export const Bed: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string; sheet?: string; frame?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#3d4f86', sheet = '#e8e4dc', frame = '#5a3e33' }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0.2, 0]} s={[1.5, 0.3, 2.1]} c={frame} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.42, 0.02]} s={[1.42, 0.16, 2.0]} c={sheet} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.52, 0.35]} s={[1.46, 0.08, 1.35]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.56, -0.75]} s={[0.9, 0.12, 0.38]} c="#f4f1ea" />
    <Box p={[0, 0.65, -1.05]} s={[1.5, 0.95, 0.08]} c={frame} />
  </At>
);

export const Desk: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string; monitor?: boolean; screen?: string; lamp?: boolean }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#b98a5e', monitor = true, screen = '#7fb2ff', lamp }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Table w={1.4} d={0.7} h={0.75} c={c} />
    {monitor && (
      <>
        <Box p={[0, 1.08, -0.15]} s={[0.62, 0.38, 0.03]} c="#1a1b22" />
        <Plane p={[0, 1.08, -0.133]} s={[0.56, 0.32, 1]} c={screen} glow />
        <Box p={[0, 0.88, -0.17]} s={[0.05, 0.2, 0.05]} c="#1a1b22" />
        <Box p={[0, 0.79, 0.08]} s={[0.45, 0.02, 0.15]} c="#2a2b33" />
      </>
    )}
    {lamp && <DeskLamp p={[0.5, 0.78, -0.15]} />}
  </At>
);

export const DeskLamp: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; c?: string }> = ({ p, c = '#2b2d36' }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.01, 0]} s={[0.09, 0.02, 0.09]} c={c} />
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.2, 0]} s={[0.012, 0.4, 0.012]} c={c} />
    <Cone p={[0.04, 0.4, 0.04]} r={[0.6, 0, -0.3]} s={[0.1, 0.13, 0.1]} c={c} />
    <Ball p={[0.07, 0.35, 0.08]} s={0.035} c="#fff2c4" glow />
  </At>
);

export const Shelf: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string; seed?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#8b6146', seed = 3 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const books: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const cols = ['#c8402f', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b', '#e7e1d3', '#7a4fa0'];
  for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
    let x = -0.5;
    while (x < 0.45) {
      const w = 0.05 + rand() * 0.05, h = 0.22 + rand() * 0.1;
      books.push(<Box key={`${row}-${x}`} p={[x + w / 2, 0.42 + row * 0.5 + h / 2, 0]} s={[w, h, 0.22]} c={cols[Math.floor(rand() * cols.length)]} />);
      x += w + 0.01;
    }
  }
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, 0.95, -0.13]} s={[1.1, 1.9, 0.04]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.2)} />
      {[0.4, 0.9, 1.4, 1.88].map(y => <Box key={y} p={[0, y, 0]} s={[1.1, 0.04, 0.3]} c={c} />)}
      <Box p={[-0.53, 0.95, 0]} s={[0.04, 1.9, 0.3]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0.53, 0.95, 0]} s={[0.04, 1.9, 0.3]} c={c} />
      {books}
    </At>
  );
};

export const Plant: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; s?: number; pot?: string; leaf?: string }> = ({ p, s = 1, pot = '#c46b47', leaf = '#4e9a6b' }) => (
  <At p={p} s={s}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.17, 0]} s={[0.16, 0.34, 0.16]} c={pot} />
    <Ball p={[0, 0.5, 0]} s={[0.26, 0.3, 0.26]} c={leaf} ico />
    <Ball p={[0.12, 0.66, 0.05]} s={0.15} c={mix(leaf, '#ffffff', 0.12)} ico />
  </At>
);

export const Tree: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; s?: number; kind?: 'round' | 'pine' | 'autumn' | 'bare'; leaf?: string }> = ({ p, s = 1, kind = 'round', leaf }) => (
  <At p={p} s={s}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.9, 0]} s={[0.1, 1.8, 0.1]} c="#5b3d2e" seg8 />
    {kind === 'pine' ? (
      <>
        <Cone p={[0, 2.2, 0]} s={[0.9, 1.6, 0.9]} c={leaf || '#2f6b4f'} />
        <Cone p={[0, 3.0, 0]} s={[0.65, 1.3, 0.65]} c={leaf || '#2f6b4f'} />
      </>
    ) : kind === 'bare' ? (
      <>
        <Cyl p={[0.2, 2.0, 0]} r={[0, 0, -0.6]} s={[0.04, 0.8, 0.04]} c="#5b3d2e" />
        <Cyl p={[-0.2, 2.1, 0]} r={[0, 0, 0.7]} s={[0.04, 0.8, 0.04]} c="#5b3d2e" />
      </>
    ) : (
      <>
        <Ball p={[0, 2.3, 0]} s={[1.0, 0.95, 1.0]} c={leaf || (kind === 'autumn' ? '#e39b3a' : '#4f9a52')} ico />
        <Ball p={[0.45, 2.0, 0.2]} s={0.6} c={leaf || (kind === 'autumn' ? '#d9822b' : '#468c4a')} ico />
        <Ball p={[-0.4, 2.1, -0.2]} s={0.62} c={leaf || (kind === 'autumn' ? '#eab04a' : '#56a35a')} ico />
      </>
    )}
  </At>
);

export const Bush: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; s?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, s = 1, c = '#4a8f4f' }) => (
  <At p={p} s={s}>
    <Ball p={[0, 0.3, 0]} s={[0.55, 0.4, 0.45]} c={c} ico />
    <Ball p={[0.35, 0.25, 0.05]} s={0.32} c={mix(c, '#fff', 0.08)} ico />
  </At>
);

export const StreetLamp: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; on?: boolean }> = ({ p, r = 0, on }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 2.0, 0]} s={[0.05, 4, 0.05]} c="#2b2e38" seg8 />
    <Box p={[0, 4.0, 0.3]} s={[0.08, 0.06, 0.65]} c="#2b2e38" />
    <Box p={[0, 3.93, 0.58]} s={[0.3, 0.1, 0.22]} c="#2b2e38" />
    <Box p={[0, 3.87, 0.58]} s={[0.24, 0.03, 0.16]} c={on ? '#ffe2a6' : '#c9c4b8'} glow={on} />
  </At>
);

export const Fence: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; len?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, len = 4, c = '#f1ede4' }) => {
  const n = Math.round(len / 0.25);
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => <Box key={i} p={[-len / 2 + i * 0.25, 0.45, 0]} s={[0.1, 0.9, 0.04]} c={c} />)}
      <Box p={[0, 0.65, 0.03]} s={[len, 0.07, 0.03]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0, 0.3, 0.03]} s={[len, 0.07, 0.03]} c={c} />
    </At>
  );
};

export const Car: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, c = '#3d6fb6' }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0.5, 0]} s={[1.8, 0.55, 4.0]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.98, -0.2]} s={[1.6, 0.48, 2.1]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 0.98, -0.2]} s={[1.62, 0.36, 1.9]} c="#a9c6de" />
    {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => (
      <Cyl key={i} p={[x * 0.88, 0.32, z * 1.25]} r={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} s={[0.32, 0.22, 0.32]} c="#1b1b20" />
    ))}
    <Box p={[0.6, 0.6, 2.0]} s={[0.3, 0.12, 0.04]} c="#fff6d8" glow />
    <Box p={[-0.6, 0.6, 2.0]} s={[0.3, 0.12, 0.04]} c="#fff6d8" glow />
  </At>
);

export const House: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number; d?: number; h?: number; c?: string; roof?: string; lit?: boolean; seed?: number; trim?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 6, d = 6, h = 3.2, c = '#e8c9a0', roof = '#7c4a46', lit, seed = 1, trim = '#f5efe4' }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const glass = lit ? '#ffcf7a' : '#9fb9cf';
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[w, h, d]} c={c} />
      <mesh geometry={G.cone4} material={envMaterial(roof)} position={[0, h + 1.0, 0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 4, 0]} scale={[w * 0.78, 2.0, d * 0.78]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <Door p={[w * 0.18, 0, d / 2]} c={['#8a4b3a', '#3d5c86', '#4e7a5a', '#a33b3b'][Math.floor(rand() * 4)]} frame={trim} />
      <Window p={[-w * 0.24, 1.45, d / 2 + 0.01]} glass={glass} lit={lit} frame={trim} w={1.3} h={1.1} bars={2} />
      {h > 4.6 && <Window p={[w * 0.18, h - 1.3, d / 2 + 0.01]} glass={glass} lit={lit && rand() < 0.6} frame={trim} w={1.1} h={0.9} bars={2} />}
      <Box p={[w * 0.18, 0.08, d / 2 + 0.35]} s={[1.3, 0.16, 0.7]} c="#bdb6aa" />
    </At>
  );
};

export const Building: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; w?: number; d?: number; h?: number; c?: string; lit?: boolean; seed?: number; windowColor?: string }> = ({ p, w = 8, d = 8, h = 20, c = '#3a4160', lit, seed = 1, windowColor }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const rows = Math.floor(h / 2.2), cols = Math.max(2, Math.floor(w / 1.6));
  const wins: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++)
    for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
      const on = lit ? rand() < 0.42 : false;
      const col = on ? (rand() < 0.8 ? windowColor || '#ffcf7a' : '#bfe1ff') : mix(c, '#000', 0.35);
      wins.push(<Plane key={`${i}-${j}`} p={[-w / 2 + (j + 0.5) * (w / cols), 1.4 + i * 2.2, d / 2 + 0.02]} s={[w / cols * 0.55, 1.1, 1]} c={col} glow={on} />);
    }
  return (
    <At p={p}>
      <Box p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[w, h, d]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0, h + 0.2, 0]} s={[w + 0.3, 0.4, d + 0.3]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.2)} />
      {wins}
    </At>
  );
};

export const WallClock: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; s?: number; t?: number; frozen?: boolean }> = ({ p, r = 0, s = 1, t = 0, frozen }) => {
  const sec = frozen ? 0 : t;
  const minuteA = -((10 * 60 + sec) / 3600) * Math.PI * 2;
  const secA = -(sec / 60) * Math.PI * 2;
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r} s={s}>
      <Cyl p={[0, 0, 0]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.32, 0.05, 0.32]} c="#2a2b33" />
      <Cyl p={[0, 0, 0.026]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.28, 0.01, 0.28]} c="#f6f2e8" />
      <group position={[0, 0, 0.04]} rotation={[0, 0, minuteA]}><Box p={[0, 0.1, 0]} s={[0.02, 0.2, 0.01]} c="#1b1b20" /></group>
      <group position={[0, 0, 0.04]} rotation={[0, 0, -2.1]}><Box p={[0, 0.065, 0]} s={[0.028, 0.13, 0.01]} c="#1b1b20" /></group>
      <group position={[0, 0, 0.045]} rotation={[0, 0, secA]}><Box p={[0, 0.1, 0]} s={[0.008, 0.22, 0.01]} c="#d9472b" /></group>
    </At>
  );
};

export const Rug: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; w?: number; d?: number; c?: string; round?: boolean }> = ({ p, w = 2.4, d = 1.6, c = '#b5584a', round }) =>
  round ? (
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial(c)} position={p ? [p[0], (p[1] || 0) + 0.006, p[2]] : [0, 0.006, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[w / 2, d / 2, 1]} receiveShadow />
  ) : (
    <Plane p={p ? [p[0], (p[1] || 0) + 0.006, p[2]] : [0, 0.006, 0]} r={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[w, d, 1]} c={c} />
  );

/** Crowd of simple seated/standing extras (cheap: head + body only). */
export const Crowd: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; rows?: number; cols?: number; dx?: number; dz?: number; rise?: number; seed?: number; r?: number }> = ({ p, rows = 6, cols = 20, dx = 0.6, dz = 0.9, rise = 0.5, seed = 5, r = 0 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const shirts = ['#5a8f9e', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b', '#e7e1d3', '#7a4fa0', '#e46f8e', '#2d2f3a'];
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++)
    for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
      const x = -((cols - 1) * dx) / 2 + j * dx + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.15;
      const z = -i * dz, y = i * rise;
      out.push(
        <group key={`${i}-${j}`} position={[x, y, z]}>
          <mesh geometry={G.box} material={envMaterial(shirts[Math.floor(rand() * shirts.length)])} position={[0, 0.45, 0]} scale={[0.34, 0.5, 0.22]} />
          <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={inkMaterial()} position={[0, 0.9 + rand() * 0.05, 0]} scale={0.17} />
        </group>,
      );
    }
  return <At p={p} r={r}>{out}</At>;
};

// Time-of-day palettes, sky dome and lighting rig. The palette also drives the character rim
// colour so silhouettes always pick up the scene's key light.
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { LOOK } from '../engine/materials';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';

export type Palette = {
  skyTop: string; skyHorizon: string; skyBottom: string;
  fog: string; fogNear: number; fogFar: number;
  hemiSky: string; hemiGround: string; hemi: number;
  key: string; keyInt: number; keyDir: Vec3;
  rim: string; rimAmbient: number;
  sun?: { color: string; size: number; dir: Vec3 };
  stars?: boolean;
  windows: string; // lit window colour for this time
  windowsLit: boolean;
  ground?: string;
};

export const PALETTES: Record<string, Palette> = {
  // IFOLOGY-style bright late afternoon (default for suburb scenes). Intensities are π-scaled for
  // three's physically-based lights with no tone mapping: hemi ≈ 0.62×albedo, key adds ≈ 0.5×.
  afternoon: {
    skyTop: '#6e9fd9', skyHorizon: '#dbe7f1', skyBottom: '#dbe7f1', fog: '#dfe4e6', fogNear: 45, fogFar: 230,
    hemiSky: '#f3f1ff', hemiGround: '#a39a78', hemi: 2.05, key: '#fff0d6', keyInt: 1.65, keyDir: [-0.5, 0.62, 0.6],
    rim: '#f6e7c6', rimAmbient: 0, windows: '#b9d4e6', windowsLit: false,
  },
  day: {
    skyTop: '#4f8fd0', skyHorizon: '#cfe7f4', skyBottom: '#cfe7f4', fog: '#cfe1ec', fogNear: 30, fogFar: 140,
    hemiSky: '#d4e6ff', hemiGround: '#8a8f6a', hemi: 2.0, key: '#fff3df', keyInt: 1.7, keyDir: [0.55, 0.8, 0.45],
    rim: '#fff4dc', rimAmbient: 0.35, windows: '#a9c8e2', windowsLit: false,
  },
  golden: {
    skyTop: '#3f4f8a', skyHorizon: '#f6b36a', skyBottom: '#f2c48e', fog: '#e6a878', fogNear: 25, fogFar: 120,
    hemiSky: '#9aa4d8', hemiGround: '#6a4f40', hemi: 1.7, key: '#ffb46e', keyInt: 1.9, keyDir: [-0.75, 0.32, -0.45],
    rim: '#ffc98c', rimAmbient: 0.45, sun: { color: '#ffe0a0', size: 6, dir: [-0.75, 0.12, -0.6] }, windows: '#ffcf7a', windowsLit: true,
  },
  dusk: {
    skyTop: '#2a2556', skyHorizon: '#e48a70', skyBottom: '#f0a57a', fog: '#8a5f86', fogNear: 20, fogFar: 110,
    hemiSky: '#7b6fc0', hemiGround: '#3c2c44', hemi: 1.7, key: '#ffa27e', keyInt: 1.4, keyDir: [-0.6, 0.3, -0.5],
    rim: '#ffbf95', rimAmbient: 0.5, sun: { color: '#ffd6a8', size: 7, dir: [-0.6, 0.06, -0.8] }, windows: '#ffcf7a', windowsLit: true,
  },
  night: {
    skyTop: '#060a1c', skyHorizon: '#1d2c58', skyBottom: '#1d2c58', fog: '#121a36', fogNear: 18, fogFar: 95,
    hemiSky: '#3a4c8c', hemiGround: '#161624', hemi: 1.4, key: '#a7c0ff', keyInt: 0.8, keyDir: [0.4, 0.7, -0.5],
    rim: '#b3ccff', rimAmbient: 0.55, stars: true, sun: { color: '#e9efff', size: 3.2, dir: [0.4, 0.45, -0.8] }, windows: '#ffcf7a', windowsLit: true,
  },
  interior: {
    skyTop: '#8fc0e6', skyHorizon: '#d7ecf6', skyBottom: '#d7ecf6', fog: '#2f2a28', fogNear: 25, fogFar: 80,
    hemiSky: '#fff1df', hemiGround: '#7a6656', hemi: 2.1, key: '#ffe6c2', keyInt: 1.4, keyDir: [0.6, 0.65, 0.4],
    rim: '#ffd8a6', rimAmbient: 0.4, windows: '#bfe0f5', windowsLit: false,
  },
  interiorNight: {
    skyTop: '#0a1028', skyHorizon: '#24345f', skyBottom: '#24345f', fog: '#14121c', fogNear: 20, fogFar: 70,
    hemiSky: '#4a4f86', hemiGround: '#221c24', hemi: 1.5, key: '#ffbb78', keyInt: 1.1, keyDir: [0.6, 0.55, 0.5],
    rim: '#ffc286', rimAmbient: 0.45, windows: '#2a3d6e', windowsLit: true,
  },
  void: {
    skyTop: '#0e1428', skyHorizon: '#1d2846', skyBottom: '#1d2846', fog: '#141c33', fogNear: 12, fogFar: 45,
    hemiSky: '#4a5a8c', hemiGround: '#141a2c', hemi: 1.7, key: '#fff0d6', keyInt: 1.3, keyDir: [0.5, 0.7, 0.4],
    rim: '#f0b44c', rimAmbient: 0.6, windows: '#f0b44c', windowsLit: true,
  },
};

const skyMat = (p: Palette) =>
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    side: THREE.BackSide, depthWrite: false, fog: false, toneMapped: false,
    uniforms: {
      top: { value: new THREE.Color(p.skyTop) }, hor: { value: new THREE.Color(p.skyHorizon) }, bot: { value: new THREE.Color(p.skyBottom) },
      sunDir: { value: new THREE.Vector3(...(p.sun?.dir || [0, -1, 0])).normalize() },
      sunCol: { value: new THREE.Color(p.sun?.color || '#000') }, sunSize: { value: p.sun?.size || 0 },
      stars: { value: p.stars ? 1 : 0 },
    },
    vertexShader: `varying vec3 vDir; void main(){ vDir = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 top; uniform vec3 hor; uniform vec3 bot; uniform vec3 sunDir; uniform vec3 sunCol; uniform float sunSize; uniform float stars;
      varying vec3 vDir;
      float h(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,37.719))) * 43758.5453); }
      void main(){
        float y = vDir.y;
        vec3 c = y > 0.0 ? mix(hor, top, pow(clamp(y, 0.0, 1.0), 0.55)) : mix(hor, bot, clamp(-y * 4.0, 0.0, 1.0));
        float d = max(dot(normalize(vDir), sunDir), 0.0);
        float ang = acos(clamp(d, -1.0, 1.0)) * 57.2958;
        c += sunCol * smoothstep(sunSize, sunSize * 0.85, ang) * 0.9;
        c += sunCol * exp(-ang / (sunSize * 2.5)) * 0.35;
        if (stars > 0.5 && y > 0.05) {
          vec3 q = floor(vDir * 260.0);
          float s = h(q);
          c += vec3(step(0.996, s) * (0.5 + 0.5 * h(q + 1.0))) * smoothstep(0.05, 0.3, y);
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }`,
  });

export const Sky: React.FC<{ p: Palette }> = ({ p }) => {
  const m = useMemo(() => skyMat(p), [p]);
  return (
    <mesh material={m} scale={300} renderOrder={-10} frustumCulled={false}>
      <sphereGeometry args={[1, 48, 24]} />
    </mesh>
  );
};

/** Lights + fog + sky + global rim uniforms for a palette. `shadowBox` sizes the sun's shadow frustum. */
export const Lighting: React.FC<{ p: Palette; center?: Vec3; shadowBox?: number; sky?: boolean; bg?: boolean; desat?: number; rim?: boolean }> = ({ p, center = [0, 0, 0], shadowBox = 18, sky = true, bg = true, desat = 0, rim = true }) => {
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3(...p.keyDir).normalize();
  if (rim) {
    LOOK.uRimColor.value.set(p.rim);
    LOOK.uRimAmbient.value = p.rimAmbient;
  }
  LOOK.uKeyDir.value.copy(dir);
  LOOK.uDesat.value = desat;
  const lightPos = new THREE.Vector3(...center).addScaledVector(dir, 40);
  const target = useMemo(() => new THREE.Object3D(), []);
  target.position.set(...center);
  return (
    <>
      {bg && <color attach="background" args={[p.skyHorizon]} />}
      <fog attach="fog" args={[p.fog, p.fogNear, p.fogFar]} />
      <hemisphereLight args={[p.hemiSky, p.hemiGround, p.hemi]} />
      <primitive object={target} />
      <directionalLight
        color={p.key}
        intensity={p.keyInt}
        position={lightPos}
        target={target}
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-bias={-0.0004}
        shadow-normalBias={0.02}
        shadow-camera-left={-shadowBox}
        shadow-camera-right={shadowBox}
        shadow-camera-top={shadowBox}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-shadowBox}
        shadow-camera-near={1}
        shadow-camera-far={90}
      />
      {sky && <Sky p={p} />}
    </>
  );
};
