@@@@ FILE src/sets/roomkit.tsx | text-crlf | 25272 | 38943d0a9cd8c11e47e747e6299a5b58ae8fe43f2772a4bed64a3e24c440445d
// Shared building blocks for the indoor sets (home, bedroom, classroom, cafeteria, void).
// Owned by the indoor-sets builder. Rooms are "dollhouses": every wall is a one-sided plane facing
// into the room, so a camera outside any wall (usually the open +z side) sees straight in, and the
// sun (a directional light from outside) passes through walls/ceiling: only furniture casts shadows.
// Repeated geometry (tiles, planks, desks, extras) is merged once per colour with `Batched`.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { mergeGeometries } from 'three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { envMaterial, flat, inkMaterial, toonGradient } from '../engine/materials';
import { At, Box, Cyl, G, Plane, rng, mix } from './kit';
import { PALETTES } from './look';

type R = Vec3 | number;
const rotV = (r?: R): Vec3 => (typeof r === 'number' ? [0, r, 0] : r || [0, 0, 0]);
const sclV = (s?: Vec3 | number): Vec3 => (typeof s === 'number' ? [s, s, s] : s || [1, 1, 1]);

export const SEMI = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 24, 0, Math.PI);
const TEMPL = {
  box: G.box, cyl: G.cyl, cyl8: G.cyl8, sphere: G.sphere, ico: G.ico, cone: G.cone, cone4: G.cone4,
  plane: G.plane, circle: G.circle, semi: SEMI,
} as const;
export type Shape = keyof typeof TEMPL;
type Kind = 'env' | 'glow' | 'ink';
type AddOpts = { kind?: Kind; cast?: boolean };
type BatchMesh = { geo: THREE.BufferGeometry; kind: Kind; c: string; cast: boolean };

const mtx = (p: Vec3, r?: R, s?: Vec3 | number) =>
  new THREE.Matrix4().compose(new THREE.Vector3(...p), new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(...rotV(r))), new THREE.Vector3(...sclV(s)));

/** Collects primitives and merges them into one geometry per (colour, material kind, cast flag). */
export class Batch {
  private groups = new Map<string, { kind: Kind; c: string; cast: boolean; geos: THREE.BufferGeometry[] }>();
  private stack: THREE.Matrix4[] = [new THREE.Matrix4()];
  private top() {
    return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1];
  }
  /** Run `fn` inside a local transform (position, yaw or euler, scale). */
  at(p: Vec3, r: R | undefined, fn: () => void, s?: Vec3 | number) {
    this.stack.push(this.top().clone().multiply(mtx(p, r, s)));
    fn();
    this.stack.pop();
  }
  add(shape: Shape, c: string, p: Vec3, s: Vec3 | number, r?: R, o: AddOpts = {}) {
    const kind = o.kind ?? 'env';
    const cast = kind === 'glow' ? false : o.cast ?? true;
    const key = `${kind}|${c}|${cast}`;
    let g = this.groups.get(key);
    if (!g) {
      g = { kind, c, cast, geos: [] };
      this.groups.set(key, g);
    }
    g.geos.push(TEMPL[shape].clone().applyMatrix4(this.top().clone().multiply(mtx(p, r, s))));
  }
  box(p: Vec3, s: Vec3, c: string, r?: R, o?: AddOpts) {
    this.add('box', c, p, s, r, o);
  }
  /** Box given by its min/max corners (handy for architecture). */
  span(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, c: string, o?: AddOpts) {
    this.add('box', c, [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2], [Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]), Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]), Math.abs(b[2] - a[2])], 0, o);
  }
  /** Cylinder/stick between two points. */
  stick(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, rad: number, c: string, o?: AddOpts, seg8 = true) {
    const va = new THREE.Vector3(...a), vb = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
    const d = vb.clone().sub(va);
    const len = d.length();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.normalize());
    const e = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(q);
    const mid = va.add(vb).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    this.add(seg8 ? 'cyl8' : 'cyl', c, [mid.x, mid.y, mid.z], [rad, len, rad], [e.x, e.y, e.z], o);
  }
  done(): BatchMesh[] {
    const out: BatchMesh[] = [];
    this.groups.forEach(g => {
      const geo = mergeGeometries(g.geos, false);
      g.geos.forEach(x => x.dispose());
      if (geo) out.push({ geo, kind: g.kind, c: g.c, cast: g.cast });
    });
    return out;
  }
}

const batchCache = new Map<string, BatchMesh[]>();
/** Static merged geometry, built once per `id` (include anything the build depends on in the id). */
export const Batched: React.FC<{ id: string; build: (b: Batch) => void }> = ({ id, build }) => {
  let meshes = batchCache.get(id);
  if (!meshes) {
    const b = new Batch();
    build(b);
    meshes = b.done();
    batchCache.set(id, meshes);
  }
  return (
    <>
      {meshes.map((m, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={m.geo} material={m.kind === 'glow' ? flat(m.c) : m.kind === 'ink' ? inkMaterial() : envMaterial(m.c)} castShadow={m.cast} receiveShadow={m.kind !== 'glow'} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Floors
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const FLAT: Vec3 = [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0];

/** Checkerboard floor tiles (no overlap, so no z-fighting). */
export function checkerFloor(b: Batch, x0: number, x1: number, z0: number, z1: number, size: number, cA: string, cB: string, y = 0) {
  for (let i = 0, x = x0; x < x1 - 1e-4; i++, x += size)
    for (let j = 0, z = z0; z < z1 - 1e-4; j++, z += size) {
      const w = Math.min(size, x1 - x), d = Math.min(size, z1 - z);
      b.add('plane', (i + j) % 2 ? cB : cA, [x + w / 2, y, z + d / 2], [w, d, 1], FLAT, { cast: false });
    }
}

/** Wooden planks running along z, staggered, a few tones. */
export function plankFloor(b: Batch, x0: number, x1: number, z0: number, z1: number, pw: number, tones: string[], seed = 1, y = 0) {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  for (let x = x0; x < x1 - 1e-4; x += pw) {
    const w = Math.min(pw, x1 - x);
    let z = z0 - rand() * 1.6;
    while (z < z1) {
      const len = 1.4 + rand() * 1.4;
      const za = Math.max(z, z0), zb = Math.min(z + len, z1);
      if (zb > za + 1e-4) b.add('plane', tones[Math.floor(rand() * tones.length)], [x + w / 2, y, (za + zb) / 2], [w - 0.008, zb - za - 0.008, 1], FLAT, { cast: false });
      z += len;
    }
  }
  // seam colour underneath the plank gaps
  b.add('plane', mix(tones[0], '#000000', 0.35), [(x0 + x1) / 2, y - 0.002, (z0 + z1) / 2], [x1 - x0, z1 - z0, 1], FLAT, { cast: false });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Room shell
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

type WallProps = { len: number; h: number; c: string; lower?: string; railY?: number; rail?: string; base?: string; thin?: boolean };
const Wall: React.FC<WallProps & { p: Vec3; r: number }> = ({ p, r, len, h, c, lower, railY = 1.0, rail, base, thin }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    {lower ? (
      <>
        <Plane p={[0, railY / 2, 0]} s={[len, railY, 1]} c={lower} />
        <Plane p={[0, railY + (h - railY) / 2, 0]} s={[len, h - railY, 1]} c={c} />
      </>
    ) : (
      <Plane p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[len, h, 1]} c={c} />
    )}
    {base && (thin ? <Plane p={[0, 0.07, 0.006]} s={[len, 0.14, 1]} c={base} /> : <Box p={[0, 0.07, 0.016]} s={[len, 0.14, 0.032]} c={base} shadow={false} />)}
    {rail && lower && (thin ? <Plane p={[0, railY, 0.006]} s={[len, 0.07, 1]} c={rail} /> : <Box p={[0, railY, 0.02]} s={[len, 0.07, 0.04]} c={rail} shadow={false} />)}
  </At>
);

export type ShellProps = {
  x0: number; x1: number; z0: number; z1: number; h: number;
  wall: string; lower?: string; railY?: number; rail?: string; base?: string;
  ceiling: string; ceilingEmissive?: string;
  back?: string; left?: string; right?: string; // per-wall upper colour overrides
  fourth?: boolean; // one-sided wall at z1, visible only from inside (reverse shots)
};

/** Four inward-facing walls + ceiling. Floors are drawn by each set. */
export const Shell: React.FC<ShellProps> = o => {
  const W = o.x1 - o.x0, D = o.z1 - o.z0, cx = (o.x0 + o.x1) / 2, cz = (o.z0 + o.z1) / 2;
  const common = { h: o.h, lower: o.lower, railY: o.railY, rail: o.rail, base: o.base };
  return (
    <>
      <Wall p={[cx, 0, o.z0]} r={0} len={W} c={o.back ?? o.wall} {...common} />
      <Wall p={[o.x0, 0, cz]} r={Math.PI / 2} len={D} c={o.left ?? o.wall} {...common} />
      <Wall p={[o.x1, 0, cz]} r={-Math.PI / 2} len={D} c={o.right ?? o.wall} {...common} />
      {o.fourth && <Wall p={[cx, 0, o.z1]} r={Math.PI} len={W} c={o.wall} {...common} thin />}
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial(o.ceiling, o.ceilingEmissive)} position={[cx, o.h, cz]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[W, D, 1]} receiveShadow />
    </>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Windows with a painted view (unlit, so they glow like daylight)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const isNight = (time: string) => !!PALETTES[time]?.windowsLit && time !== 'void';

const viewTexCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
function viewTexture(night: boolean, seed: number) {
  const key = `${night}|${seed}`;
  const hit = viewTexCache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const W = 512, H = 384;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = W;
  cv.height = H;
  const g = cv.getContext('2d')!;
  const rand = rng(seed * 17 + 5);
  const sky = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  if (night) {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#0b1433');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#2b3f73');
  } else {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#7db4e6');
    sky.addColorStop(0.75, '#d6ecf7');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#e8f4f8');
  }
  g.fillStyle = sky;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const blob = (x: number, y: number, rx: number, ry: number, c: string) => {
    g.fillStyle = c;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
  };
  if (night) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) blob(rand() * W, rand() * H * 0.6, 1.3, 1.3, '#dfe6ff');
    blob(W * (0.2 + rand() * 0.6), H * 0.18, 18, 18, '#f3efd9');
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const x = rand() * W, y = 40 + rand() * 90;
      blob(x, y, 46, 16, '#ffffff');
      blob(x + 30, y - 8, 30, 16, '#ffffff');
    }
  }
  // distant hills, trees, hedge
  const hill = night ? '#1b2a4c' : '#a9cf8c';
  const tree = night ? '#15213d' : '#5aa54a';
  const tree2 = night ? '#121c34' : '#4a9441';
  const hedge = night ? '#101830' : '#4e9a45';
  blob(W * 0.25, H * 0.86, W * 0.45, H * 0.2, hill);
  blob(W * 0.8, H * 0.88, W * 0.4, H * 0.17, hill);
  if (!night) {
    // a house roof peeking over the hedge
    const hx = W * (0.25 + rand() * 0.5);
    g.fillStyle = '#e8c9a0';
    g.fillRect(hx - 60, H * 0.62, 120, 80);
    g.fillStyle = '#8e5b4c';
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(hx - 74, H * 0.63);
    g.lineTo(hx, H * 0.48);
    g.lineTo(hx + 74, H * 0.63);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = '#b9d4e6';
    g.fillRect(hx - 40, H * 0.68, 26, 22);
    g.fillRect(hx + 14, H * 0.68, 26, 22);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const x = (i + 0.3 + rand() * 0.4) * (W / 4);
    const s = 0.8 + rand() * 0.5;
    g.fillStyle = night ? '#0e1529' : '#6b4a35';
    g.fillRect(x - 5 * s, H * 0.7, 10 * s, H * 0.2);
    blob(x, H * 0.62 - 10 * s, 48 * s, 52 * s, i % 2 ? tree : tree2);
  }
  g.fillStyle = hedge;
  g.fillRect(0, H * 0.84, W, H * 0.16);
  for (let x = 0; x < W + 40; x += 40) blob(x, H * 0.85, 26, 16, hedge);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.anisotropy = 4;
  viewTexCache.set(key, tex);
  return tex;
}

const viewMatCache = new Map<string, THREE.MeshBasicMaterial>();
export function viewMaterial(night: boolean, seed = 1) {
  const key = `${night}|${seed % 4}`;
  let m = viewMatCache.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: viewTexture(night, seed % 4), toneMapped: false });
    viewMatCache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

/** Window on a wall. Local +z points into the room; `p` is the pane centre on the wall plane. */
export const RoomWindow: React.FC<{
  p: Vec3; r?: number; w: number; h: number; frame?: string; night?: boolean; seed?: number; cols?: number; cross?: boolean;
  sill?: boolean; curtain?: string; blinds?: boolean;
}> = ({ p, r = 0, w, h, frame = '#f4f0e8', night = false, seed = 1, cols = 2, cross = true, sill = true, curtain }) => {
  const t = 0.07;
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={viewMaterial(night, seed)} position={[0, 0, 0.008]} scale={[w, h, 1]} />
      <Box p={[0, h / 2 + t / 2, 0.05]} s={[w + 2 * t, t, 0.1]} c={frame} />
      <Box p={[0, -h / 2 - t / 2, 0.05]} s={[w + 2 * t, t, 0.1]} c={frame} />
      <Box p={[-w / 2 - t / 2, 0, 0.05]} s={[t, h, 0.1]} c={frame} />
      <Box p={[w / 2 + t / 2, 0, 0.05]} s={[t, h, 0.1]} c={frame} />
      {Array.from({ length: cols - 1 }, (_, i) => (
        <Box key={i} p={[-w / 2 + ((i + 1) * w) / cols, 0, 0.03]} s={[0.045, h, 0.05]} c={frame} />
      ))}
      {cross && <Box p={[0, h * 0.12, 0.03]} s={[w, 0.045, 0.05]} c={frame} />}
      {sill && <Box p={[0, -h / 2 - t - 0.02, 0.1]} s={[w + 0.3, 0.05, 0.2]} c={frame} />}
      {curtain && (
        <>
          <Cyl p={[0, h / 2 + 0.2, 0.16]} r={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} s={[0.02, w + 1.1, 0.02]} c="#3a3438" />
          {[-1, 1].map(sd => (
            <group key={sd}>
              <Box p={[sd * (w / 2 + 0.22), -0.08, 0.16]} s={[0.4, h + 0.55, 0.07]} c={curtain} />
              <Box p={[sd * (w / 2 + 0.1), -0.08, 0.2]} s={[0.12, h + 0.55, 0.05]} c={mix(curtain, '#000000', 0.12)} />
              <Box p={[sd * (w / 2 + 0.34), -0.08, 0.2]} s={[0.12, h + 0.55, 0.05]} c={mix(curtain, '#ffffff', 0.12)} />
            </group>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
    </At>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Painted (canvas-textured) surfaces: boards, posters, menus. Cached per id.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

type Draw = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, W: number, H: number) => void;
const paintCache = new Map<string, THREE.Material>();
export function paintedMaterial(id: string, W: number, H: number, draw: Draw, lit = true): THREE.Material {
  const key = `${id}|${lit}`;
  let m = paintCache.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
    cv.width = W;
    cv.height = H;
    draw(cv.getContext('2d')!, W, H);
    const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
    tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    tex.anisotropy = 8;
    m = lit ? new THREE.MeshToonMaterial({ map: tex, gradientMap: toonGradient([110, 190, 255]) }) : new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, toneMapped: false });
    paintCache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

/** A plane showing a canvas drawing (`px` = canvas pixels per metre). Local +z faces out. */
export const Painted: React.FC<{ id: string; p: Vec3; r?: R; w: number; h: number; px?: number; draw: Draw; lit?: boolean }> = ({ id, p, r, w, h, px = 256, draw, lit = true }) => (
  <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={paintedMaterial(id, Math.round(w * px), Math.round(h * px), draw, lit)} position={p} rotation={rotV(r)} scale={[w, h, 1]} receiveShadow={lit} />
);

export const HAND_FONT = '"Comic Sans MS", "Segoe Print", "Chalkboard SE", cursive';
export const BOLD_FONT = '"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Wall decor
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Framed picture. Local +z out of the wall. */
export const Picture: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number; w: number; h: number; frame?: string; art?: 'abstract' | 'landscape' | 'dots' | 'sun'; bg?: string; seed?: number }> = ({
  p, r = 0, w, h, frame = '#2a2b33', art = 'abstract', bg, seed = 1,
}) => {
  const rand = rng(seed * 11 + 3);
  const iw = w - 0.1, ih = h - 0.1;
  const z = 0.036;
  const C = (x: number, y: number, rad: number, c: string, k: number) => (
    <mesh key={k} geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial(c)} position={[x * iw, y * ih, z + 0.004 * (k + 1)]} scale={rad * Math.min(iw, ih)} receiveShadow />
  );
  const S = (x: number, y: number, rad: number, c: string, k: number) => (
    <mesh key={k} geometry={SEMI} material={envMaterial(c)} position={[x * iw, y * ih, z + 0.004 * (k + 1)]} scale={[rad * iw, rad * iw * 0.7, 1]} receiveShadow />
  );
  let shapes: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let back = bg;
  if (art === 'abstract') {
    back = back ?? '#22232c';
    const cols = ['#e2483d', '#f2b632', '#f4efe2', '#3d8fd6', '#e46f8e'];
    const o = Math.floor(rand() * cols.length);
    shapes = [C(-0.12 + rand() * 0.1, 0.12, 0.26, cols[o], 0), C(0.15, -0.1 - rand() * 0.1, 0.18, cols[(o + 1) % 5], 1), C(-0.18, -0.25, 0.1, cols[(o + 2) % 5], 2)];
  } else if (art === 'landscape') {
    back = back ?? '#9fd0ee';
    shapes = [C(0.22, 0.22, 0.12, '#f7d65a', 0), S(-0.2, -0.5, 0.55, '#6cb85a', 1), S(0.3, -0.5, 0.45, '#4f9a45', 2)];
  } else if (art === 'dots') {
    back = back ?? '#f4efe2';
    const cols = ['#e2483d', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b'];
    shapes = cols.map((c, i) => C(-0.3 + (i % 2) * 0.6 * 0.9, 0.22 - Math.floor(i / 2) * 0.44, 0.15, c, i));
  } else {
    back = back ?? '#f3d9a4';
    shapes = [C(0, 0.05, 0.3, '#e9853d', 0), C(0, 0.05, 0.2, '#f6c04a', 1)];
  }
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, 0, 0.016]} s={[w, h, 0.032]} c={frame} />
      <Plane p={[0, 0, z]} s={[iw, ih, 1]} c={back} />
      {shapes}
    </At>
  );
};

/** Cork pin board with pastel notes (IFOLOGY kitchen). Local +z out of the wall. */
export const Pinboard: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number; h?: number; seed?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 0.9, h = 0.65, seed = 2 }) => {
  const notes = ['#f2a7b5', '#9fd0ee', '#f7d65a', '#a9d98f', '#f4efe2'];
  const rand = rng(seed);
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, 0, 0.02]} s={[w, h, 0.04]} c="#9a6a42" />
      <Plane p={[0, 0, 0.041]} s={[w - 0.08, h - 0.08, 1]} c="#c99a63" />
      {[0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => {
        const x = (i % 2 ? 0.2 : -0.2) * w + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.06, y = (i < 2 ? 0.17 : -0.15) * h + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.04;
        return (
          <group key={i}>
            <Box p={[x, y, 0.046]} r={[0, 0, (rand() - 0.5) * 0.25]} s={[0.26 * w, 0.32 * h, 0.006]} c={notes[(i + seed) % notes.length]} shadow={false} />
            <Cyl p={[x, y + 0.11 * h, 0.052]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.012, 0.01, 0.012]} c="#d9472b" shadow={false} />
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </At>
  );
};

/** Glowing flush ceiling panel (classroom) or round lamp. Sits just under the ceiling at y=h. */
export const CeilingPanel: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; w?: number; d?: number; round?: boolean; frame?: string; lit?: string }> = ({ p, w = 1.2, d = 0.6, round, frame = '#d9dbe0', lit = '#fbfaf4' }) =>
  round ? (
    <At p={p}>
      <Cyl p={[0, -0.03, 0]} s={[w / 2, 0.06, w / 2]} c={frame} shadow={false} />
      <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={flat(lit)} position={[0, -0.061, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={w / 2 - 0.04} />
    </At>
  ) : (
    <At p={p}>
      <Box p={[0, -0.025, 0]} s={[w + 0.08, 0.05, d + 0.08]} c={frame} shadow={false} />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={flat(lit)} position={[0, -0.051, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[w, d, 1]} />
    </At>
  );

/** Leafy potted plant (spiky leaves, like IFOLOGY's kitchen plants). */
export const LeafPlant: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; s?: number; pot?: string; leaf?: string; seed?: number }> = ({ p, s = 1, pot = '#e9e2d4', leaf = '#4e9a45', seed = 1 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed * 7 + 1);
  const n = 7;
  return (
    <At p={p} s={s}>
      <Cyl p={[0, 0.16, 0]} s={[0.17, 0.32, 0.17]} c={pot} />
      <Cyl p={[0, 0.33, 0]} s={[0.15, 0.02, 0.15]} c="#5b3d2e" shadow={false} />
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
        const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + rand() * 0.4;
        const tilt = 0.35 + rand() * 0.45;
        const len = 0.42 + rand() * 0.25;
        return (
          <group key={i} position={[0, 0.32, 0]} rotation={[0, a, 0]}>
            <group rotation={[tilt, 0, 0]}>
              <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial(i % 2 ? leaf : mix(leaf, '#ffffff', 0.15))} position={[0, len / 2, 0]} scale={[0.07, len / 2, 0.025]} castShadow receiveShadow />
            </group>
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </At>
  );
};

/** Bowl of fruit for tables and counters. */
export const FruitBowl: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; s?: number }> = ({ p, s = 1 }) => (
  <At p={p} s={s}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.04, 0]} s={[0.17, 0.08, 0.17]} c="#f4efe2" />
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.01, 0]} s={[0.1, 0.02, 0.1]} c="#e3dccd" />
    <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial('#f08a24')} position={[-0.06, 0.12, 0.02]} scale={0.065} castShadow receiveShadow />
    <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial('#d9332b')} position={[0.06, 0.12, -0.02]} scale={0.06} castShadow receiveShadow />
    <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial('#9bc53d')} position={[0.0, 0.17, 0.04]} scale={0.058} castShadow receiveShadow />
    <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial('#f2c94c')} position={[0.02, 0.13, -0.08]} rotation-z={0.6} scale={[0.11, 0.035, 0.035]} castShadow receiveShadow />
  </At>
);

/** Low-poly sofa. Faces local +z. Seat top ≈ 0.52 m. */
export const Sofa: React.FC<{ p?: Vec3; r?: number; w?: number; c?: string; pillow?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, w = 2.2, c = '#3e5c8a', pillow = '#e8b84a' }) => {
  const cu = mix(c, '#ffffff', 0.12);
  const iw = (w - 0.44) / 2 - 0.02;
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, 0.25, 0]} s={[w, 0.3, 0.92]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0, 0.68, -0.36]} s={[w, 0.66, 0.2]} c={c} />
      {[-1, 1].map(sd => (
        <group key={sd}>
          <Box p={[sd * (w / 2 - 0.11), 0.48, 0.02]} s={[0.22, 0.42, 0.92]} c={c} />
          <Box p={[sd * (iw / 2 + 0.01), 0.46, 0.08]} s={[iw, 0.16, 0.7]} c={cu} />
          <Box p={[sd * (iw / 2 + 0.01), 0.76, -0.2]} r={[-0.14, 0, 0]} s={[iw, 0.44, 0.15]} c={cu} />
          <Cyl p={[sd * (w / 2 - 0.12), 0.05, 0.36]} s={[0.04, 0.1, 0.04]} c="#3a2a22" />
          <Cyl p={[sd * (w / 2 - 0.12), 0.05, -0.36]} s={[0.04, 0.1, 0.04]} c="#3a2a22" />
        </group>
      ))}
      <Box p={[-w / 2 + 0.42, 0.68, -0.08]} r={[-0.2, 0.25, 0.1]} s={[0.36, 0.34, 0.12]} c={pillow} />
      <Box p={[w / 2 - 0.42, 0.68, -0.08]} r={[-0.2, -0.3, -0.08]} s={[0.34, 0.32, 0.12]} c={mix(pillow, '#e2483d', 0.6)} />
    </At>
  );
};

/** Simple floor lamp; `on` makes the shade glow. */
export const FloorLamp: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; on?: boolean; shade?: string }> = ({ p, on, shade = '#f4efe2' }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.02, 0]} s={[0.17, 0.04, 0.17]} c="#2b2d36" />
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.8, 0]} s={[0.018, 1.56, 0.018]} c="#2b2d36" />
    <Cyl p={[0, 1.66, 0]} s={[0.2, 0.3, 0.2]} c={on ? '#ffe7b0' : shade} glow={on} />
  </At>
);

/** Low-poly seated extra (cheap stickman: merged into a Batch). Faces local +z, chair seat at ~0.47. */
export function seatedExtra(b: Batch, p: Vec3, yaw: number, shirt: string, pants: string, seed: number, armsOnDesk = true, handY = 0.3) {
  const rand = rng(seed * 13 + 7);
  const lean = (rand() - 0.5) * 0.12;
  b.at(p, yaw, () => {
    const hy = 0.5;
    b.box([0, hy + 0.27, -0.02], [0.36, 0.5, 0.22], shirt, [lean * 0.5, 0, 0]);
    b.box([0, hy + 0.04, 0.0], [0.34, 0.1, 0.24], pants);
    const hx = lean * 0.4, hh = hy + 0.73;
    b.add('sphere', '#020203', [hx, hh, 0.0], 0.2, 0, { kind: 'ink' });
    // tiny IFOLOGY face: two vertical eye ovals + a smile, unlit white
    const happy = rand() < 0.5;
    for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
      b.add('sphere', '#f4f1ea', [hx + sd * 0.045, hh - 0.04, 0.188], happy ? [0.016, 0.008, 0.008] : [0.01, 0.018, 0.008], 0, { kind: 'glow' });
      b.add('sphere', '#f4f1ea', [hx + sd * 0.017, hh - 0.098, 0.176], [0.02, 0.0045, 0.008], [0, 0, sd * 0.35], { kind: 'glow' });
    }
    // legs: thighs forward, shins down
    for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
      b.stick([sd * 0.09, hy, 0.02], [sd * 0.1, hy + 0.02, 0.42], 0.05, pants);
      b.stick([sd * 0.1, hy + 0.02, 0.42], [sd * 0.1, 0.06, 0.44], 0.025, '#111114');
      b.box([sd * 0.1, 0.04, 0.48], [0.1, 0.08, 0.2], '#f1eee8');
      if (armsOnDesk) {
        b.stick([sd * 0.2, hy + 0.48, -0.02], [sd * 0.22, hy + 0.26, 0.18], 0.035, shirt);
        b.stick([sd * 0.22, hy + 0.26, 0.18], [sd * 0.1, hy + handY, 0.42], 0.02, '#111114');
        b.add('sphere', '#020203', [sd * 0.09, hy + handY, 0.45], 0.03, 0, { kind: 'ink' });
      } else {
        b.stick([sd * 0.2, hy + 0.48, -0.02], [sd * 0.23, hy + 0.22, 0.1], 0.035, shirt);
        b.stick([sd * 0.23, hy + 0.22, 0.1], [sd * 0.15, hy + 0.08, 0.3], 0.02, '#111114');
      }
    }
  });
}

export { rng, mix };

// American-football stadium: striped turf with yard lines, numbers and coloured end zones, yellow
// goal posts, stepped stands on all four sides filled with an instanced crowd (~13k people in a
// handful of draw calls), floodlight towers in the corners and a scoreboard above the west stand.
//
// Field along x: end lines x = ±54.86, sidelines z = ±24.38, midfield x = 0. Turf top y = 0.02.
// Long stands front wall at z = ±33 (seats from y 2.2 up), end stands at x = ±64.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { envMaterial, flat, inkMaterial } from '../engine/materials';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import { At, Box, Cyl, G, mix, rng, Sign, textTexture } from './kit';
import { decalMaterial, Halo, Inst, Instances, lampsOn, mapMaterial } from './outdoorKit';

const HL = 54.86, HW = 24.38; // half length (incl. end zones), half width
const YD = 0.9144;
const GOAL_LINE = HL - 10 * YD; // 45.72
const TURF_Y = 0.02;
const STAND_Z = 33, STAND_X = 64; // stand front walls
const H0 = 2.2, RD = 0.85, RISE = 0.42; // front wall height, row depth, row rise
const LONG_ROWS = 30, END_ROWS = 18;
const HOME = '#2f4f9a', AWAY = '#2f7a5a'; // no gray: the hero's jacket is the only gray on screen

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Geometry
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/** Stepped stand cross-section (x = outward distance, y = height), extruded 1 m along z. */
function standGeo(rows: number) {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  s.moveTo(0, 0);
  s.lineTo(0, H0);
  for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
    s.lineTo((i + 1) * RD, H0 + i * RISE);
    s.lineTo((i + 1) * RD, H0 + (i + 1) * RISE);
  }
  const top = H0 + rows * RISE;
  s.lineTo(rows * RD, top + 2.6);
  s.lineTo(rows * RD + 0.6, top + 2.6);
  s.lineTo(rows * RD + 0.6, 0);
  s.lineTo(0, 0);
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 1, bevelEnabled: false });
  g.translate(0, 0, -0.5);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
const longStand = standGeo(LONG_ROWS);
const endStand = standGeo(END_ROWS);
const headGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8);
const torsoGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.5, 1, 3, 10); // 2 units tall, 1 wide
const armGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6);
const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

const AISLES = [-36, -12, 12, 36];
const SHIRTS = ['#5a8f9e', '#3d6fb6', '#f2b632', '#4e9a6b', '#e7e1d3', '#7a4fa0', '#e46f8e', '#2d2f3a', '#ff8a3a', '#7fc2e8'];

type StandSpec = { rows: number; len: number; ry: number; at: Vec3; team: string; seed: number; gap?: [number, number, number] };
// ry maps the stand's local +x (outward) to the world: +z → -π/2, -z → π/2, +x → 0, -x → π.
const STANDS: StandSpec[] = [
  { rows: LONG_ROWS, len: 112, ry: -Math.PI / 2, at: [0, 0, STAND_Z], team: HOME, seed: 1, gap: [0, 2, 4] }, // near (+z) stand, hero seat gap at x≈0
  { rows: LONG_ROWS, len: 112, ry: Math.PI / 2, at: [0, 0, -STAND_Z], team: AWAY, seed: 2 },
  { rows: END_ROWS, len: 62, ry: 0, at: [STAND_X, 0, 0], team: HOME, seed: 3 },
  { rows: END_ROWS, len: 62, ry: Math.PI, at: [-STAND_X, 0, 0], team: AWAY, seed: 4 },
];

/** World position of a point given in stand-local coords (u = outward, v = height, w = along). */
function standToWorld(st: StandSpec, u: number, v: number, w: number): Vec3 {
  const c = Math.cos(st.ry), sn = Math.sin(st.ry);
  // local (x=u, z=w) rotated about y by ry: x' = x cos + z sin, z' = -x sin + z cos
  return [st.at[0] + u * c + w * sn, st.at[1] + v, st.at[2] - u * sn + w * c];
}

function crowdFor(st: StandSpec) {
  const rand = rng(st.seed * 97 + 13);
  const bodies: Inst[] = [], heads: Inst[] = [], arms: Inst[] = [];
  const c = Math.cos(st.ry), sn = Math.sin(st.ry);
  const dirW = (u: number, v: number, w: number) => new THREE.Vector3(u * c + w * sn, v, -u * sn + w * c).normalize();
  const dx = 0.58;
  const n = Math.floor(st.len / dx);
  for (let i = 0; i < st.rows; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      const w = -st.len / 2 + (j + 0.5) * dx + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.12;
      const r1 = rand();
      if (r1 < 0.07) continue; // empty seat
      if (st.gap && i >= st.gap[1] && i <= st.gap[2] && Math.abs(w - st.gap[0]) < 1.6) continue;
      if (st.rows === LONG_ROWS && AISLES.some(a => Math.abs(w - a) < 0.75)) continue; // stair aisles
      const stand = rand() < 0.12;
      const base = H0 + i * RISE;
      const u = i * RD + RD * 0.55;
      const shirt = rand() < 0.45 ? (rand() < 0.75 ? st.team : '#f4f1ea') : SHIRTS[Math.floor(rand() * SHIRTS.length)];
      const hb = stand ? 0.85 : 0.52; // body centre above the tread
      const bh = stand ? 0.74 : 0.6;
      bodies.push({ p: standToWorld(st, u, base + hb, w), s: [0.3, bh / 2, 0.4], r: st.ry, c: shirt });
      heads.push({ p: standToWorld(st, u, base + hb + bh / 2 + 0.13, w), s: 0.16 });
      if (rand() < 0.2) {
        // cheering: both arms up and out
        const spread = 0.35 + rand() * 0.35;
        [-1, 1].forEach(sd => {
          const d = dirW(0.08, 1, sd * spread);
          const sh = standToWorld(st, u, base + hb + bh / 2 - 0.08, w + sd * 0.17);
          arms.push({ p: [sh[0] + d.x * 0.28, sh[1] + d.y * 0.28, sh[2] + d.z * 0.28], s: [0.035, 0.56, 0.035], q: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(UP, d) });
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { bodies, heads, arms };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pieces
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const GoalPost: React.FC<{ x: number }> = ({ x }) => {
  const sgn = Math.sign(x);
  const y = '#f2c53c';
  const back = x + sgn * 1.8;
  return (
    <group>
      <Cyl p={[back, 1.6, 0]} s={[0.16, 3.2, 0.16]} c={y} />
      <Box p={[back, 1.0, 0]} s={[0.5, 2.0, 0.5]} c="#2a3550" />
      <Cyl p={[(back + x) / 2, 3.05, 0]} r={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} s={[0.12, Math.abs(back - x), 0.12]} c={y} />
      <Cyl p={[x, 3.05, 0]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.1, 5.64, 0.1]} c={y} />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Cyl p={[x, 3.05 + 4.5, s * 2.82]} s={[0.08, 9, 0.08]} c={y} />
          <Box p={[x, 12.2, s * 2.82 + 0.18]} s={[0.02, 0.6, 0.32]} c="#e8453c" shadow={false} />
        </group>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

const Floodlight: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; on: boolean }> = ({ p, on }) => {
  // bank faces the field centre
  const ry = Math.atan2(-p[0], -p[2]);
  const H = 36;
  return (
    <At p={p}>
      <Cyl p={[0, H / 2, 0]} s={[0.55, H, 0.55]} c="#8c93a3" seg8 />
      <Cyl p={[0, 0.6, 0]} s={[1.0, 1.2, 1.0]} c="#6d7383" seg8 />
      <At p={[0, H + 2.2, 0]} r={ry}>
        <group rotation={[0.35, 0, 0]}>
          <Box p={[0, 0, -0.35]} s={[8.6, 5.2, 0.5]} c="#4d5262" />
          {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
            <mesh key={i} geometry={G.plane} material={on ? flat('#fffbe8') : envMaterial('#dcdcd6')} position={[-3.3 + (i % 4) * 2.2, -1.6 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 1.6, -0.09]} scale={[1.8, 1.25, 1]} />
          ))}
          {on && <Halo p={[0, 0, 0.6]} r={9} c="#fff4d6" o={0.5} />}
        </group>
      </At>
    </At>
  );
};

const Scoreboard: React.FC<{ on: boolean }> = ({ on }) => (
  <At p={[-84, 0, 0]} r={Math.PI / 2}>
    {[-8, 8].map(x => <Box key={x} p={[x, 7, -0.6]} s={[0.9, 14, 0.9]} c="#4d5262" />)}
    <Box p={[0, 19.5, -0.4]} s={[28, 12, 0.8]} c="#1d2333" />
    <Box p={[0, 25.8, -0.4]} s={[28.6, 0.6, 1.0]} c={HOME} />
    <Sign p={[0, 23.6, 0.02]} w={22} h={2.6} text="ESTÁDIO MUNICIPAL" bg="#1d2333" fg="#f2c53c" />
    <Sign p={[-7, 18.6, 0.02]} w={9} h={6} text={'HOME\n21'} bg="#24305a" fg="#ffffff" />
    <Sign p={[7, 18.6, 0.02]} w={9} h={6} text={'AWAY\n14'} bg="#24503a" fg="#ffffff" />
    <Sign p={[0, 18.6, 0.02]} w={4.2} h={6} text={'Q4\n2:00'} bg="#111522" fg="#ffd27e" />
    <Sign p={[0, 14.4, 0.02]} w={24} h={1.6} text="GOOOL!" bg="#111522" fg="#7fe0ff" />
    {on && <Halo p={[0, 19.5, 2]} r={16} c="#9fb8ff" o={0.18} />}
  </At>
);

const BOARD_TEXT = ['HOME', 'GO TEAM!', 'STICK SODA', 'SPORTS 24', 'FAST FOOD', 'DEFENSE!', 'HOT DOGS', 'PURPLE PRIDE'];
// empty variant = a school field: school banners instead of game-day ads (PT-BR content)
const SCHOOL_TEXT = ['ESCOLA', 'VAI, TIME!', 'EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA', 'CANTINA', 'JOGOS ESCOLARES', 'FEIRA DE CIÊNCIAS', 'TORNEIO', 'BIBLIOTECA'];
const BOARD_BG = ['#6d3fc4', '#2f4f9a', '#3fb3c4', '#1d2333', '#f2b632', '#2f7a5a'];

const Field: React.FC = React.memo(() => {
  const stripes: Inst[] = [];
  const lines: Inst[] = [];
  // 5-yard mowing stripes between the goal lines
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const x = -GOAL_LINE + (i + 0.5) * 5 * YD;
    stripes.push({ p: [x, TURF_Y / 2, 0], s: [5 * YD, TURF_Y, HW * 2], c: i % 2 ? '#5fb54c' : '#55a845' });
  }
  // yard lines (every 5 yd), goal lines thicker
  for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
    const x = -GOAL_LINE + i * 5 * YD;
    lines.push({ p: [x, TURF_Y + 0.006, 0], s: [i % 20 === 0 ? 0.2 : 0.11, 0.012, HW * 2] });
  }
  // hash marks every yard: near both sidelines and the two inbound rows
  for (let i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
    if (i % 5 === 0) continue;
    const x = -GOAL_LINE + i * YD;
    [HW - 0.5, 2.82, -2.82, -HW + 0.5].forEach(z => lines.push({ p: [x, TURF_Y + 0.006, z], s: [0.1, 0.012, 0.6] }));
  }
  // border
  [-1, 1].forEach(s => {
    lines.push({ p: [0, TURF_Y + 0.006, s * (HW + 0.1)], s: [HL * 2 + 0.4, 0.012, 0.2] });
    lines.push({ p: [s * (HL + 0.1), TURF_Y + 0.006, 0], s: [0.2, 0.012, HW * 2 + 0.4] });
  });
  const nums = ['10', '20', '30', '40', '50', '40', '30', '20', '10'];
  return (
    <group>
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={envMaterial('#ffffff')} items={() => stripes} k="stripes" />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Box p={[s * (GOAL_LINE + 5 * YD), TURF_Y / 2, 0]} s={[10 * YD, TURF_Y, HW * 2]} c={s > 0 ? HOME : AWAY} shadow={false} />
          <group position={[s * (GOAL_LINE + 5 * YD), TURF_Y + 0.004, 0]} rotation={[0, -s * Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
            <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={mapMaterial(textTexture('CASA', { w: 1024, h: 256, fg: '#ffffff' }), false, true)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[34, 8.5, 1]} receiveShadow />
          </group>
        </group>
      ))}
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#f6f4ee')} items={() => lines} k="lines" />
      {/* yard numbers, bottoms towards their sideline */}
      {nums.map((n, i) => {
        const x = -GOAL_LINE + (i + 1) * 10 * YD;
        return [-1, 1].map(s => (
          <group key={`${i}${s}`} position={[x, TURF_Y + 0.004, s * (HW - 11.9)]} rotation={[0, s > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI, 0]}>
            <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={mapMaterial(textTexture(n, { w: 256, h: 192, fg: '#f6f4ee' }), false, true)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[3.2, 2.4, 1]} receiveShadow />
          </group>
        ));
      })}
      {/* midfield logo */}
      <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={decalMaterial('#6d3fc4')} position={[0, TURF_Y + 0.003, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={4.2} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={decalMaterial('#9f7bea')} position={[0, TURF_Y + 0.004, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={3.7} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={mapMaterial(textTexture('E.E.\nSOL',{ w: 256, h: 256, fg: '#ffffff' }), false, true)} position={[0, TURF_Y + 0.006, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={5.4} receiveShadow />
      {/* pylons */}
      {[-1, 1].map(sx => [-1, 1].map(sz => [GOAL_LINE, HL].map(x => <Box key={`${sx}${sz}${x}`} p={[sx * x, 0.25, sz * HW]} s={[0.12, 0.46, 0.12]} c="#ff7a1f" />)))}
      <GoalPost x={HL} />
      <GoalPost x={-HL} />
    </group>
  );
});

const Stand: React.FC<{ st: StandSpec; i: number; empty?: boolean }> = React.memo(({ st, i, empty }) => {
  const crowd = React.useMemo(() => crowdFor(st), [st]);
  const geo = st.rows === LONG_ROWS ? longStand : endStand;
  const top = H0 + st.rows * RISE;
  const boards: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const nb = Math.floor(st.len / 9);
  for (let b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
    const w = -st.len / 2 + (b + 0.5) * (st.len / nb);
    const k = (b + i * 3) % BOARD_TEXT.length;
    const text = (empty ? SCHOOL_TEXT : BOARD_TEXT)[k];
    const p = standToWorld(st, -0.02, 1.15, w);
    boards.push(<Sign key={b} p={p} r={st.ry + Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI} w={st.len / nb - 0.4} h={1.5} text={text} bg={BOARD_BG[(b + i) % BOARD_BG.length]} fg="#ffffff" />);
  }
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={geo} material={envMaterial(i < 2 ? '#8e9ab3' : '#9aa3b8')} position={st.at} rotation={[0, st.ry, 0]} scale={[1, 1, st.len]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {/* aisle stripes (stairs) on the long stands */}
      {st.rows === LONG_ROWS && AISLES.map(w => {
        const p = standToWorld(st, (st.rows * RD) / 2, H0 + (st.rows * RISE) / 2 + 0.02, w);
        return <mesh key={w} geometry={G.box} material={envMaterial('#c9ced9')} position={p} rotation={[0, st.ry, Math.atan2(RISE, RD)]} scale={[Math.hypot(st.rows * RD, st.rows * RISE), 0.06, 1.2]} receiveShadow />;
      })}
      {/* roof canopy over the long stands */}
      {st.rows === LONG_ROWS && (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={G.box} material={envMaterial('#e9ebef')} position={standToWorld(st, st.rows * RD - 8, top + 7.6, 0)} rotation={[0, st.ry, 0]} scale={[17, 0.6, st.len + 2]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          {[-48, -24, 0, 24, 48].map(w => (
            <mesh key={w} geometry={G.box} material={envMaterial('#c9ced9')} position={standToWorld(st, st.rows * RD + 0.3, top + 3.65, w)} rotation={[0, st.ry, 0]} scale={[0.5, 7.5, 0.5]} castShadow />
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {boards}
      {!empty && (
        <>
          <Instances geo={torsoGeo} mat={envMaterial('#ffffff')} items={() => crowd.bodies} k={`b${i}`} />
          <Instances geo={armGeo} mat={inkMaterial()} items={() => crowd.arms} k={`a${i}`} receive={false} />
          <Instances geo={headGeo} mat={inkMaterial()} items={() => crowd.heads} k={`h${i}`} receive={false} />
        </>
      )}
    </group>
  );
});

const StadiumScene: React.FC<{ time: string; empty?: boolean }> = React.memo(({ time, empty }) => {
  const on = lampsOn(time);
  return (
    <group>
      {/* apron turf and outer concourse */}
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#4c9a45')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[2 * STAND_X + 2, 2 * STAND_Z + 2, 1]} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#9aa0ac')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.02, 0]} scale={[900, 900, 1]} receiveShadow />
      <Field />
      {STANDS.map((st, i) => <Stand key={i} st={st} i={i} empty={empty} />)}
      {/* corner walls close the gaps between stands */}
      {[-1, 1].map(sx => [-1, 1].map(sz => (
        <Box key={`${sx}${sz}`} p={[sx * (STAND_X - 4), 2.2, sz * (STAND_Z + 6)]} s={[8, 4.4, 12]} c="#7f8aa3" />
      )))}
      {/* team benches + coolers */}
      {[-1, 1].map(s => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Box p={[-15, 0.45, s * 29.2]} s={[14, 0.12, 0.6]} c={s > 0 ? HOME : AWAY} />
          <Box p={[-15, 0.8, s * 29.55]} s={[14, 0.6, 0.1]} c={s > 0 ? HOME : AWAY} />
          {[-21, -17, -13, -9].map(x => <Box key={x} p={[x, 0.22, s * 29.2]} s={[0.1, 0.44, 0.5]} c="#2a2d36" />)}
          {[-23, -7].map(x => (
            <group key={x}>
              <Cyl p={[x, 0.35, s * 28.6]} s={[0.32, 0.7, 0.32]} c="#ff8a1f" />
              <Cyl p={[x, 0.74, s * 28.6]} s={[0.34, 0.08, 0.34]} c="#f4f1ea" />
            </group>
          ))}
        </group>
      ))}
      {[[-62, -42], [62, -42], [-62, 42], [62, 42]].map(([x, z], i) => <Floodlight key={i} p={[x, 0, z]} on={on} />)}
      <Scoreboard on={on} />
      {/* distant city silhouette so the horizon isn't empty above the stands */}
      {Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => {
        const a = (i / 18) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.2;
        const h = 28 + ((i * 37) % 5) * 7;
        return <Box key={i} p={[Math.cos(a) * 190, h / 2, Math.sin(a) * 190]} s={[22, h, 22]} c={mix('#8e98b0', '#c4cbe0', (i % 3) / 3)} shadow={false} />;
      })}
    </group>
  );
});

// variant odd = empty stands (a school field on a day with no game)
export const StadiumSet: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ time, variant }) => <StadiumScene time={time} empty={variant % 2 === 1} />;

export const STADIUM_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  midfield: [0, TURF_Y, 0], // on the 50 (midfield logo)
  center: [0, TURF_Y, 3.5],
  goal: [GOAL_LINE + 4, TURF_Y, 0], // in the east end zone, goal posts behind (+x)
  goalLine: [GOAL_LINE, TURF_Y, -1.5],
  sideline: [-6, TURF_Y, HW + 1.6], // near (+z) sideline, team bench behind
  bench: [-14, 0, 29.2], // seat of the home bench (sit with rot 180 = facing the field)
  stands: [0, H0 + 3 * RISE, STAND_Z + 3 * RD + RD * 0.55], // gap in the crowd, near stand row 4 (rot 180 faces the field)
  tunnel: [-STAND_X + 2, 0, STAND_Z + 2], // corner by the west end
};

// IFOLOGY-style suburban street that tiles forever along X (so speed shots never run out of world).
// Road on z∈[-3.5,3.5]; the "home" sidewalk is z≈-4.5 with lawns and houses behind it (−z).
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { clothMaterial, envMaterial } from '../engine/materials';
import { At, Ball, Box, Car, Cyl, Door, G, rng, Window } from './kit';

export const SEG = 26;

const roofGeo = (() => {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  s.moveTo(-0.5, 0);
  s.lineTo(0.5, 0);
  s.lineTo(0, 0.5);
  s.lineTo(-0.5, 0);
  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 1, bevelEnabled: false });
  g.translate(0, 0, -0.5);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
})();

const blob = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 20);

const WALLS = ['#eab7a4', '#f1d8a0', '#a8c6da', '#dccbb2', '#c8d9a6', '#e2c4d4', '#f2e2c8'];
const ROOFS = ['#8e5b4c', '#5f5876', '#4d5b73', '#9c6a4e', '#6b4e46'];
const DOORS = ['#a33b3b', '#2f5f8a', '#3f7a52', '#7a4fa0', '#c98a2b'];
const CARS = ['#c8402f', '#3d6fb6', '#e9e4da', '#2b2f3a', '#f2b632'];

export const House2: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; seed: number; r?: number }> = ({ p, seed, r = 0 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed * 7 + 3);
  const wall = WALLS[Math.floor(rand() * WALLS.length)];
  const roof = ROOFS[Math.floor(rand() * ROOFS.length)];
  const door = DOORS[Math.floor(rand() * DOORS.length)];
  const w = 8 + rand() * 2.5, d = 7, h = rand() < 0.75 ? 5.6 : 3.1;
  const trim = '#f7f1e6';
  const glass = '#b9d4e6';
  const twoStory = h > 4;
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <Box p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[w, h, d]} c={wall} />
      <Box p={[0, 0.12, 0]} s={[w + 0.15, 0.24, d + 0.15]} c="#c9bfae" />
      <mesh geometry={roofGeo} material={envMaterial(roof)} position={[0, h - 0.02, 0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[d + 0.9, 3.2, w + 0.7]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <Box p={[0, h + 0.02, d / 2 + 0.3]} s={[w + 0.7, 0.12, 0.1]} c={trim} />
      <Door p={[w * 0.22, 0.24, d / 2]} c={door} frame={trim} />
      <Box p={[w * 0.22, 0.28, d / 2 + 0.45]} s={[1.5, 0.12, 0.8]} c="#d8d0c2" />
      <Window p={[-w * 0.22, 1.75, d / 2 + 0.01]} glass={glass} lit={false} frame={trim} w={1.6} h={1.2} bars={2} />
      {twoStory && (
        <>
          <Window p={[-w * 0.22, 4.0, d / 2 + 0.01]} glass={glass} lit={false} frame={trim} w={1.3} h={1.1} bars={2} />
          <Window p={[w * 0.22, 4.0, d / 2 + 0.01]} glass={glass} lit={false} frame={trim} w={1.3} h={1.1} bars={2} />
        </>
      )}
    </At>
  );
};

export const RoundTree: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; s?: number; seed?: number }> = ({ p, s = 1, seed = 1 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed * 13 + 1);
  const leaf = ['#5aa54a', '#4f9b45', '#62ad4f', '#4a9441'][Math.floor(rand() * 4)];
  return (
    <At p={p} s={s}>
      <Cyl p={[0, 1.2, 0]} s={[0.13, 2.4, 0.13]} c="#6b4a35" />
      <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial(leaf)} position={[0, 3.3, 0]} scale={[1.45, 1.35, 1.45]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial(leaf)} position={[0.55, 2.75, 0.35]} scale={0.85} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial(leaf)} position={[-0.6, 2.85, -0.2]} scale={0.9} castShadow receiveShadow />
    </At>
  );
};

/** Bumpy rounded hedge like IFOLOGY's (row of fat blobs). */
export const Hedge: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; len: number; h?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, len, h = 1.1, c = '#4e9a45' }) => {
  const n = Math.max(2, Math.round(len / 0.7));
  const m = envMaterial(c);
  return (
    <At p={p}>
      <mesh geometry={G.box} material={m} position={[0, h * 0.42, 0]} scale={[len, h * 0.84, 0.95]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={blob} material={m} position={[-len / 2 + (i + 0.5) * (len / n), h * 0.72, 0]} scale={[len / n * 0.62, h * 0.38, 0.5]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      ))}
    </At>
  );
};

export const LampPost: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; r?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0 }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 2.4, 0]} s={[0.055, 4.8, 0.055]} c="#2b2e38" />
    <Box p={[0, 4.78, 0.35]} s={[0.08, 0.07, 0.75]} c="#2b2e38" />
    <Box p={[0, 4.7, 0.68]} s={[0.32, 0.12, 0.26]} c="#2b2e38" />
  </At>
);

const Mailbox: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; c?: string }> = ({ p, c = '#2f5f8a' }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Cyl p={[0, 0.5, 0]} s={[0.04, 1.0, 0.04]} c="#6b4a35" />
    <Box p={[0, 1.08, 0]} s={[0.24, 0.24, 0.45]} c={c} />
  </At>
);

const Bin: React.FC<{ p: [number, number, number]; c?: string }> = ({ p, c = '#3f7a52' }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Box p={[0, 0.5, 0]} s={[0.6, 1.0, 0.7]} c={c} />
    <Box p={[0, 1.04, -0.02]} s={[0.64, 0.08, 0.76]} c={c} />
  </At>
);

/** One 26 m block of street. Back side (−z) is the detailed side; front side (+z) is dressed lighter. */
const Segment: React.FC<{ k: number; lamps?: boolean }> = ({ k, lamps = true }) => {
  const x0 = k * SEG;
  const rand = rng(Math.abs(k * 31 + 7));
  const dash: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < SEG / 3; i++) dash.push(<Box key={i} p={[x0 + i * 3 + 0.75, 0.012, 0]} s={[1.5, 0.01, 0.14]} c="#f0c33c" shadow={false} />);
  return (
    <group>
      {/* road, curbs, sidewalks, lawns */}
      <Box p={[x0 + SEG / 2, -0.05, 0]} s={[SEG, 0.1, 7]} c="#3c404d" shadow={false} />
      {dash}
      {[-1, 1].map(sd => (
        <group key={sd}>
          <Box p={[x0 + SEG / 2, 0.012, sd * 3.2]} s={[SEG, 0.01, 0.1]} c="#e8e4da" shadow={false} />
          <Box p={[x0 + SEG / 2, 0.06, sd * 3.575]} s={[SEG, 0.12, 0.15]} c="#bdb7ab" />
          <Box p={[x0 + SEG / 2, 0.05, sd * 4.55]} s={[SEG, 0.1, 1.8]} c="#d9cfbb" shadow={false} />
          {/* sidewalk joints */}
          {Array.from({ length: SEG / 2 }, (_, i) => (
            <Box key={i} p={[x0 + i * 2, 0.102, sd * 4.55]} s={[0.035, 0.005, 1.8]} c="#b9ae98" shadow={false} />
          ))}
          <Box p={[x0 + SEG / 2, 0.04, sd * 15]} s={[SEG, 0.08, 20.9]} c="#5aa548" shadow={false} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* back side: houses, trees, hedges, lamps */}
      <House2 p={[x0 + 6.5, 0.08, -17]} seed={k * 2} />
      <House2 p={[x0 + 19.5, 0.08, -17]} seed={k * 2 + 1} />
      <RoundTree p={[x0 + 13, 0.08, -8.5 - rand() * 2]} s={0.95 + rand() * 0.25} seed={k} />
      {rand() < 0.6 && <RoundTree p={[x0 + 1 + rand() * 3, 0.08, -11]} s={0.8 + rand() * 0.2} seed={k + 50} />}
      <Hedge p={[x0 + 6.5, 0.08, -7.2]} len={6.5 + rand() * 2} />
      {rand() < 0.7 && <Hedge p={[x0 + 19.5, 0.08, -7.2]} len={5 + rand() * 3} c="#4a9441" />}
      <Box p={[x0 + 6.5 + 1.95, 0.085, -10.5]} s={[1.3, 0.02, 6.5]} c="#d9cfbb" shadow={false} />
      <Box p={[x0 + 19.5 + 1.95, 0.085, -10.5]} s={[1.3, 0.02, 6.5]} c="#d9cfbb" shadow={false} />
      <Mailbox p={[x0 + 10.2, 0.1, -5.7]} c={DOORS[Math.floor(rand() * DOORS.length)]} />
      {rand() < 0.5 && <Bin p={[x0 + 22.7, 0.1, -5.8]} />}
      {lamps && k % 2 === 0 && <LampPost p={[x0 + 15, 0.1, -3.9]} r={Math.PI} />}
      {/* front side */}
      <House2 p={[x0 + 13, 0.08, 18]} seed={k * 5 + 101} r={Math.PI} />
      <RoundTree p={[x0 + 4, 0.08, 9]} seed={k + 200} s={1.05} />
      <RoundTree p={[x0 + 22, 0.08, 9.5]} seed={k + 300} />
      <Hedge p={[x0 + 13, 0.08, 7.4]} len={9} />
      {k % 2 === 1 && <LampPost p={[x0 + 15, 0.1, 3.9]} />}
      {rand() < 0.45 && <Car p={[x0 + 8 + rand() * 8, 0, 2.2]} r={Math.PI / 2} c={CARS[Math.floor(rand() * CARS.length)]} />}
    </group>
  );
};

/** Street tiled around `centerX`; covers `behind`/`ahead` metres. */
export const Suburb: React.FC<{ centerX?: number; behind?: number; ahead?: number; lamps?: boolean }> = ({ centerX = 0, behind = 120, ahead = 160, lamps = true }) => {
  const k0 = Math.floor((centerX - behind) / SEG), k1 = Math.floor((centerX + ahead) / SEG);
  const segs: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) segs.push(<Segment key={k} k={k} lamps={lamps} />);
  return (
    <group>
      {segs}
      {/* far ground under everything */}
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#5aa548')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[centerX, -0.02, 0]} scale={[1200, 600, 1]} receiveShadow />
      {/* distant tree line so the horizon isn't empty */}
      {Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => {
        const x = Math.floor(centerX / 30) * 30 - 600 + i * 30;
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={blob} material={clothMaterial('#4b8f4a')} position={[x, 3, -60 - (i % 3) * 6]} scale={[14, 7 + (i % 4), 6]} />;
      })}
    </group>
  );
};

export { Ball };

// "Void" explanation stage (IFOLOGY's navy mind-space): endless navy floor that fades into the
// horizon, a soft spotlight pool + faint beam at the origin, a subtle blueprint grid and a few
// slowly drifting low-poly shapes far behind. Floor y=0; stage centre is the origin.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import { envMaterial, flat, toon } from '../engine/materials';
import { G } from './kit';
import { Batched } from './roomkit';

const FLOOR = '#1c2649';
const GRID = '#1b2549';

let poolTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
function poolTexture() {
  if (poolTex) return poolTex;
  const W = 256, H = 256;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = W;
  cv.height = H;
  const g = cv.getContext('2d')!;
  const gr = g.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, W / 2);
  gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
  gr.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)');
  gr.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
  gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  poolTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  poolTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return poolTex;
}

const poolMats = new Map<string, THREE.MeshBasicMaterial>();
function poolMaterial(color: string, opacity: number) {
  const key = `${color}|${opacity}`;
  let m = poolMats.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: poolTexture(), color, transparent: true, opacity, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false, fog: false });
    poolMats.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

const BEAM = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 2.7, 9, 48, 1, true);
// Soft volumetric-looking beam: only back faces draw (so it never tints a character standing in
// it), brightest through the middle and toward the floor, fading out at the silhouette and top.
// When the camera is inside the cone every face is a back face and the far wall would wash a
// character standing behind it navy, so the beam fades out as the camera enters it.
const beamMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  side: THREE.BackSide, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, fog: false, toneMapped: false,
  uniforms: { uColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#5d73c9') }, uOpacity: { value: 0.55 } },
  vertexShader: `varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vY; varying float vIn;
    void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal); vV = -mv.xyz; vY = uv.y;
      vec4 o = modelMatrix * vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      float r = 2.7 - 2.2 * clamp((cameraPosition.y - o.y + 4.5) / 9.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      vIn = 1.0 - smoothstep(r - 0.5, r + 0.3, length(cameraPosition.xz - o.xz));
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uColor; uniform float uOpacity; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vY; varying float vIn;
    void main(){ float f = abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV))); float a = pow(f, 2.5) * pow(1.0 - vY, 1.4) * uOpacity * (1.0 - vIn); gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor, a); }`,
});
// Backdrop: matches the fog colour at the horizon so the floor melts into it, a faint glow band
// just above, darkening to deep navy overhead.
const skyMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  side: THREE.BackSide, depthWrite: false, fog: false, toneMapped: false,
  uniforms: { uHor: { value: new THREE.Color('#141c33') }, uBand: { value: new THREE.Color('#1f2b52') }, uTop: { value: new THREE.Color('#090d1c') } },
  vertexShader: `varying vec3 vD; void main(){ vD = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uHor; uniform vec3 uBand; uniform vec3 uTop; varying vec3 vD;
    void main(){ float y = max(vD.y, 0.0);
      vec3 c = mix(uHor, uBand, smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, y));
      c = mix(c, uTop, smoothstep(0.08, 0.7, y));
      gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }`,
});
const SKY = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 24);
const RING = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.985, 1, 96);
const OCTA = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0);
const TORUS = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.22, 10, 28);

const ACCENTS: { p: Vec3; s: number; c: string; geo: THREE.BufferGeometry; spin: number; ph: number }[] = [
  { p: [-7.5, 3.4, -10], s: 0.7, c: '#8473d6', geo: G.ico, spin: 0.25, ph: 0 },
  { p: [7.2, 2.4, -12], s: 0.55, c: '#efb54a', geo: OCTA, spin: -0.3, ph: 1.3 },
  { p: [-4.2, 5.6, -17], s: 0.9, c: '#4aa8c4', geo: TORUS, spin: 0.18, ph: 2.1 },
  { p: [10.5, 5.8, -19], s: 0.8, c: '#8473d6', geo: OCTA, spin: 0.22, ph: 3.2 },
  { p: [2.6, 7.2, -22], s: 0.75, c: '#efb54a', geo: G.ico, spin: -0.2, ph: 4.4 },
  { p: [-12, 2.2, -16], s: 0.6, c: '#4aa8c4', geo: G.box, spin: 0.3, ph: 5.1 },
];

export const VoidStage: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ t }) => (
  <group>
    {/* endless floor (fog fades it into the horizon) */}
    <mesh geometry={SKY} material={skyMat} scale={250} renderOrder={-10} frustumCulled={false} />
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={toon(FLOOR, { rim: 0, levels: [110, 190, 255] })} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={160} receiveShadow />
    {/* faint blueprint grid around the stage */}
    <Batched
      id="void-grid"
      build={b => {
        for (let i = -18; i <= 18; i++) {
          b.add('plane', GRID, [i, 0.002, -6], [0.018, 36, 1], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], { kind: 'glow' });
          b.add('plane', GRID, [0, 0.002, i - 6], [36, 0.018, 1], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], { kind: 'glow' });
        }
      }}
    />
    {/* spotlight pool + rings + faint beam */}
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={poolMaterial('#3b4f99', 0.9)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.004, 0]} scale={3.6} renderOrder={2} />
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={poolMaterial('#5a6fc0', 0.5)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.005, 0]} scale={1.7} renderOrder={3} />
    <mesh geometry={RING} material={flat('#3a4c8a')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.006, 0]} scale={3.4} />
    <mesh geometry={RING} material={flat('#2c3a6a')} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.006, 0]} scale={5.2} />
    <mesh geometry={BEAM} material={beamMat} position={[0, 4.5, 0]} renderOrder={4} />
    {/* drifting accents far behind */}
    {ACCENTS.map((a, i) => (
      <mesh
        key={i}
        geometry={a.geo}
        material={envMaterial(a.c)}
        position={[a.p[0], a.p[1] + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + a.ph) * 0.25, a.p[2]]}
        rotation={[t * a.spin + a.ph, t * a.spin * 0.7 + a.ph * 0.5, 0.3]}
        scale={a.s}
      />
    ))}
  </group>
);

export const VOID_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, 0, 0],
  left: [-2.2, 0, 0.3],
  right: [2.2, 0, 0.3],
  back: [0, 0, -3],
  front: [0, 0, 2],
  farLeft: [-4.5, 0, -1.5],
  farRight: [4.5, 0, -1.5],
};

// Episode spec: the JSON Claude writes for every video (public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json).
// Everything in a shot is in seconds relative to the shot start; positions are metres,
// y up, a character with rot 0 faces +z (towards the default camera).

export type Vec3 = [number, number, number];

export type Outfit = {
  top?: 'hoodie' | 'jacket' | 'tee' | 'coat' | 'dress' | 'suit' | 'none';
  topColor?: string;
  accent?: string; // drawstrings, zip, stripes
  bottom?: 'pants' | 'shorts' | 'skirt' | 'none';
  bottomColor?: string;
  shoes?: string;
  hat?: 'cap' | 'beanie' | 'headband' | 'helmet' | 'none';
  hatColor?: string;
  hair?: 'none' | 'spiky' | 'bun' | 'afro' | 'long' | 'ponytail' | 'bob' | 'curly';
  glasses?: boolean;
  glassesColor?: string;
  mask?: string; // breathing-apparatus visor tint (firefighters, divers)
  headphones?: string;
  backpack?: string;
};

export type CastMember = Outfit & {
  name?: string;
  height?: number; // 1 = adult (1.75 m); kids ~0.7
  build?: number; // torso width multiplier
};

// A pose is a set of joint angles in degrees. Missing joints fall back to "stand".
export type Pose = {
  hipY?: number; // hips offset from standing height (m), negative = lower
  body?: Vec3; // whole-body rotation (x tips forward/back, z sideways) — lying, falling
  spine?: [number, number, number]; // bend fwd, lean to own left, twist to own left
  head?: [number, number, number]; // nod down, turn to own left, tilt
  armL?: [number, number, number, number]; // fwd raise, out raise, twist, elbow bend
  armR?: [number, number, number, number];
  legL?: [number, number, number]; // fwd raise, out raise, knee bend
  legR?: [number, number, number];
  handL?: 'fist' | 'open' | 'point';
  handR?: 'fist' | 'open' | 'point';
  // Two-bone IK: put the wrist on a body landmark or a root-local point; overrides armL/armR.
  reachL?: Reach;
  reachR?: Reach;
};

export type Reach = {
  to: 'mouth' | 'face' | 'chin' | 'temple' | 'forehead' | 'chest' | 'heart' | 'hip' | 'pocket' | Vec3;
  offset?: Vec3; // extra root-local offset (m)
  pole?: Vec3; // elbow hint, chest-local (+x = character's left)
};

export type Face = {
  eyes?: number; // openness 0..1.4 (1.4 = wide)
  pupils?: boolean; // black pupil dots (shocked close-ups)
  look?: [number, number]; // eye offset -1..1
  brow?: number; // -1 angry V .. 0 neutral .. 1 worried
  browY?: number; // raise
  mouth?: number; // curve: -1 frown .. 1 smile
  open?: number; // 0..1
  width?: number;
  tears?: boolean;
  sweat?: boolean;
  blush?: boolean;
  lid?: number; // 0..0.7 heavy upper lid (smug / bored / sly)
  lidTilt?: number; // lid slope -1..1 (defaults to brow); negative = inner end lower (sly)
  size?: number; // feature scale (thumbnails use ~1.8)
};

export type Key<T> = { t: number; v: T; blend?: number };

export type ActorInShot = {
  id: string; // key into episode.cast
  pos?: Vec3;
  rot?: number; // yaw degrees
  pose?: string | Pose; // starting pose
  face?: string | Face; // starting expression
  poses?: { t: number; pose: string | Pose; blend?: number }[]; // t may be a word cue "@word" in episode.json
  faces?: { t: number; face: string | Face; blend?: number }[];
  path?: { t: number; pos: Vec3; gait?: Gait; rot?: number }[]; // waypoints; moves between them
  gait?: Gait; // default gait for path segments
  strafe?: boolean; // keep facing `rot` while moving along the path (rolling backwards, side-steps)
  look?: string | Vec3 | 'camera'; // head looks at actor id / point
  talk?: [number, number][]; // mouth flaps during these intervals
  hold?: { L?: string; R?: string; scaleL?: number; scaleR?: number }; // props in hands; scaleX enlarges one about the palm (a prop the narration points at)
  scale?: number;
  ghost?: boolean; // translucent copy (afterimages, visions)
  glow?: string; // aura colour
  hidden?: boolean;
  contact?: boolean; // may touch/overlap other characters (hugs, tackles) without an audit error
};

export type Gait = 'walk' | 'run' | 'sprint' | 'dash' | 'sneak' | 'jog' | 'float' | 'glide' | 'carried' | 'shamble'; // shamble: slow zombie drag, arms out in front. carried: moved by something (basket, seat, a flight) — the pose stays as keyed

export type CameraSpec = {
  shot?: 'establishing' | 'wide' | 'full' | 'medium' | 'close' | 'xclose' | 'insert';
  target?: string | string[] | Vec3; // actor id(s) or a point
  focus?: 'head' | 'chest' | 'hips' | 'feet' | 'handL' | 'handR';
  angle?: number; // yaw around the target; for an actor 0 = in front of them, 90 = their left side
  height?: number; // elevation degrees (negative = low angle looking up)
  dist?: number; // override distance
  fov?: number;
  over?: string; // over-the-shoulder of this actor
  move?: 'static' | 'drift' | 'pushIn' | 'pullOut' | 'orbitL' | 'orbitR' | 'craneUp' | 'craneDown' |
    'truckL' | 'truckR' | 'track' | 'crashIn' | 'shake' | 'handheld';
  amount?: number; // move strength multiplier
  pos?: Vec3; // explicit camera
  look?: Vec3;
  to?: { pos: Vec3; look: Vec3 };
  moveAt?: [number | string, number | string]; // when the explicit `to` move runs (seconds or word cues); default the whole shot
  ease?: 'inOut' | 'linear' | 'out' | 'in' | 'cruise'; // easing of the explicit `to` move (cruise = steady pan that tracks a mover)
  path?: { t: number | string; pos: Vec3; look: Vec3; fov?: number; ease?: 'inOut' | 'linear' | 'out' | 'in' | 'cruise' }[]; // explicit keyframed camera (word cues ok); overrides pos/look/to
  dutch?: number; // roll degrees
};

export type PropSpec = {
  type: string; // see sets/props.tsx registry
  pos?: Vec3;
  rot?: number | Vec3;
  scale?: number;
  color?: string;
  text?: string;
  path?: { t: number; pos: Vec3; rot?: Vec3 }[];
  [k: string]: unknown;
};

export type Overlay =
  | { type: 'label'; text: string; at?: number; until?: number; corner?: 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br' }
  | { type: 'title'; small?: string; big: string; at?: number; until?: number }
  | { type: 'stopwatch'; from?: string; to?: string; switchAt?: number | string; at?: number; until?: number; persist?: boolean; tick?: number; keep?: boolean; corner?: 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br' } // tick: live countdown of an "M:SS" from (story s per s); keep: no fade-out at the cut // switchAt may be a word cue ("@two")
  | { type: 'stat'; value: number | string; unit?: string; label?: string; at?: number; prefix?: string; decimals?: number; pos?: 'center' | 'top' | 'right' }
  | { type: 'bubble'; text: string; actor: string; at?: number; until?: number }
  | { type: 'thought'; text: string; actor: string; at?: number; until?: number }
  | { type: 'crush'; actor: string; value: number; from?: number; countDur?: number; at?: number; until?: number } // pink heart + % above the actor's head
  | { type: 'caption'; text: string; at?: number; until?: number }
  | { type: 'flash'; at?: number; color?: string }
  | { type: 'counter'; text: string; at?: number }
  | { type: 'news'; headline: string; ticker?: string; tag?: string; at?: number; until?: number }
  | { type: 'hudList'; items: string[]; at?: number; checked?: number };

export type ShotFx = {
  swap?: { t: number | string; ids: [string, string]; keepPaths?: boolean }; // the two actors trade places at t (blink-blink, flash, afterimages). keepPaths: their paths already encode the jump (momentum gags)
  freeze?: boolean | number; // time-freeze grade (number = start time)
  speedLines?: string; // actor id
  trail?: string; // afterimage trail behind actor id
  particles?: 'dust' | 'snow' | 'rain' | 'sparks' | 'embers' | 'stars';
  grade?: 'none' | 'warm' | 'cool' | 'desat' | 'mono' | 'dream' | 'night' | 'danger' | 'flashback';
  slowmo?: boolean;
  vignette?: number;
  shake?: number;
  bars?: 'in' | 'out';
};

// ---- episode spec (public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json) ------------------------------------
// Positions may be a set mark name ("desk") or "mark+x,y,z" offsets ("sidewalk+1.5,0,0").
export type Place = Vec3 | string;

export type EpisodeActor = Omit<ActorInShot, 'pos' | 'path' | 'look'> & {
  pos?: Place;
  path?: { t: number | string; pos: Place; gait?: Gait; rot?: number }[]; // t may be a word cue
  look?: string | Place | 'camera';
};

export type EpisodeProp = { type: string; pos?: Place; follow?: string | { t: number | string; id: string }[]; // ride on an actor's feet (skateboards); switch actor at t
  rot?: number | Vec3; scale?: number; color?: string; text?: string; path?: { t: number | string; pos: Vec3; rot?: Vec3 }[]; [k: string]: unknown }; // path t may be a word cue

export type Shot3D = {
  kind?: '3d';
  id?: string;
  vo?: string; // narration covered by this shot, in script order, in Portuguese. ElevenLabs audio tags like [whispering] are allowed.
  who?: string; // speaker key in episode.voices (default 'narrator')
  hold?: number; // extra seconds after the narration (or the whole shot if no vo). Ends a voice section.
  set: string; // SETS key
  time?: string; // PALETTES key (default: the set's palette)
  variant?: number;
  actors?: EpisodeActor[];
  props?: EpisodeProp[];
  camera?: CameraSpec;
  overlays?: Overlay[];
  fx?: ShotFx;
  sfx?: SfxCue[];
  cut?: 'cut' | 'flow' | 'flash' | 'whip' | 'dip'; // default: flow when the framing barely changes in the same set, else cut
};

export type CardShot = {
  kind: 'card';
  id?: string;
  vo?: string;
  who?: string;
  hold?: number;
  card: string; // CARDS key; the remaining fields are that card's spec
  overlays?: Overlay[];
  sfx?: SfxCue[];
  cut?: Shot3D['cut'];
  [k: string]: unknown;
};

export type Shot = Shot3D | CardShot;

export type SfxCue = { t: number; name: string; vol?: number; dur?: number };

export type MusicCue = { shot: number; mood: 'curious' | 'tension' | 'action' | 'wonder' | 'sad' | 'none'; vol?: number };

export type Episode = {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  fps?: number;
  voice: { id: string; model?: 'eleven_v4' | 'eleven_multilingual_v2' | 'eleven_turbo_v2_5'; direction?: string; tempo?: number; targetWpm?: number; tempoRange?: [number, number]; maxPause?: number; stability?: number; similarityBoost?: number };
  voices?: Record<string, string>; // extra speakers: key → ElevenLabs voice id (narrator = voice.id)
  cast?: Record<string, CastMember>; // merged over src/cast.ts
  music?: MusicCue[];
  shots: Shot[];
};

export type Timing = {
  fps: number;
  total: number; // seconds
  shots: { start: number; dur: number; section: number | null; words?: [string, number][] }[];
  sections: { file: string; start: number; dur: number }[];
};
